izzyondroid:com.tharunbirla.gestureflow.name: GestureFlow
izzyondroid:com.tharunbirla.gestureflow.summary: Control your device with simple motion gestures.
izzyondroid:com.tharunbirla.gestureflow.description:
GestureFlow is an Android application that allows you to control your device with simple motion gestures. It uses the accelerometer and gyroscope sensors to detect gestures and perform actions, providing a touch-free way to interact with your device.
 Features
 Touch-Free Control: Control your device without touching the screen.
 Intuitive Gestures: Simple and intuitive gestures for common actions.
 Accessibility Service: Runs in the background to provide seamless gesture control.
 How to Use
 Enable the Service: 
 Open the GestureFlow app.
 Tap the "Enable Service" button.
 This will take you to the Accessibility settings.
 Find "GestureFlow" in the list and turn it on.
 Perform Gestures: 
 Back: Perform a quick flick of your device towards you (like pulling a trigger).
 Multitasking: Perform a quick flick of your device to the right (like swiping horizontally).
 Notification Pull-down: Perform a quick flick of your device downwards (like dropping your hand).
 Privacy
 GestureFlow requires the Accessibility Service permission to function. All sensor data is processed on-device and is not collected, stored, or shared. Your privacy is respected.

izzyondroid:com.tommihirvonen.exifnotes.name: Exif Notes
izzyondroid:com.tommihirvonen.exifnotes.summary: quickly save important notes when shooting with film.
izzyondroid:com.tommihirvonen.exifnotes.description:
Exif Notes let’s you quickly save important notes and exif data when shooting with film. It allows you to add frequently used gear such as camera bodies and lenses to your database. These can then be selected when adding new rolls of film and when adding new frames. When adding new frames you can save information such as time taken, lens used, shutter speed, aperture, location, custom notes and more.
 You can export ExifTool commands for specific film rolls. You can upload these to Dropbox for example and download them on your computer. You can save the exif data to your scanned files on your computer using ExifTool by Phil Harvey and the ready made commands. In addition to the ExifTool commands you can export a roll’s data in .csv format. You can then use a spreadsheet programme like Excel on your computer to view the data in an easily readable format.
 Exif Notes is a continuous work in progress and new features are added with future versions. There are other Android apps that let you do the same thing as Exif Notes . The objective of Exif Notes is to be fast and easy to use as well as easy on the eyes. It was born out of love for film and out of interest for programming. Exif Notes is a hobby project that I have been developing on my spare time. However, it is developed with good practices and complies with Material Design while being compatible with most Android devices.

fdroid:now.abhi.graycie.name: Graycie
fdroid:now.abhi.graycie.summary: Apply grayscale automatically based on the app in the foreground
fdroid:now.abhi.graycie.description:
Graycie automatically switches Android's grayscale color correction according
to the app currently in the foreground.
Choose one of two policies:
• Only selected apps: selected apps are grayscale; everything else stays in color.
• Except selected apps: selected apps stay in color; everything else is grayscale.
Color apps keep your saved correction for color blindness and its on/off state.
If your saved correction is grayscale, color apps turn correction off instead.
Graycie also includes optional auto-snooze support for banking and other
security-sensitive apps that refuse to run while an accessibility service is
enabled. “Open safely” disables Graycie's accessibility service before opening
one of these apps. You remain in control of when the service resumes.
Important setup and privacy details:
• Graycie uses an accessibility service solely to identify the foreground app.
 It does not read screen text, inspect window content, perform gestures, or
 collect what you type.
• Graycie reads the installed-app catalog so you can select apps for grayscale
 and auto-snooze policies.
• A one-time ADB command must grant WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS. This lets Graycie
 control Android's color-correction setting and restore its own accessibility
 service after a snooze. The permission cannot be granted from within the app.
• Foreground-app detection, policy decisions, settings, and app lists remain
 entirely on your device. Graycie has no network permission, analytics,
 account, ads, cloud service, or telemetry.
• An ongoing local notification is shown while accessibility is snoozed so you
 can return to Graycie and resume it.
• While management is on, Graycie temporarily overrides Android Color
 correction. It saves the previous mode and on/off state and restores them
 when management stops or snoozes. A newer manual correction is kept.
While management is on, Graycie keeps its own interface in color. Home and
launcher-hosted Overview remain grayscale, and the current Home app cannot
be selected.
Before uninstalling, turn Graycie OFF to restore your previous Color correction.
If the screen stays grayscale after uninstalling, open Android Settings →
Accessibility → Color correction and turn Color correction OFF. If you use
correction for color blindness, select your preferred mode there instead.
If you cannot find this setting, search Android Settings for “Color correction”.

* CSV export and import

WAKE UP ON TIME: Proper Alarm Settings
• Keep the app open and running always to have your alarm go off and play the sounds you’ve set for ‘Music'.
When your app is open, you can use the volume slider within the app. When the app is in the background, use the device volume to set your volume.
• Make sure your battery is charged and have your notifications turned on before you go to sleep, when the battery level goes below 30% it might not sound. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.
• Keep your Apple Music available on your device
The music you can select consists of everything you have available on your ‘Apple Music' app on your device. If the music is saved on your iCloud, and not on the device itself, it won’t be available.
NEVER MISS AN ALARM
When you close the app and do not have it running in the background, the alarm will use the device volume instead and play the notification sound system.
The app will close itself automatically after 10 hours of inactivity. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.
When your device is muted, set to ‘Do Not Disturb’, or your device volume is set to 0, the alarm won’t play properly. It will still show the notification without any sound. This is due to Apple’s restrictions as we are unable to access the app settings when the app is closed, only when it’s open or running in the background.

apple-itunes:1557014712.name: MyWay, Route Planner, Delivery
apple-itunes:1557014712.description:
MyWay Route Planner is an app that builds the most efficient routes. MyWay app helps you save up to 30% of your time and money on fuel by providing an optimized stop sequence.
MyWay Route Planner solves all your routing problems and uses the best route optimization algorithms. The app combines the most up-to-date maps, addresses, and places databases from Google Maps, Mapbox, Here, TomTom, ArcGis, and OpenStreetMap into one route planner. Available on iOS, and web, MyWay Route Planner is suitable for individuals, small businesses, and enterprises. MyWay app can work as a delivery route planner, sales route planner, property management route planner, technician route planner, shuttle service route planner, and healthcare route planner, and it has features that will work for every industry.
MyWay Route Planner features:
- Optimize routes up to 200 stops per route (unlimited routes).
- Optimize routes up to 10000 miles.
- Easy to import your addresses (by Photo, Voice, Excel, CSV, from Phonebook, by Web-Link, Google Drive/Dropbox, from other MyWay users, etc.)
- Every Stop has Priority settings (First/High/Normal/Low/Last), Time Window, Time at Stop, Tracking ID, Color, Stop Type, Contact Details and many other parameters that help - you manage and prioritize them.
- Choose fastest or shortest route.
- Routes sharing and tracking.
- Support car, van, small truck (lorry), truck, motorcycle, bicycle, and walking routes.
- Live traffic and historic traffic. Other route conditions (like weather) are also taken into account.
- Circuit routes, one-way routes, pickup/delivery routing with linked pickup–dropoff stops, and all route scenarios.
- Delivery-specific features like proof of delivery (multiple photos, signature, notes, custom proof statuses, etc.).
- Sales-specific features like favourites and connection to your Phonebook.
- Route history with all information about every route (routes export and reports, XLS, CSV, PDF).
- Route building settings (avoid toll roads, allow u-turns, side of the road, access points, unpaved roads, etc.)

debian-packages:backupninja.name: backupninja
debian-packages:backupninja.description:
Backupninja lets you drop simple config files in /etc/backup.d to
coordinate system backups. Backupninja is a master of many arts,
including incremental remote filesystem backup, and MySQL backup.
By creating simple drop-in handler scripts, backupninja can learn new skills.
Backupninja is a silent flower blossom death strike to lost data.
In addition to backing up regular files, Backupninja has handlers to ease
backing up: Maildir, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SVN, Trac, hardware and system
information, as well as the output from custom shell scripts.
Backupninja currently supports common backup utilities, easing their
configuration, currently supported are: rdiff-backup, duplicity, rsync,
borgbackup, restic and CD/DVD.
Most handlers have their own dependencies/recommendations, shown in brackets
below:
 - dup [duplicity, trickle]
 - rdiff [rdiff-backup]
 - sys [debconf-utils, hwinfo, mdadm]
 - makecd [genisoimage, wodim]
 - rsync [rsync]
 - svn [subversion]
 - tar [bzip2]
 - borg [borgbackup]
 - restic [restic]

flathub:org.tigervnc.vncviewer.name: TigerVNC
flathub:org.tigervnc.vncviewer.summary: Connect to VNC server and display remote desktop
flathub:org.tigervnc.vncviewer.description:
Virtual Network Computing (VNC) is a remote display system that allows you to view and interact
 with a virtual desktop environment running on another computer on the network. Using VNC, you can
 run graphical applications on a remote machine and send only the display from these applications
 to your local device. This package contains a client which will enable you to connect to other
 desktops running a VNC server. VNC is platform-independent and supports various operating systems
 and architectures as both servers and clients.
 TigerVNC is a high-speed version of VNC based on the RealVNC 4 and X.org code bases. TigerVNC
 started as a next-generation development effort for TightVNC on Unix and Linux platforms, but it
 split from its parent project in early 2009 so that TightVNC could focus on Windows platforms.
 TigerVNC supports a variant of Tight encoding that is greatly accelerated by the use of the libjpeg-turbo
 JPEG codec.

fedora-packages:fontsquirrel-crete-round.description: Crete Round is a warm slab serif providing a hint of softness to texts. It started as a tailored version of the original Crete fonts - www.type-together.com/Crete - created specially to serve as corporate typeface for the type design competition Letter2 - www.letter2.org. Crete Round is more independent from the original with modified terminals and serifs to create two new fonts that deliver a more contemporary and functional appearance. The tall x-height, low contrast and sturdy slabs prove to be surprisingly efficient for web use. This font supports 128 languages and has 416 glyphs.

fedora-packages:fuse-btfs/fuse-btfs.name: fuse-btfs

fedora-packages:javapackages-bootstrap/j.name: javapackages-bootstrap
fedora-packages:javapackages-bootstrap/j.summary: A means of bootstrapping Java Packages Tools
fedora-packages:javapackages-bootstrap/j.description: In a nutshell, Java Packages Bootstrap (JPB) is a standalone build of all Java software packages that are required for Java Packages Tools (JPT) to work. In order to achieve reliable and reproducible builds of Java packages while meeting Fedora policy that requires everything to be built from source, without using prebuilt binary artifacts, it is necessary to build the packages in a well-defined, acyclic order. Dependency cycles between packages are the biggest obstacle to achieving this goal and JPT is the biggest offender -- it requires more than a hundred of Java packages, all of which in turn build-require JPT. JPB comes with a solution to this problem -- it builds everything that JPT needs to work, without reliance on any Java software other than OpenJDK. JPT can depend on JPB for everything, without depending on any other Java packages. For example, JPB contains embedded version of XMvn, removing dependency of JPT on XMvn, allowing JPT to be used before one builds XMvn package.

firefox-addons:3082659.summary: Zeigt im Checkout, was sich ändert: Preise, Versand, Lieferzeit, Zusatzoptionen. Hinweise, kein Urteil. Daten bleiben im Browser.
firefox-addons:3082659.description:
Shopping Guard beobachtet Ihren Einkauf im Browser und zeigt, was sich zwischen zwei Schritten geändert hat — etwa neu hinzugekommene Versandkosten, eine geänderte Lieferzeit oder eine vorausgewählte kostenpflichtige Zusatzoption.
 Was es tut: 
- Erkennt den Bestellvorgang automatisch — ohne Klick, auf jedem Shop.
- Vergleicht Preise, Versand, Lieferzeit und Optionen zwischen zwei Schritten.
- Meldet Änderungen als Hinweise — kein Urteil, keine Bewertung.
 Was es nicht tut: 
- Keine Datenübertragung: alles bleibt auf Ihrem Gerät.
- Keine Konten, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.
- Liest keine Passwörter, Karten- oder Kontonummern.
Shopping Guard gibt eine Einschätzung auf Basis dessen, was auf der Seite sichtbar ist. Es prüft keine Rechtskonformität und ersetzt keine Beratung.

bluejetty:00045847:ios.description:
AOD Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with AOD Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the AOD Mobile app, you must be enrolled as an AOD FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00068943:ios.description:
The purpose of Zarta is to give misleading answers to real and difficult questions to trick your friends. In Zarta, you can not only spend quality time with your friends but also learn new information. Zarta is a great game that you can play during course break, on long journeys, during match break or a coffee break in your office.
How to play?
One of you chooses a deck as a playmaker, builds a new room, and shares the secret code with other players, and after everyone joins, the playmaker starts the game by pressing the start button.
The playmaker will give you a secret code after installing the game. After entering that code on the join screen, press the join button and wait for the playmaker to start the game.
When the game starts, you will see a question that is difficult to find the right answer so you can earn points by writing a misleading answer that others might think of as the correct answer and letting the other players choose your answers.
The scoring in the game is as follows: If you choose the right answer, you get 1 point. If someone chooses the answer that you created, you get 2 points.
Thank you for listening to us. We would like to listen to you about the game. You can share your comments and suggestions with info@potensas.com.
Categories :
- History&Holidays: If you are good with history and holidays, you will love this category. Your goal is to give tricky answers to questions and try to mislead your friends. 
- General: There are many questions in this category related to different fields such as music, history, important people, etc. 
- Entertainment: In this category, you can find television characters and a lot of things about them. 
- Geography: How well do you know the countries, languages , and cultures of the world? 
 If your geography is good, you will love this category. 
- Sports&Leisure: If you are good with sports and leisure activities, this category is for you. 
- Science&Nature: If you are interested in science and nature, you will love this category. 
- People&Places, This category includes questions about famous people and famous places. 
- Music: If you are good with songs, singers and bands, this category is for you. 
- Food&Drink: How much do you know the world cuisine? If you are good with food and 
 drinks, you will love this category. 
- Religion&Mythology: How much do you know religions and mythologies? If you are interested in religions and mythologies, you will love this category. 
- Art&Literature: If you are interested in art and literature, you will love this category.
Terms & Condition: http://zartaapp.com/terms-and-condition.html 
Privacy Policy : http://zartaapp.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00129682:ios.summary:
Train Your Brain Daily with BlockMind
BlockMind is a brain training app focused on memory, logic, and concentration, designed for adults and seniors. Through short daily sessions, it helps improve memory, reasoning skills, mental speed, an
bluejetty:00129682:ios.description:
Train Your Brain Daily with BlockMind
BlockMind is a brain training app focused on memory, logic, and concentration, designed for adults and seniors. Through short daily sessions, it helps improve memory, reasoning skills, mental speed, and focus in a simple and effective way.
Whether you want to stay mentally sharp, improve concentration, or support healthy brain aging, BlockMind offers science-inspired cognitive exercises you can practice every day.
Medical Validation and Daily Brain Training Benefits
BlockMind has been reviewed and validated by medical specialists in memory and cognitive health. The exercises are designed to support brain function through regular, structured mental training, aligned with recognized principles of cognitive stimulation.
Daily practice with BlockMind helps reinforce memory, attention, and reasoning over time. Short, consistent sessions encourage healthy habits and make brain training both effective and sustainable, especially for adults and seniors.
Improve Logic and Visual Reasoning with Picture Puzzles
BlockMind features picture-based logic puzzles where you reconstruct mixed images using deduction and visual reasoning. These exercises train logical thinking, spatial reasoning, and attention.
This mode provides ideal cognitive stimulation for adults and seniors who want to maintain mental agility through engaging visual brain puzzles.
Boost Mental Speed and Focus with Timed Challenges
Speed Mode challenges your brain with timed puzzles designed to improve mental speed, reaction time, and focus. These exercises strengthen working memory and help improve attention span and cognitive flexibility.
Perfect for users looking to train fast thinking and stay mentally responsive.
Strengthen Memory and Recall with Visual Memory Training
In Memory Mode, you observe an image briefly, then rebuild it from memory. This mode targets short-term and long-term memory, improving visual retention and recall.
Regular memory training helps support cognitive health and prevent age-related memory decline.
Designed for Adults and Seniors
BlockMind is designed to support cognitive health at any age, with accessible exercises that encourage daily mental activity and long-term brain fitness.
Adaptive Training and Progress Tracking
BlockMind tracks your performance and adapts difficulty automatically, helping you improve memory, logic accuracy, focus, and mental speed over time.
Offline Brain Training — No Ads, No Account
BlockMind works fully offline, with no ads, no interruptions, and no account required. Your brain training stays private, calm, and distraction-free.
Why Choose BlockMind?
• Brain training app for adults and seniors
• Validated by memory specialists
• Improves memory, logic, focus, and processing speed
• Adaptive daily mental workouts
• Offline, no ads, no account required
Download BlockMind and make brain training a simple daily habit to stay sharp and focused at any age.

bluejetty:00131767:ios.summary:
The modern basketball coach’s playbook: design plays, plan practice, organize drills, and teach your team clearly.
Elite Hoops gives basketball coaches one place to design plays, build practices, organize drills, and teach more clearly. Us
bluejetty:00131767:ios.description:
The modern basketball coach’s playbook: design plays, plan practice, organize drills, and teach your team clearly.
Elite Hoops gives basketball coaches one place to design plays, build practices, organize drills, and teach more clearly. Used by over 18,000 coaches and trainers, from Division 1 to AAU to youth hoops.
The star of Elite Hoops is our play designer that's approachable, affordable and advanced. Build polished, detailed plays frame by frame, show player movement with precision, organize everything with tags, smart tags call out screens and actions, and present concepts in a way players can actually follow. And when you need to draw something up fast, the Digital Whiteboard that coaches have used to share over 10,000 plays is right here too.
But Elite Hoops is more than just a play tool. It brings together the full coaching workflow across plays, practices, and drills. Build practices from your device, create your own drill library, track with shot charts, record breakdown videos, and share everything with players and staff. Or, create a practice in a pinch with our AI practice builder, which uses your drills and learns from your team's practice to customize them. Preparing for practice, installing a set, or adjusting in-game, Elite Hoops helps you coach with more detail and less friction.
New: the Play Bank. Hundreds of animated plays with notes on every step, ready to add to your playbook in one tap.
-- Elite Hoops Features --
· Play Designer:
 ⤍ Build animated plays frame by frame with detailed movement and timing and create playbooks.
 ⤍ Organize plays with tags so your playbook stays easy to search and manage.
 ⤍ Show real lineups, spacing, actions, and concepts with far more clarity.
· Play Bank:
 ⤍ Hundreds of animated plays: Horns, Flex, presses, inbounds sets, and more, with notes on every step.
 ⤍ Add any play to your playbook in one tap, then edit it like your own.
· Digital Whiteboard:
 ⤍ Quickly draw up one-off plays, counters, out-of-bounds actions, and defensive concepts.
 ⤍ Share images fast when you need to teach on the fly.
· Practice Planner:
 ⤍ Create and run practices from your device.
 ⤍ Print or share your practice plans as a .pdf.
· Drill Library:
 ⤍ Use our 200+ drills or build your own personalized drill library.
 ⤍ Keep your best drills organized and ready for every session.
· Share Links:
 ⤍ Create a share link for any play, practice, or drill, and turn it off anytime.
 ⤍ Send coaching material to players and staff without exporting a file.
· Video Export:
 ⤍ Record and export breakdown videos of your plays, drills, and concepts to share anywhere.
· Shot Charts:
 ⤍ Track makes and misses during games, scrimmages, or training.
 ⤍ Review trends with a fast, coach-friendly shot chart tool.
· Customizable Court:
 ⤍ NBA, FIBA, WNBA, NCAA, EuroLeague, and High School court dimensions.
 ⤍ Your own court color, hardwood styles, and boundary line colors.
· Team Plans:
 ⤍ Invite unlimited coaches, players, and parents by email, link, or code.
 ⤍ Coaches edit the plays, practices, and drills; players and parents view them.
· Team Tools:
 ⤍ Add as many teams as you coach, with rosters, jersey numbers, and team colors.
· Coaching Tools:
 ⤍ Add an opposing team to demonstrate actions and counters.
 ⤍ Show zone and press defenses with Zone Overlays.
 ⤍ Sub players on the court.
· Built for Apple devices:
 ⤍ Full Apple Pencil support.
 ⤍ AirPlay to a TV and show the whole team.
-- LEGAL --
· View our terms of service here: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
· View our privacy policy here: https://www.elitehoopsapp.com/privacy
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00187054:ios.description:
About this app
Everything you love about WhatsApp plus built-in tools for business
WhatsApp Business is a free-to-download app with built-in tools to help you work smarter, build trust, and grow your business. 
You get free calls* and free international messaging* plus business features to help you do more with conversations.
Download the app to get business benefits like these:
• Work smarter. Save time by letting the app do the work for you! Send customers automated quick replies and away messages so you never miss an opportunity. Use labels to quickly organize, filter, and find important conversations. Create a status to share an offer or news, and even take orders and payments** in-app to create a great customer experience. 
• Build relationships and trust. With a professional business profile on a secure platform, you build credibility and trust with customers. Use the app to provide more responsive customer support and build long-term loyalty. Subscribe to Meta Verified*** to reinforce your authenticity.
• Sell more and grow. Get discovered, advertise, and make more valuable customer connections. Boost sales by sending targeted offers to customers; create ads that click to WhatsApp; showcase your product catalog; and give customers the convenience of in-app orders and payments.**
FAQs
Are all features free?
The app is free to download and use, with a mix of free and paid features.
Can I still use my personal WhatsApp?
Yes! As long as you have two different phone numbers, your business and personal accounts can live together on a single device. 
Can I transfer over my chat history?
Yes. When you set up the WhatsApp Business app, you can restore a backup from your WhatsApp account to transfer your messages, media, and contacts to your business account.
How many devices can I connect?
You can have a total of five web-based devices or mobile phones on your account (up to 10 if you subscribe to Meta Verified***). 
*Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.
**Not available in all markets
***Available soon globally
Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
 Learn more about messaging privately: https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy
 Learn more about WhatsApp safety: https://www.whatsapp.com/security

bluejetty:00121062:ios.description:
Could never resist the attraction of the computer game Spider Solitaire? It has now landed on the AppStore. You can even play it to kill the boring time on your commuting. Spider Solitaire, what a familiar picture! During the years without pervading online games, this classic card-game had brought us uncountable happy moments. In those times, several students gathered round a computer and waited for their turn to play the game, which made the computer class the most cheerful one. As is known to all, the game is very hard to win (never try to seek psychological comfort from playing the junior level monochrome game, which is prepared for the small kids), and it is which aroused the great enthusiasm of some players. Since it’s hard to win, the victory after a hard battle brings a stronger sense of achievement. 
Game features:
1. Completely copy the PC version
2. Excellent control
Spider Solitaire: rules and basics
The object
Remove all the cards from the table in the fewest number of moves.
The table
Spider Solitaire is played with two decks of cards. Depending on the difficulty level, the decks consist of either one, two, or four different suits.
The cards are arranged in ten columns. The top card in each column is face up, the rest are face down. The remaining cards are piled in the lower-right corner of the table.
How to play
To win, you must remove all the cards from the table by building columns organized in descending order, from king to ace. At intermediate and advanced levels, the cards must also match suit.
When you succeed in building a sequentially-ordered column, it flies off the table.
If you run out of moves, click the pile at the bottom of the table and Windows deals a new row of cards.
You aren't limited to moving just one card at a time. If a run of cards are all in the same suit, and arranged in numeric order, you can drag them around as if they were a single card.
Scoring
You start with 500 points. From this, Windows subtracts the number of moves it takes to finish a game. It then increases this subtotal by 100 times the number of runs removed from the table.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the colorful, adventurous, and captivating world of Adorimon. Enjoy the journey of collecting, training, and battling to become a true Adorimaster. Step into the action and explore the Mystery World now!

bluejetty:00021556:ios.description:
Pocket Terço – O app católico mais completo para sua vida de oração
O Pocket Terço é um aplicativo gratuito, sem publicidade, que reúne mais de 250 terços, novenas, meditações e devoções, além de centenas de orações, músicas católicas e a Liturgia Diária mais completa em língua portuguesa. Ideal para quem deseja rezar a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar, mesmo sem um terço físico em mãos. Todas as orações são guiadas com as contas na tela, tornando a experiência de oração ainda mais prática e profunda.
Principais funcionalidades:
• Terços
Reze com facilidade o Rosário completo (em português e latim), Terço da Misericórdia, Terço da Providência, Terço de São José e muitos outros.
• Novenas
Acompanhe o início de cada novena com notificações e reze dia após dia com os textos completos, sem se perder.
• Meditações
Faça diariamente a meditação do dia com o recurso de Meditação Dirigida. Cresça sua vida espiritual com as meditações de Santo Afonso Maria de Ligório para cada dia do ano.
• Devocionários
Tenha sempre à mão as orações essenciais para o seu dia: orações da manhã, da noite e muito mais – também em formato de áudio.
• Consagrações
Prepare-se para a Consagração a Jesus pelas mãos de Maria ou para a Consagração a São José. Renove suas promessas batismais com acompanhamento diário.
• Liturgia do Dia (atualizada diariamente)
Acompanhe as leituras completas (conforme o calendário da Igreja Católica no Brasil), com Homilia do dia (texto e áudio), Santo do dia, antífonas e orações do Missal, além das antífonas do Gradual (tradução 
oficial aprovada no Brasil) para cantar.
• Rede de intercessão
Envie suas intenções de oração e interceda pelas intenções de outros usuários. Uma rede de oração viva.
• Orações
Acesse rapidamente mais de 630 orações organizadas por temas e em ordem alfabética. Use o campo de busca para localizar com facilidade a oração desejada.
• Exame de consciência
Faça seu exame de consciência para uma boa confissão. Você conta com vários modelos, inclusive exame de consciência para pecados veniais.
• Player com músicas católicas
Reze com cantos gregorianos, salmos e músicas de diversos artistas católicos enquanto descansa, trabalha ou dirige.
• Notificações inteligentes
Receba alertas sempre que uma novena estiver prestes a começar para não perder nenhuma oportunidade de oração.
Tudo isso totalmente gratuito e sem limitações.
Para quem deseja apoiar o projeto, oferecemos conteúdos adicionais opcionais que ajudam a manter o aplicativo no ar.
Ajude-nos com sua avaliação!
Seu comentário na App Store é muito importante. Para avaliá-lo, abra o app, toque em “Sobre” e clique no link para deixar sua opinião.
Dúvidas, sugestões ou pedidos de novas orações?
Entre em contato conosco: contato@pocketterco.com.br

◉ Homework Time Saver: Say goodbye to endless hours spent on tricky math problems. With Math Solver, tackle your homework in record time, leaving you with more freedom to pursue your passions and enjoy the things you love.

◉ On-the-Go Convenience: Solve math problems anytime, anywhere – even without an internet connection. Whether you're in a classroom, library, or hanging out with friends, Math Solver ensures you have the tools you need right at your fingertips.
◉ Boost Confidence: Gain confidence in your math skills as you effortlessly conquer each problem. Math Solver is your secret weapon for turning homework challenges into moments of success.

Don't let math homework be a roadblock in your academic journey. Download Math Solver today and experience a faster, more enjoyable way to tackle math problems. Spend less time stressing and more time doing what you love! Your homework hero awaits.

At Kido Games, we create safe, high-quality digital experiences designed to inspire creativity and independent play.

bluejetty:00068055:ios.name: Animatoon
bluejetty:00068055:ios.summary:
Anima Toon is a unique 3d modelling and animation program for creating and animating voxel characters easily.
Model and animate a 3D character with keyframes using onion skin guides in order to pose your characters.
Create and save clips
bluejetty:00068055:ios.description:
Anima Toon is a unique 3d modelling and animation program for creating and animating voxel characters easily.
Model and animate a 3D character with keyframes using onion skin guides in order to pose your characters.
Create and save clips of your animations to reuse and modify on other characters.
Modify the character and then seamlessly switch back and forth with the animation scene.
The built in renderer allows you to preview your character in modelling and animation modes with soft shadows and HDR lighting.
Create infinite varieties of characters (including four legged animals )based on the character templates included along with access to a library of animations and models such as walks, runs, idles, fights etc. The timeline allows you to copy, paste and delete keyframes along with simple navigation to zoom in and out of frames.
The intuitive rig controllers have smart manipulator guides to accurately pose and animate your characters.
Gesture driven controls allow frame operations to be done with speed and precision.
Export your 3D animations as .GLTF and .FBX files so you can import them in popular packages such as Blender, Maya, Unreal and Unity 3d.
Import .VOX files from Magicavoxel to seamlessly add backgrounds to your character animations.
*Non-linear character animation and 3d modelling workflow
*Infinite variations based on inbuilt rigs and library animations
*Export as .GLTF runtime animations to use in Blender, Maya, 3dsMax,Unity 3D etc
*Save animations as clips to reuse and share animations
*MP4 export for quick renders and sharing
*Import .VOX files from your favourite voxel creation packages such as Magicavoxel
*Import and export scenes for collaborative workflow
*Audio functionality: Import .MP3 and .WAV ,Scrub in timeline and export out with MP4
*Demos and tutorials for learning are bundled inside the app
*Apple Pencil support for modelling and painting in 3D
*Ambient Occlusion mode for previewing renders in realtime
*Dozens of in-built library characters
*Reusable animations for basic walks, runs, attacks, idles etc...
Designed for animators, by animators Anima Toon can be used by beginners and pros to create 3D character animations intuitively and easily.
Anima Toon has been created by Appy Monkeys, an award winning app developer with 10 years of experience in creating fun and intuitive creativity apps with over 10 million downloads on the App store and recipient of various awards such as Children's Tech Review and Purdue University's guide for STEM apps
Animatoon Home Page: https://www.animatoon.org/
Animatoon Demo Videos: https://www.animatoon.org/videos.html

bluejetty:00041402:ios.name: The Atlas News
bluejetty:00041402:ios.summary: In today’s information environment, headlines move faster than governments and misinformation spreads faster than truth. For professionals, analysts, and globally engaged citizens, staying ahead is not optional—it’s essential. Atlas provide
bluejetty:00041402:ios.description:
In today’s information environment, headlines move faster than governments and misinformation spreads faster than truth. For professionals, analysts, and globally engaged citizens, staying ahead is not optional—it’s essential. Atlas provides real-time geopolitical reporting and open-source intelligence (OSINT) designed to give you situational awareness and decision advantage.
We don’t just deliver headlines—we deliver clarity. Atlas News monitors conflict zones, military activity, political instability, and global security threats, transforming raw signals into verified reporting and actionable insight.
Why Atlas:
Mainstream outlets often report late, incompletely, or with noise. Atlas News was built for those who need to detect, understand, and adapt faster. Our analysts use OSINT tradecraft, geolocation, and multi-source validation to surface the earliest indicators of global events—often before they reach mainstream coverage.
Our mission is simple:
- Detect earlier. Identify emerging threats, shifts, and signals as they happen.
- Decide faster. Concise, verified reporting that cuts through the clutter.
- Understand deeper. Analytical context behind the headline—giving you the “so what” that matters.
Key Features:
- Coverage of conflicts, military operations, diplomatic shifts, and international crises.
- Updates powered by open-source collection, verification, and analysis.
- Push notifications for critical developments so you are always ahead of the curve.
- Intelligence-style briefs that explain why events matter.
- Track regions, topics, or report types relevant to your mission set or interests.
- Unfiltered and unbiased reporting of the most important geopolitical shifts. 
Who Uses Atlas News:
- Security professionals and policymakers who need early warning and threat awareness
- Analysts, journalists, and researchers looking for credible, source-verified intelligence
- Globally engaged citizens who want to cut past the noise and see the real picture
Our Mission:
Atlas exists to turn information into intelligence. We are not entertainment, and we are not late-breaking. We are early detection, rapid validation, and clear analysis of global events. By fusing OSINT tradecraft with accessible reporting, we provide the awareness you need to anticipate—not just react.
No spin. No delay. Just intelligence for a complex world.

bluejetty:00074173:ios.name: Chladni Screen
bluejetty:00074173:ios.summary:
Chladni figures were geometric figures first discovered by Robert Hooke in 1680 and was researched and published by Ernst Chladni in 1787.
These geometric figures are typically rendered on a rigid, vibrating membrane made from materials su
bluejetty:00074173:ios.description:
Chladni figures were geometric figures first discovered by Robert Hooke in 1680 and was researched and published by Ernst Chladni in 1787.
These geometric figures are typically rendered on a rigid, vibrating membrane made from materials such as metal, plastic, glass, or bowl, covered with grains, like salt and sand, and changes shapes in response to different sounds that are transmitted by mediums such as speakers and actuators.
The study of such phenomena is also known as cymatics.
Chladni is able to simulate the phenomena digitally.
A further 3 programs can be displayed by pressing and holding each of the 3 mode buttons.
Some texts in this document are taken from the following Wikipedia Creative Commons license (inheritance).
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ernst_Chladni
Explore the wonders and beauty of the Chladni figures as it manifests from varying sound sources such as your voice and instruments!

• Autoscroll
• Guitar, ukulele and piano chord diagrams, including alternate tunings
• Audio player & recorder. Attach your tracks from Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, URL or local file

• Bluetooth / MIDI pedal support

• Tonic Pad — an ambient backing pad matched to your song's key
• PlayTogether — keep your whole band in sync live, hands-free

bluejetty:00159275:ios.name: TachyMon
bluejetty:00159275:ios.summary:
Get rapid alerts for significant heart rate changes due to POTS, tachycardia, exercise or other activities. 
Features:
- Haptic alerts based on custom threshold levels.
- Customizable upper and lower threshold levels for current heart rate
bluejetty:00159275:ios.description:
Get rapid alerts for significant heart rate changes due to POTS, tachycardia, exercise or other activities. 
Features:
- Haptic alerts based on custom threshold levels.
- Customizable upper and lower threshold levels for current heart rate and difference from recent average.
- The main display shows: current heart rate, moving average of recent heart rate, and delta of current heart rate to average.
- Display colors change to show severity of alert.
- The app tracks alert events with start time of event, event duration, starting average heart rate, and maximum or minimum heart rate during event.
- Triple tap to temporarily silence alerts.
- Review detailed monitoring data on the companion iPhone app.
Premium features:
- View detailed heart rate chart for each event
- Share event info directly from watch, or export from iPhone to Photos app
- Run monitoring sessions directly on your iPhone, without an Apple Watch, by connecting a Bluetooth heart rate sensor
- Generate a shareable PDF report for each session
- Add notes and symptoms to Alert Events
- Export Alert Event raw heart rate data to .csv
- View live session data on the iPhone companion app
- View a summary of Alert Events over last week / month / year
TachyMon was created by the developer for his niece Alex, who was diagnosed with Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS) in the fall of 2021. Alex was experiencing frequent fainting, and her family noticed the episodes often followed a rapid rise in her heart rate. She wanted a heads-up the moment that started happening. Alex uses TachyMon's alerts as a cue to sit or crouch down when her heart rate climbs quickly, and she finds the app helps her feel a bit more in control of her day.
It is a simple but specialized app, and we hope it may help others with POTS, or anyone who wants to be alerted to changes in their heart rate.
APPLE HEALTH
TachyMon integrates with the Apple Health app. TachyMon stores workout information (including heart rate) with the Apple Health app.
WARNING: It is important to consult with medical professionals if you are concerned about your health. The TachyMon app is intended for informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for specialized medical care.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

------------------------------------------
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!!
With this Travel Guide you have a full city guide in your iPhone & iPod Touch.
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!!
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. Slide through the tutorial for more tips. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standed.
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc...
Unlike other guides, this Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region.
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Strøget, The City Hall Square, Frederick's Church, Church of Our Saviour, Kongens Nytorv, Royal Danish Theatre, Frederiksstaden, Amalienborg Palace, Bernstorff Palace, Royal Danish Playhouse, Langelinie, Gefion Fountain, Nyhavn, The Little Mermaid, Slotsholmen, Christiansborg Palace, Børsen, Royal Danish Library, Thorvaldsens Museum, Christian IV's Brewhouse, Tøjhus Museum, among others.
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.
This app contains IAPs for you to enjoy and discover the best out of your visit.

Very Good Camera is based on the most popular film grades by Very Good Co. Three color grades suit every style of photography: VG400 for anytime, VG800 for low-light, and VGTX for monochrome. This camera is feature-rich, with tools you'd expect to find in any camera: focus & exposure modes, tools to overlay, and various file formats.
This camera also includes three iconic shutter sounds, natural processing for a digicam look, and the ability to dial in and customize each of our color grades. Whether you want a filmic, digicam, or modern look, Very Good Camera has what you need to get the best colors right out of your iPhone.

- Camera modes for a full or minimal experience
- Various aspect ratios, including native 4:3 as well as 2:3, 5:4, 1:1, 16:9, and XPAN
- File formats with JPG, HEIC, and RAW
- Resolution of 12MP or 48MP
- Standard or Natural Processing
- Build out a custom lens kit of common focal lengths
- Auto or Manual Exposure Modes to control ISO & Shutter
- Exposure lock to prevent exposure changes
- Exposure push and pull, based on film scans
- Tap or Tracking Focus Modes
- Mirrored or True modes for the Selfie cam
- Three iconic shutter tones
- Grid, level, and histogram overlay tools
- Self timer
- White, black, and film-inspired frames

Who’s faking among your friends? Fakeit is a fast-paced imposter game built around bluffing, quick thinking, and hilarious debates. Designed for unforgettable game nights, parties, road trips, and hangouts, this imposter word game brings people together for fast-paced rounds filled with laughter, tension, and surprise twists. In this impostor game, everyone knows the secret word… except the imposters. Most players see the word, while the fakers must bluff, improvise, and blend in. As a dynamic imposter game app, it ensures everyone can join the fun. After the hints are shared, it’s time to debate, accuse, and vote. Can you expose them before they slip away with the win?
How to Play Imposter Game: Quick Rules 
· Get the Secret Word: Driven by a smart imposter game generator, most players see the secret word, while the liars are left in the dark. 
· Give Clever Hints: Share subtle clues, debate, accuse, and read the room. 
· Vote the Faker Out: Each round brings a fresh challenge. Can you guess the impostor, spot the spy, and figure out who the traitor is?
Why Players Love the Fakeit Impostor App 
· Easy to Pick Up: No complex rules—anyone can join the fun instantly. 
· Infinite Variety: Enjoy 10 categories and 1000+ words. Play our handcrafted “Party Time” deck for free, or subscribe to unlock full access with no limits. 
· Offline Multiplayer: No internet? No problem. Enjoy face-to-face multiplayer fun with your friends and family anywhere. 
· Smart Word Selection: Think of Fakeit as your dynamic imposter game generator that creates endless unique scenarios for every round.
Whether you are looking for a spy game, an infiltrator challenge, or a built-in social deduction experience, this imposter game app is optimized for both phones and tablets to deliver a smooth multiplayer experience. This engaging imposter word game keeps every round unpredictable and competitive.
Test your detective skills, face off in group adventures, and see who’s the sharpest detective—or the sneakiest liar. Try Fakeit now and turn your next game night into legendary fun!

Skybrary: Kids Reading App with Free Books and Read-Aloud Stories
Skybrary is the trusted, ad-free children’s reading app with 1,000+ eBooks (100 free!) and 150+ educational field trip videos—perfect for ages 3–9, online or offline.
Why Parents and Teachers Love Skybrary
Read Anywhere, Anytime
Download books once and enjoy them anywhere with Skybrary’s offline mode. Kids can read, explore, and learn even without Wi-Fi. It’s the perfect reading companion for travel, quiet time, or bedtime stories.
Designed for Kids, Backed by Experts
Skybrary is more than just a kids reading app—it’s built to support early literacy and spark imagination. With calming visuals, read-aloud stories, and no ads or overstimulation, Skybrary makes screen time enriching and parent-approved.
Curated, Quality Content
No random algorithms—every book and video is hand-selected by literacy experts. From picture books and early readers to educational field trips, Skybrary offers diverse, high-quality content that helps kids discover the joy of reading.
Free Books for Kids
Start exploring with 100 free books for kids. Upgrade anytime to unlock our full library of 1,000+ eBooks and 150+ videos. Whether you’re looking for free book apps for kids or want to know where to read books for free, Skybrary makes it easy to inspire a lifelong love of reading.
Trusted by Families and Educators
Used in classrooms nationwide, Skybrary brings the same trusted literacy experience to your home. Powered by Reading Is Fundamental (RIF), the nation’s leading children’s literacy nonprofit, every subscription helps get books into the hands of kids in under-resourced communities.
Download Skybrary today—where reading takes flight.

bluejetty:00126931:ios.name: Law of Attraction Toolbox
bluejetty:00126931:ios.summary: Law of Attraction Toolbox is a daily manifestation app with 25+ guided exercises, games, and tools for building a consistent practice. Based on the teachings of Abraham-Hicks, Neville Goddard, Napoleon Hill, and other widely studied methods
bluejetty:00126931:ios.description:
Law of Attraction Toolbox is a daily manifestation app with 25+ guided exercises, games, and tools for building a consistent practice. Based on the teachings of Abraham-Hicks, Neville Goddard, Napoleon Hill, and other widely studied methods, it helps both beginners and experienced practitioners structure their manifestation work on iPhone and iPad.
What problems does this app help with?
Many people learn about manifesting through books, YouTube, or podcasts but struggle to apply the techniques consistently. They feel stuck in unwanted circumstances, can't maintain a daily practice, or find the material overwhelming without guidance. Law of Attraction Toolbox solves this by providing short, guided exercises you can do in 2 to 20 minutes, giving you structure without requiring hours of study.
If you're dealing with limiting beliefs about money, relationships, career, or self-worth, the app includes specific tools for each area. The Money Game helps shift your abundance mindset. Scripting and Future Paving guide you through writing exercises to clarify what you want to manifest. The Focus Wheel and Placemat Process - both drawn from Abraham-Hicks teachings - help you work through resistance on specific topics.
How does daily manifestation practice work?
The app is built around the idea that raising your emotional vibration is the foundation of manifesting. The Emotional Scale guidance helps you identify where you are emotionally and choose the right exercise to move up the scale. On a difficult day, you might start with the Emergency Alignment tool or a guided meditation. On a good day, you might use the Feel As If Game or Vision Board to amplify your momentum.
Each exercise includes 60+ unique prompts, so you won't repeat the same content. The 68-Second Timer is based on Abraham-Hicks' teaching that 68 seconds of pure focused thought activates the vibration of what you want.
AI-powered manifestation coaching
The built-in AI coach provides personalized guidance based on where you are in your practice. It generates custom affirmations tailored to your specific goals, creates mantras aligned with your intentions, and offers daily empowering questions to keep your focus sharp. When you feel off-track or emotionally low, the coaching feature helps you realign without needing to search through books or videos.
Tracking what you manifest
The app includes a manifestation goals list where you log your desires and track which ones have come to fruition. A progress journal lets you record daily insights, synchronicities, and shifts in your thinking. Over time, this becomes a personal record of your growth - something practitioners often find motivating when they look back and see how far they've come.
Gratitude and appreciation practice
Gratitude is central to manifesting. The Daily Gratitude Game and Appreciation exercises help you build a habit of noticing what's already working in your life, which is the foundation for attracting more of what you want. These are some of the simplest tools in the app but often the most effective for shifting your daily mood.
Who is this app for?
Law of Attraction Toolbox works for anyone interested in manifestation, positive thinking, mindset work, visualization, or spiritual growth practices. Whether you follow Abraham-Hicks, Neville Goddard, Joe Dispenza, The Secret, or general positive psychology principles, the tools complement what you already know. It's particularly helpful if you want a structured way to manifest without spending hours on YouTube or re-reading books.
The app includes both free and premium features. You can start with the free tools and upgrade if you want access to the full library.
Terms of use (EULA) - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy - http://www.lawofattractiontoolboxapp.com/app-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00037378:ios.description:
Universal Remote - Control TVs is your one-stop solution for a seamless smart TV experience.
This app transforms your smartphone into a powerful universal remote, replicating all the functionality of your original remote and offering additional features you'll love: 
* Core Remote Functions: Control everything effortlessly, including volume, channels, playback, and navigation.
* Intuitive UI: Enjoy a user-friendly interface with a full remote layout, responsive touchpad, fast keyboard search, and more.
* Automatic Setup: Forget complicated configurations. Our app simplifies setup to get you started instantly.
* Effortless Channel Surfing: Access your favorite channels with ease through the system tab.
* Big Screen Entertainment: Cast photos, videos directly from your phone to your TV for a truly immersive experience. (New Feature!)
* Multi-Media Casting: Unleash the power of your phone's screen. Cast PDFs, PPTX presentations, browse content directly on your TV, and view online images. (New Feature!)
* Seamless Wi-Fi Connectivity: Connect your phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network for effortless control. 
How to Get Started:
1. Download Universal Remote - Control TVs and ensure your phone and Smart TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
2. Click the Connect icon on the app and choose your Smart TV from the list.
3. Start exploring! Enjoy all the features at your fingertips. 
Compatibility:
Our app is designed to work with all major Smart TV brands, giving you universal control.

bluejetty:00147096:ios.summary:
Amazing Marvin is a to-do list and daily planner you can customize, one feature at a time.

bluejetty:00147096:ios.description:
Amazing Marvin is a to-do list and daily planner you can customize, one feature at a time.
WHY IT WORKS THIS WAY
Different things work for different people. The method that changed your colleague's life can feel like a straitjacket on you. The setup you loved in March can stop working in June. That is normal.
So Marvin does not hand you a fixed system. Turn on the features you need, and disable the ones you don't. 
What users are saying:
"So customizable, that when I feel I start to get bored, I can change my flow or strategy & it feels like a brand new app."
If you have ever abandoned a setup because you got bored of it, you will love Marvin.
PLANNING YOUR DAY
- Day planner, where each day gets its own list rather than one endless pile
- Duration estimates and a capacity bar that tells you when you have planned more than the day actually holds
- Do dates and due dates kept separate, so "work on it Tuesday" is not the same as "it is due Tuesday"
- Two-way calendar sync
- Week planning, with tasks dragged between days to even out the load
- Nested projects and categories, labels, smart lists, recurring tasks
- A backburner for someday, kept out of sight of today
STARTING IS THE OTHER HALF
Knowing what to do and being able to begin are two different problems, and the second is where most days come apart. A lot of Marvin is built for that exact moment:
- Accountability Pledge: put money on a task. If you do not finish it, you pay.
- Procrastination Wizard: an interactive walk-through of why you are stuck and what to try next
- Task breakdown: split something until the first step is small enough to be boring
- Super Focus Mode: everything hidden except the one task
- The Task Jar: when choosing is the problem, let it choose for you
- Dread levels and Eat the Frog, so the thing you are avoiding stops being invisible
- Truncated lists, showing two or three items at a time instead of forty
KEEPING TRACK, OR NOT
Time tracking, Time goals, Pomodoro targets, Habits, Points and Rewards are all here (optional). 
BUILT WITH LOVE, BY A SMALL TEAM
Marvin has been in development for nearly ten years and is still made by a very small team that reads its own support email. It is funded by the people who use it, which is why it has no ads, no data selling and no investors to grow for.
ON YOUR PHONE
The Marvin phone app syncs with the web and desktop versions. Capture on the bus, plan at your desk, or do all of it from your pocket.
Free 14-day trial, no card required.
SUBSCRIPTION
After the free trial, Amazing Marvin is $11.99 per month or $96 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. listings.name: Amazing Marvin: ADHD Planner
listings.description:
Amazing Marvin is a to-do list and daily planner you can customize, one feature at a time.

WHY IT WORKS THIS WAY

Different things work for different people. The method that changed your colleague's life can feel like a straitjacket on you. The setup you loved in March can stop working in June. That is normal.

So Marvin does not hand you a fixed system. Turn on the features you need, and disable the ones you don't. 

What users are saying:
"So customizable, that when I feel I start to get bored, I can change my flow or strategy & it feels like a brand new app."

If you have ever abandoned a setup because you got bored of it, you will love Marvin.

PLANNING YOUR DAY

- Day planner, where each day gets its own list rather than one endless pile
- Duration estimates and a capacity bar that tells you when you have planned more than the day actually holds
- Do dates and due dates kept separate, so "work on it Tuesday" is not the same as "it is due Tuesday"
- Two-way calendar sync
- Week planning, with tasks dragged between days to even out the load
- Nested projects and categories, labels, smart lists, recurring tasks
- A backburner for someday, kept out of sight of today

STARTING IS THE OTHER HALF

Knowing what to do and being able to begin are two different problems, and the second is where most days come apart. A lot of Marvin is built for that exact moment:

- Accountability Pledge: put money on a task. If you do not finish it, you pay.
- Procrastination Wizard: an interactive walk-through of why you are stuck and what to try next
- Task breakdown: split something until the first step is small enough to be boring
- Super Focus Mode: everything hidden except the one task
- The Task Jar: when choosing is the problem, let it choose for you
- Dread levels and Eat the Frog, so the thing you are avoiding stops being invisible
- Truncated lists, showing two or three items at a time instead of forty

KEEPING TRACK, OR NOT

Time tracking, Time goals, Pomodoro targets, Habits, Points and Rewards are all here (optional). 

BUILT WITH LOVE, BY A SMALL TEAM

Marvin has been in development for nearly ten years and is still made by a very small team that reads its own support email. It is funded by the people who use it, which is why it has no ads, no data selling and no investors to grow for.

ON YOUR PHONE

The Marvin phone app syncs with the web and desktop versions. Capture on the bus, plan at your desk, or do all of it from your pocket.

Free 14-day trial, no card required.

SUBSCRIPTION

After the free trial, Amazing Marvin is $11.99 per month or $96 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your device settings.

bluejetty:00034221:ios.name: Outfit Formulas
bluejetty:00034221:ios.summary:
HOW IT WORKS
Every month you’ll get a shopping list of items – a perfect mix of classic closet staples (that you likely already own) and the latest seasonal trends. Shop your closet first using the shopping list, then fill in any gaps remai
bluejetty:00034221:ios.description:
HOW IT WORKS
Every month you’ll get a shopping list of items – a perfect mix of classic closet staples (that you likely already own) and the latest seasonal trends. Shop your closet first using the shopping list, then fill in any gaps remaining at your favorite retailer or use the shopping directory provided. With your checklist of clothing items completed, easily get dressed every day using the daily Outfit Formulas provided in your outfit calendar.
SHOPPING LIST
Your interactive monthly shopping list includes a description of the pictured item, a link to shop the exact pictured item, substitution notes if you’d prefer to use clothes you already have, and a shopping directory with 10+ current retailer options that are regularly updated to help fill in any gaps that may be missing in your wardrobe.
CURATE CLOSET STAPLES
Build a solid wardrobe foundation by intentionally reusing closet staple pieces, these are classic basic items that you can wear season after season, year after year. Every shopping list denotes which items are considered closet staples – these are items worth investing in higher quality if your budget allows. After a few seasons of Outfit Formulas® you’ll have most of your basics in place and just need to add in seasonal trends as you like.
SHOPPING DIRECTORY
Every item on your shopping list includes a shopping directory of retailer links for you to browse as you curate your wardrobe. Links to items at the retailers you already know and love like Target, Amazon, H&M, Old Navy, LOFT, J.Crew Factory, Nordstrom + more can be found and are updated regularly – all you need to do is tap that ‘add to cart’ button. Link options are included for petite fit, tall fit, and plus size as well – our program is for everybody and every BODY!
DAILY OUTFIT CALENDAR
Your outfit calendar includes an Outfit Formula to style for every single day of the year. Just tap on today’s date to view the formula and check out which clothing articles it features. Head to your closet to grab the items in the formula, which you’ll already have handy since they were the same pieces on your shopping list, and voila – getting dressed has never been so easy! Each formula also includes suggestions on how to dress the formula up or down to suit your daily events. Once you are dressed you can tap the ‘Wore It Today’ checkbox to log your outfit styling streak!
PERSONALIZE AS YOU LIKE
Not a fan of white jeans, sleeveless tops, shorts, or heels? No problem! Outfit Formulas® provides you with a formula to follow, rather than a specific article of clothing, which means you have the final say of the cut, style, and color for each and every item. You can follow our recommendations to a tee or get creative with your own unique style. The choice is yours!
The flexibility of a formula allows YOU to decide what matters most to you when getting dressed and empowers you to focus on YOUR priorities as you curate your wardrobe. This format allows members to adapt each formula for their own age, size, body shape, budget, climate, personal style, colors, preferred retailers, and lifestyle.
Subscriptions:
We offer the following subscription plans:
Monthly Subscription
Yearly
The subscription will auto-renew. You can always turn this off by going to "subscriptions" under the App Store.
Terms and Conditions:
https://outfitformulas.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy:
https://outfitformulas.com/privacy-policy/

* Quick sketches and ideas

* Sharing artistic moments
Experience the revival of a classic. Download SimpleDraw today and turn your device into a canvas for your imagination!

bluejetty:00150745:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00150745:ios.description:
Welcome to Tacoria – where flavor fiestas meet fresh vibes!
Dive into a world where tacos reign supreme and every bite tells a tale of Mexico’s rich culinary heritage. But Tacoria is more than just a restaurant with the best Mexican food ever (according to our moms). It’s a vibrant homage to the colors, culture, and hospitality of our southern neighbors. Our mission? To spice up your day with amazing fresh food, fun people, and an atmosphere that’s as lively and cool as a mariachi band!
Features That Sizzle:
- Rewards & Offers: Earn spicy rewards with every visit! From free guac to exclusive discounts, our loyalty program keeps your cravings and your wallet happy.
- Ordering Made Easy: Craving our famous carne asada? Tap, order, and we’ll have it hot and ready when you arrive. No lines, just deliciousness.
- Quick Reorder: Love at first bite? Easily reorder your favorites with a tap – because some things are just too good to wait for.
- Shout-outs & Feedback: Loved our salsas? Got ideas hotter than our habaneros? Share your thoughts and get ready for some taco-loving shout-outs!
- About Us: Tacoria isn’t just a place to eat – it’s a movement. Inspired by Mexico’s zest for life, we’re here to serve up more than food. We’re here to inspire and improve our local communities, one taco at a time.
So, whether you’re crunching on tacos al pastor or sipping on a fresh agua fresca, Tacoria is your spot to eat fresh, feel fresh, and be fresh! Because life’s too short for bland – spice it up with Tacoria today and experience the healthy, happy vibe we’re all about. ¡Buen provecho!

bluejetty:00076118:ios.summary:
Sometimes grocery and everyday shopping can feel overwhelming with so many ingredients and labels to understand. PureCheck is designed to help you scan products and view ingredient details in a simple and accessible way.
PureCheck helps yo
bluejetty:00076118:ios.description:
Sometimes grocery and everyday shopping can feel overwhelming with so many ingredients and labels to understand. PureCheck is designed to help you scan products and view ingredient details in a simple and accessible way.
PureCheck helps you explore food and cosmetic products so you can better understand what they contain and make more informed choices based on your personal preferences and needs.
Why PureCheck?
PureCheck is a smart ingredient scanner and product discovery tool that helps you access available ingredient, nutrition, and product information from everyday products.
It is designed to support users who want to better understand food labels, cosmetic ingredients, and commonly used additives in a simple and structured way.
Key Features
Barcode Scanner
Scan food, beverages, cosmetics, and personal care products to view available ingredient lists, nutrition facts, and product details.
Ingredient Checker
Understand product ingredients in an easy-to-read format, including additives and commonly used components in food and cosmetics.
Cosmetic Ingredient Insights
Explore skincare and cosmetic formulations to better understand what ingredients are included in your personal care products.
Allergen Highlights
View information about ingredients that may be relevant for users with sensitivities, based on available product and ingredient data.
Manual Search
Search products by name or barcode to access available ingredient and product information.
Shopping Lists
Create and manage shopping lists to organize frequently used or preferred products.
How PureCheck Helps
• Understand food and cosmetic labels more clearly
• Compare ingredients across different products
• Review information about commonly known allergens and additives based on available ingredient data
• Explore ingredient information relevant to dietary preferences such as gluten-free or dairy-aware choices
• Make everyday shopping easier and more informed
Important Note
PureCheck provides ingredient and product information based on available data sources. It is intended for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.
Users with allergies, intolerances, or medical dietary requirements should verify product packaging and manufacturer information before making health-related decisions.
Privacy & Data Safety
We respect your privacy and handle information in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For details about how PureCheck collects, uses, and protects information, please review our Privacy Policy.
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/purecheck/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.pixsterstudio.com/legal-policies/purecheck/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00114806:ios.summary:
ClapSeek helps you check if your phone is with you—no networks, no setup, just smart reactions to your actions.
With three simple modes, ClapSeek brings daily convenience to people who often misplace or forget their phones:
• Clap Mode
bluejetty:00114806:ios.description:
ClapSeek helps you check if your phone is with you—no networks, no setup, just smart reactions to your actions.
With three simple modes, ClapSeek brings daily convenience to people who often misplace or forget their phones:
• Clap Mode 
Clap your hands twice, and if your phone is nearby, it will ring. Perfect for quickly locating your phone at home or work.
• Bag Detection Mode 
Place your phone inside your bag. If someone removes it, you’ll hear a sound. A helpful way to notice if your phone is no longer where you left it.
• Surface Tap Mode 
Set your phone on a table, chair, or bed. If someone touches or moves the surface, your phone will respond with a sound.
Who is it for?
• Those who often forget where their phone is
• People in a rush who want a quick way to check before heading out
• Users in shared spaces like offices, cafés, or classrooms
Why choose ClapSeek?
• No internet or Bluetooth required
• Simple, clean interface—easy for everyone to use
• Adjustable sensitivity for different environments
• Lightweight and efficient, with no ads
ClapSeek is not a tracking tool. It doesn’t rely on GPS or microphones. It simply reacts to everyday interactions to help you stay aware of your phone.
Download ClapSeek now and leave phone-forgetting worries behind!

bluejetty:00169303:ios.description:
Heart Rate Recording app uses the camera and flash on your mobile phone to obtain images of blood circulation at your fingertips, and uses the professional PPG algorithms to accurately measure your heart rate!
Use the Heart Rate Recording to measure your heart rate anytime, anywhere in your home or office, when you wake up in the morning, when you relax, before and after exercise, and before attending important meetings.
===============================
* Place the tip of your index finger on the iPhone’s camera, and in a couple of seconds, your pulse will be shown!
* Plus1Health Heart Rate Recording app detects a color change in your finger tip each time your heart beats and uses an advanced algorithm to show you your heart rate.
* A real-time chart will show you every heartbeat, similar to pulse oximeters used in hospitals.
======= MAIN FREE FEATURES ========
1. Heart Rate Measurement 
2. Integrated with Apple Health App
3. Analysis of abnormal heart rate: Tachycardia, Bradycardia, Normal heart rate
4. Pulse waveform graphs
5. A beep for the heartbeat monitor
==== Premium Features ====
6. Unlimited Data Storage
7. Stress Level Test And Trend Analysis 
8. Heart Rate Trend Analysis
======== Attention =======
1. Please place your finger tip on the rear camera lens and flash. Please DO NOT press hardly, that you may cut off the blood circulation of your fingertips and affect the measuring.
2､The APP needs about 5 seconds to learn your heart rate and update the value, and it takes more than 10 seconds to get the accurate heart rate value, The default is 30 seconds.
* NOT INTENDED FOR MEDICAL USE, FOR FITNESS USE ONLY
From our heart to yours,
Plus1Health Team

bluejetty:00022922:ios.description:
The National Post app connects you to the news you need to know. Create your custom feed so you don't miss the latest from your favourite writers.
Features include:
· Stay connected to news that is shaping your world.
· Enjoy the wide variety of comprehensive explainers on trending issues and compelling longreads from our top journalists — plus extensive video coverage.
· Navigate directly to individual publications from across the Postmedia network.
· You can choose your preferred publications when you first open the new app, ensuring a curated news feed that aligns with your interests.
· Use the Discover tab to explore trending stories from our newsrooms across Canada.
· Personalize your news experience by selecting topics, journalists and columnists you want to see more of, so your feed will be filled with the content and perspectives you enjoy.
· Online Access and Home Delivery subscribers receive unlimited access to content on the app, included with your subscription.
· App readers can access one free article before being prompted to register to gain access to two more articles.
If you are not an existing subscriber, you can easily sign up through the app marketplace.
· Payment will be charged to your store account upon confirmation of purchase.
· Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
· The account will now be charged $14.99 for monthly renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends.
· You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal after purchase in the App settings. Select "My Subscription" then "Manage my Subscription" and you will be able to make changes.
Privacy Policy: https://www.postmedia.com/privacy-statement/
Postmedia Terms and Conditions: https://www.postmedia.com/terms-and-conditions/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
We appreciate and value your feedback. Please send any comments, suggestions or questions to: appsupport@postmedia.com
