bluejetty:00160242:ios.name: Bíblia King James Atualizada
bluejetty:00160242:ios.summary: Descubra a profundidade e beleza da palavra de Deus com a aplicação "Bíblia King James Atualizada", uma ferramenta essencial para todo cristão de fala portuguesa que deseja aprofundar sua fé e conhecimento bíblico. Disponível para iPhone e
bluejetty:00160242:ios.description:
Descubra a profundidade e beleza da palavra de Deus com a aplicação "Bíblia King James Atualizada", uma ferramenta essencial para todo cristão de fala portuguesa que deseja aprofundar sua fé e conhecimento bíblico. Disponível para iPhone e iPad, esta aplicação traz a você a renomada versão King James Atualizada (KJA), uma tradução que combina precisão textual com uma linguagem atual, facilitando a compreensão das Sagradas Escrituras.
Ao abrir a "Bíblia King James Atualizada", você é imediatamente envolvido por uma interface limpa e intuitiva, projetada para oferecer a melhor experiência de leitura bíblica, seja em casa, na igreja ou em qualquer lugar. A aplicação não apenas fornece acesso rápido e fácil aos livros e capítulos bíblicos, mas também inclui recursos extras que enriquecem seu estudo e devoção.
Entre os recursos destacados, a Bíblia King James Atualizada KJA" oferece uma vasta seleção de temas bíblicos para predicar, que são perfeitos para pastores e líderes cristãos que buscam inspiração para suas mensagens e sermões. Além disso, para aqueles que procuram um momento de reflexão e conexão diária com Deus, a aplicação apresenta devocionais diários que guiam o usuário através de leituras bíblicas e reflexões profundas sobre a fé cristã.
Para um estudo bíblico mais aprofundado, a Bíblia KJA inclui estudos bíblicos detalhados e bosquejos de sermones que ajudam a compreender melhor os ensinamentos bíblicos e a aplicá-los à vida cotidiana. Estes recursos são ideais para aqueles que desejam crescer em sua compreensão da Bíblia e fortalecer sua fé.
Pensando no conforto e na personalização da experiência do usuário, a "Bíblia King James Atualizada KJA" foi desenvolvida com funcionalidades que permitem ajustar o tamanho do texto de acordo com a preferência do usuário, garantindo assim uma leitura confortável para todos. Além disso, o modo noturno disponível na aplicação assegura uma leitura agradável em ambientes com pouca luz, protegendo os olhos da tensão e do cansaço.
Tudo isso, em conjunto com a possibilidade de marcar versículos, fazer anotações e destacar passagens importantes, faz da "Bíblia King James Atualizada" uma aplicação indispensável para quem busca uma ferramenta completa de estudo e devoção bíblica. Seja você um estudioso da Bíblia, um líder cristão ou alguém em busca de crescimento espiritual, esta aplicação é para você.
Finalmente, el compromiso de la "Bíblia King James Atualizada" con sus usuarios es evidente en su constante actualización y mejora, incorporando regularmente nuevo contenido y funcionalidades para enriquecer aún más la experiencia de estudio bíblico. Con un soporte técnico atento y una comunidad activa, los usuarios pueden estar seguros de que cualquier duda o problema será atendido con prontitud, asegurando así una experiencia de usuario sin igual.
Em resumo, a Bíblia KJA é muito mais do que uma simples aplicação bíblica; é um companheiro de fé que oferece recursos valiosos para aprofundar seu conhecimento bíblico, enriquecer sua vida espiritual e inspirar sua jornada cristã. Baixe agora e transforme sua experiência de leitura da Bíblia com a "Bíblia King James Atualizada".
Sumando todas estas características y funcionalidades, la "Bíblia King James Atualizada" se establece no solo como una aplicación de lectura bíblica, sino como un verdadero compañero en su jornada de fe. Invitamos a todos los creyentes, estudiosos y buscadores espirituales a descargar la Bíblia KJA y a descubrir por sí mismos cómo puede transformar su estudio de la palabra de Dios y enriquecer su vida espiritual.

bluejetty:00089138:ios.description:
Browse our extensive catalog with 100s of professionally engineered mixes:
- Noise Colors: white noise, brown noise, green noise, pink noise and more…
- Nature Sounds: rain sounds, nature sounds, forest sounds, insects and more…
- Ambient Sounds: fan sounds, airplanes, crowds, machines and more…
From the creator of the most downloaded sound machine Podcast in the world, “12 Hour Sound Machines”, Dwellspring was created to help you easily find peaceful moments. We provide essential tools that put a world of relaxing sounds at your fingertips, empowering you to reclaim your rest.
Explore professionally engineered mixes, join a supportive community sharing their own creations, and craft your personal sound sanctuary.
Perfect for:
- Sleep
- Soothing Babies
- Sound masking
- Managing Anxiety
- Work and concentration
- Meditation
- ADHD
- Autism
Download any mix for offline listening. No need for an internet signal to access anything saved to your Library!
Do you fall asleep with a certain bedroom fan or drown out distractions with a trusty vacuum cleaner? Record them using the app, add them into your mixes, and take them with you wherever you are.
Share your mixes in the Creator Exchange or browse custom mixes from our community of Creators. Discover popular mixes by searching what’s most listened to, or search for sounds that speak to you and save them for later listening, either online or offline.
Noise Colors and research-backed Binaural Beats generators are proven to enhance the depth of your sleep, increase restoration and relaxation, boost meditative states, and foster undistracted focus. Adjust the frequency and find your favorite sounds based on their benefits.
SOUND MACHINE MIXER
- Sounds for You: Blend our expertly crafted sounds with your own recordings, Creator Mixes, and more.
- Perfected Soundscapes: Layer beats and recordings with other mixes, music, and sounds for a truly personalized experience.
- Create Your Mix: Fine-tune your mix for blissful sleep, distraction-free focus, or meditative calm.
NOISE COLOR & BINAURAL BEAT GENERATORS
- Explore world-renowned noise colors and science-backed Binaural Beats.
- Customized Soundscapes: Adjust the noise color frequencies to create a personalized balance.
- Focus Your Comfort Zone: Soothing Binaural Beats target specific brain states to enhance focus, productivity, creativity, and more.
CREATOR EXCHANGE
- Join a Community of Creators: Discover popular mixes by filtering the most listened-to mixes from other Creators.
- Save and Share Your Creations: Publish your mixes and help fellow rest-seekers find their peace.
- Amplify the Power of Sound: Cultivate a community dedicated to offering accessible self-care to a world that desperately needs it.
OFFLINE LISTENING
- Find Peace Anywhere: Save your favorite mixes to your personal Library.
- Unplug and Unwind: Listen without an internet connection and enjoy unwavering reliability (and peace of mind) no matter where you are.
INSTAREST
- Calm at Your Fingertips: Set your mix, timer and alarm preferences with a single tap.
- Your Peace Begins Now: Immerse yourself in your favorite mix the moment you need it.
Download Dwellspring today to craft your sound sanctuary and make serenity a daily habit. 
Access all features and content by subscribing to Dwellspring Premium. Subscriptions start at $9.99 per month and $59.99 per year. Subscriptions automatically renew through iTunes unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription & auto-renewal may be turned off via iTunes after purchase.
Terms & Conditions: https://dwellspring.io/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://dwellspring.io/privacy-policy/

Setlists from every gig

- Music lovers who discover new songs through live performances
Download now and turn every live show into a playlist.

bluejetty:00037404:ios.description:
Doviesfitness app is the best fitness app for anyone who wants to work out at home or at the gym. With Doviesfitness app, you can choose from hundreds of workouts for all levels and goals, or create your own with our easy-to-use tools. You can also follow our diet plans for different lifestyles and preferences, and track your progress with our workout log feature. Plus, you can enjoy 4K Ultra HD videos, download workouts for offline use, and cast them to your TV.
With Doviesfitness app, you can:
• Access over 1800+ exercise videos to show you how to perform each exercise correctly and safely.
• Choose from over 300 workouts for cardio, abs, back, chest, arms, legs, and more. You can also customize any workout or create your own from scratch.
• Follow monthly workout plans for weight loss, toning, or muscle gains. Each plan is designed to help you reach your goals in 60 to 90 days.
• Follow diet plans for vegan, pescatarian, ketogenic, and more. 
• Track your workouts and see your progress over time with our workout log feature.
• Enjoy 4K Ultra HD on-demand workouts for a stunning viewing experience.
• Download your workouts and watch them anywhere with our offline mode.
• Stream your workouts to a bigger screen with our TV casting option.
Doviesfitness app is free to download and try. You can access some free workouts and exercises to get a taste of what the app offers. To unlock all the features, you will need to subscribe. We offer one month, three months, and yearly subscriptions. The price will vary depending on your country and will be displayed in the app. All subscriptions are auto-renewed. You can cancel the auto-renewal anytime through the iTunes account settings. Check our terms and conditions to find out more about subscription.
Doviesfitness app is more than just an app. It's a community of people who share the same passion for fitness and health. Our goal is to help you achieve the lifestyle you deserve. Join us today and start your fitness journey with Doviesfitness app!

bluejetty:00062693:ios.name: Snoring: Elephant logic puzzle
bluejetty:00062693:ios.summary:
Snoring: Elephant puzzle - a fun and tricky physics brain teaser game!
Get ready for one of the funniest logic games you’ll ever play! In Snoring: Elephant puzzle, you’ll go on a delightful adventure to wake up a lovable, sleepy elephant wi
bluejetty:00062693:ios.description:
Snoring: Elephant puzzle - a fun and tricky physics brain teaser game!
Get ready for one of the funniest logic games you’ll ever play! In Snoring: Elephant puzzle, you’ll go on a delightful adventure to wake up a lovable, sleepy elephant with the help of adorable animal friends!
His adorable friends - like the owl, penguin, cow, giraffe, and zebra - are counting on you to help them enjoy some peaceful rest! But they need your help!
This brain-teasing puzzle game is packed with smart and silly moments. It’s a mix of logic puzzles, funny characters, and physics-based challenges that make you think in creative ways. If you enjoy brain teasers and love animals, this is the perfect relaxing game for you!
Why You’ll Love It?
- Tons of fun levels full of tricky physics puzzles
- Travel through cool worlds like the jungle, wild west, and even Viking lands or cosmos
- Meet adorable animals, each with their own moves
- Simple to play but gets smarter as you go
- Great for building your logical skills and quiz-solving skills
- Play with friends or family - fun for all ages
- Cute graphics and happy music to make you smile.
A lovable bunch of adorable, cuddly animals are dreaming of a peaceful, cozy night - but their big, friendly elephant buddy is snoring joyfully and dreaming up a storm! Now it’s up to them - and you - to find fun and smart ways to wake him up. Use each animal’s special move, think ahead, and figure out the best way to solve the logic puzzle on each level.
How to Play:
It’s easy to start! Just tap, roll, or bounce the animals into action!
Move blocks, tilt platforms, and set off fun chain reactions to solve the puzzle. You’ll need to use your brain and test your timing to beat each level. The more you play, the trickier the puzzles get. It’s a great way to test your skills and enjoy a new kind of puzzle solving experience.
This funny and clever logic game is perfect for fans of smart games, cute characters, and fun challenges. If you like games that exercise your brain, you’ll love this one!
Download Snoring: Elephant puzzle now and join the adventure. Wake up the snoring elephant and help the animals finally get some sleep!

bluejetty:00146871:ios.description:
NewForm is the only free recovery support app that helps you build a joyful, connected life in sobriety and recovery. 
Join nearly 500,000 people who are redefining what recovery looks like. This sober community app connects you to a full spectrum of free sober experiences: in-person meetups, virtual support groups, creative workshops, fitness events, safe discussion spaces, all powered by trusted recovery organizations with peer support at the core. Whether you're sober-curious, already deep into your recovery journey, or anywhere in between, NewForm makes it easy to explore recovery your way, with no pressure, no fees, and no judgment.
WHY NEWFORM?
- Join supportive sober groups and communities that feel like home, with opportunities for real connection both on and off the app

bluejetty:00035639:ios.name: My Forge Shop: Sim Supermarket
bluejetty:00035639:ios.summary: Welcome to Forge Shop, It has been six months since the zombie apocalypse began. As a survivor, you have the opportunity to build your very own blacksmith shop where you can craft and sell a wide array of equipment. Your skills as a blacksm
bluejetty:00035639:ios.description:
Welcome to Forge Shop, It has been six months since the zombie apocalypse began. As a survivor, you have the opportunity to build your very own blacksmith shop where you can craft and sell a wide array of equipment. Your skills as a blacksmith will be vital for survival, so get ready to thrive in this chaotic world!
Build Your Forge Shop
Start by constructing your forge shop from the ground up. Upgrade and expand it to accommodate more workstations, research stations, and storage space for precious resources. The better your shop, the more advanced equipment you can create!
Craft and Sell Various Equipment
Use your blacksmithing skills to craft all sorts of essential gear, weapons, and armor. From basic tools to powerful weapons, your creations will be crucial for adventurers in their fight against the undead. Price your items strategically to maximize your profits!
Research New Equipment
Stay ahead of the competition by researching and developing cutting-edge equipment. Unlock blueprints and discover new designs to create even more powerful gear. Your innovation and expertise will attract adventurers seeking the best equipment to survive the zombie-infested city.
Haggle with Adventurers
Interact with wandering adventurers and negotiate prices for your equipment. Persuade them to pay more for your top-notch items, or offer discounts to build customer loyalty. Clever haggling will earn you better profits and a reputation as a skilled blacksmith.
Recruit Adventurers and Heroes
Assemble a team of brave adventurers and heroes to explore the zombie-infested city. Send them on dangerous quests to collect rare resources needed for crafting advanced equipment. The better your team, the more valuable resources they can bring back to your forge.
Trade and Interact with Other Players
Forge Shop is not just about surviving alone; it's also about collaboration! Interact with other players, join guilds, and trade equipment with fellow blacksmiths. Team up with others to fend off zombie hordes and share resources for mutual benefit.
It's time to sharpen your skills, face the zombie, and make a name for yourself as the most renowned blacksmith in the zombie apocalypse. Forge your destiny, create legendary equipment, and become a beacon of hope for all survivors in Forge Shop!
This app includes the following subscription options:
- VIP MERCHANT，Monthly($9.99)
- After the subscription, you can get vip benefits, include repair items with gold; extra vip rewards；+10% gems from packs; get better deals in lucky zone!
- Free trial subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://support.myjoymore.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://support.myjoymore.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00179226:ios.summary:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless file drive. Phone Drive Pro helps you transfer files to your computer, organize documents and media, read PDFs and play music in one app.
TRANSFER FILES OVER WI-FI
Move files between Phone Drive Pro
bluejetty:00179226:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless file drive. Phone Drive Pro helps you transfer files to your computer, organize documents and media, read PDFs and play music in one app.
TRANSFER FILES OVER WI-FI
Move files between Phone Drive Pro and your Mac or Windows PC over the same Wi-Fi network. Start the transfer feature in the app and open its address in your computer's web browser. Upload and download files without a USB cable or separate desktop app.
ORGANIZE YOUR FILES
Create folders for projects, work documents, photos and music. Copy, move, rename, delete and share files. ZIP related files together or unzip an archive you receive. Keep local files in Phone Drive Pro available for offline access.
READ DOCUMENTS AND EDIT TEXT
Open PDFs and preview supported Microsoft Office and iWork documents, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers and Keynote files. View images, create text files and edit plain text or source code.
ENJOY YOUR MUSIC AND VIDEOS
Build playlists from your own audio files and listen with shuffle, repeat and background playback. Watch supported videos and stream compatible music or video from connected cloud storage.
CONNECT CLOUD ACCOUNTS AND SERVERS
Access supported Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, iCloud Drive and Yandex Disk accounts, plus FTP and WebDAV servers. Browse connected storage and move files between supported locations. Cloud connections require additional in-app purchases.
PROTECT ACCESS TO THE APP
Set a passcode and use Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices to restrict access to Phone Drive Pro.
KEEP USEFUL FILES CLOSE
Carry reference documents to a meeting, organize photos from your library or keep PDFs and music ready for a trip. Use your iPhone or iPad as a place to store, open and manage the files you need.
Phone Drive Pro is the paid edition of Phone Drive. Optional cloud connections are sold separately through in-app purchases.
For local Wi-Fi transfers, keep the app open and your device awake until the transfer finishes. Cloud services require an internet connection and a supported account.
Learn more: https://sixbytes.io/products/phone-drive
Privacy Policy: https://sixbytes.io/products/phone-drive/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sixbytes.io/products/phone-drive/legal/terms

bluejetty:00171018:ios.description:
Engaing, innovative, minimal puzzle game with dozens of levels.
The aim is simple: you need to move through the field and pickup all the circles. The problem is they are visible only on one of two colors – that's why you should use toggles to switch the light. 
*** How to play ***
The design is simple and there are different levels. A color line will enter in the field made of squares. The user needs to drag the line to collect the circles appear in that field. After collecting all the circles you need to exit from the field. After that, you will be on next level. You can also shift the line backward side. Gather all the circles and pass on next level. 
*** Features ***
• 88 unique levels
• Easy to play to refresh mind
• No target based labyrinth game 
• Simple & user-friendly design
• You can mute sound & music in the setting option
• Labyrinth game with lots of different levels
• Relaxing sound and music 
Play btw and become great witness in the route game.

One against the galaxy! Overspace is a fast-paced top-down shooter with deep RPG elements, where your reflexes and strategy are the only keys to survival. The crew of Starship 117 is missing, and you're the last Spartan who can stop the alien invasion. Endless waves of aliens and undead are coming. Your mission is pure action and an adventure to save humanity.
You'll battle through survival arenas packed with monster hordes. Upgrade your hero, enhance futuristic weapons and combat drones, building an unstoppable war machine. Every fight tests your skills in this shooter, and every win earns resources for upgrades.
GAME FEATURES:
• Intense top-down action: Lightning-fast battles with an overhead view, true to the classic top-down shooter style.
• Deep RPG progression: Boost your damage, armor, speed, and unique abilities. Create your own combat style!
• Endless survival: Face thousands of aliens and epic bosses across diverse arenas.
• Powerful arsenal: From plasma rifles to gravity saws – dozens of weapons to vaporize enemy swarms.
• Play offline: Enjoy the action and adventure anytime, anywhere.
• Immersive universe: Explore derelict colonies, asteroid fields, and infested stations with stunning graphics.
BECOME A LEGEND:
This is more than a shooter – it's a tactical RPG survival test. Simple one-touch controls and auto-shoot let you focus on tactics and dodging. Craft the ultimate loadout, discover enemy weak points, and become humanity's last hope in this cosmic saga.
Ready for combat? Overspace is waiting – a shooter, action RPG, and survival challenge rolled into one.
Download now and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00149326:ios.name: Trails LA County
bluejetty:00149326:ios.summary: From the desert to the mountains and to the sea, Trails LA County is the official trail guide to hundreds of miles of public multi-use trails across Los Angeles County. Featuring accurate, updated trail maps, Trails LA County shows you wher
bluejetty:00149326:ios.description:
From the desert to the mountains and to the sea, Trails LA County is the official trail guide to hundreds of miles of public multi-use trails across Los Angeles County. Featuring accurate, updated trail maps, Trails LA County shows you where you are on the trail and guides you along your journey.
Trails LA County includes maps of trails, maps of regional parks and open spaces, curated outings, beautiful photographs, succinct descriptions, and helpful information. Trails LA County will help you enjoy the beautiful trails and diverse landscapes offered throughout the County with confidence that you are on the right path!
Trails LA County was created by the Los Angeles County Department of Parks and Recreation in collaboration with the United States National Park Service, California State Parks, Mountains Recreation Conservation Authority, Mountains Restoration Trust, and the Catalina Island Conservancy.
# Features
- GPS shows where you are while out on the trail
- Accurate maps of more than 500 miles of public, multi-use trails
- Curated outings
- Beautiful landscape photography
- Pertinent trail use information
- Succinct trail descriptions
- Information about outdoor events
- Partner organization information
Please contact LA County Department of Parks and Recreation Trails Planning at trails@parks.lacounty.gov with any questions about Trails LA County.
(This app uses background location to let you know when you're approaching a task location for challenges you're participating in. Continued use of background location may decrease battery life.)

bluejetty:00015594:ios.description:
Welcome to Pocket Worlds!
EARLY-LEARNING ACTIVITIES
• Build foundational skills with games featuring numbers, counting, colors, shapes, matching, sorting, and stacking.
100% AD-FREE
• No banners, video ads, or third-party advertising.
KID-FRIENDLY DESIGN
• Simple controls and clear navigation help children explore and play independently.
COLORFUL ART AND VOICE-OVER
• Friendly narration, engaging sounds, and positive reinforcement make learning welcoming and rewarding.
CREATIVE COLORING
• Each world includes coloring pages, stickers, and scenes that encourage creativity and imaginative play.
---
** Start with Party World **
Pocket Worlds includes Party World, a collection of nine birthday-themed activities. Children can practice counting, shape sorting, color sorting, matching, stacking, and other early-learning skills.
** Discover More Worlds **
Expand the adventure with School World, Ocean World, and Zoo World, available through in-app purchase. Each world includes nine additional games, along with new coloring pages, stickers, and scenes.
Pocket Worlds was created by parents who wanted a safe, polished, and genuinely enjoyable learning experience for young children. That commitment helped Pocket Worlds earn a Parents’ Choice Award.
Questions or Feedback?
• Feedback: feedback@tuxedogames.com
• Customer support: support@tuxedogames.com
• Privacy policy: https://www.tuxedogames.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00073424:ios.name: Ovia Cycle & Pregnancy Tracker
bluejetty:00073424:ios.summary: At Ovia Health by Labcorp, we’re here to empower women at every stage of their health journey—from your period through fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, perimenopause, menopause, and beyond. With personalized tools and data-driven insigh
bluejetty:00073424:ios.description:
At Ovia Health by Labcorp, we’re here to empower women at every stage of their health journey—from your period through fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, perimenopause, menopause, and beyond. With personalized tools and data-driven insights, Ovia empowers women to make informed decisions and access the care they need, whenever they need it.
Whether you're tracking your period, trying to get pregnant, monitoring your pregnancy, recovering postpartum, navigating perimenopause, or tracking your health, join millions of Ovia users.
Consistently rated one of the best women’s health apps, Ovia helps you stay on top of all your women’s health needs – in one trusted place! 
YOUR HEALTH IN YOUR HANDS
◆ Personalized email summaries and reminders to help you make the most of your experience and manage your health
◆ Period & Fertility calendar - Fertility forecasting algorithm predicts your fertility windows & ovulation cycles.
◆ Pregnancy - Baby growth calendar, due date countdown, bump and fetal movement tracker, and more. Watch your baby grow, track your symptoms, and learn what to expect each week.
◆ Postpartum Experience - personalized recovery modes based on delivery (vaginal, c-section, VBAC), symptom tracking, and more.
◆ Perimenopause & Menopause support - comprehensive health tracking for real-time alerts & personalized feedback.
◆ Access over 2,000 free expert articles on fertility, ovulation, conception, postpartum, menopause & reproductive health.
OVULATION CALCULATOR & FERTILITY TRACKER
◆ Fertile window and ovulation time predictions & a daily fertility score. An ovulation app that helps you know when you’re ovulating when trying to conceive (TTC).
PERIOD AND MENSTRUAL CYCLE TRACKER
◆ A period tracker with customizable data logging including symptoms, moods, sex, and nutrition.
◆ Support for regular & irregular menstrual cycles.
◆ Birth control tracking
PREGNANCY & POSTPARTUM
◆ A personalized, 12-month program focused on birth recovery, postpartum conditions and complications, reproductive planning, return to work support, mental health, & more.
PERIMENOPAUSE & MENOPAUSE SUPPORT
◆ Symptom and mood tracking, education, and support to navigate perimenopause & menopause confidently.
STAY UP TO DATE ON YOUR PREGNANCY WITH ESSENTIALS
◆ Pregnancy Week by Week: Know what to expect each week with a baby due date countdown and weekly videos and content about pregnancy symptoms, body changes, & baby tips.
◆ Pregnancy Tracker & Baby Growth Calendar: Compare your baby’s weekly size to a fruit, toy, pastry item, or animal. View 3D illustrations of your baby each week & track baby’s growth.
◆ My Baby Names: Swipe through thousands of baby names. Save your favorites.
◆ Baby Hand & Foot Size: See a life-size image of how big your baby's hands and feet are today compared to how big they'll be at your due date!
◆ Bump Tracker: Keep a record of your growing baby bump.
◆ Safety Lookup Tools: Use lookup tools for symptoms & food safety.
◆ Kick Counter & Contraction Timer: Count baby kicks & contractions as your due date approaches.
OTHER FEATURES OUR MEMBERS LOVE
◆ Friends & Family Sharing: Add your spouse, partner, sibling, or your BFF to share your daily updates.
◆ Privacy & Security: Add an extra layer of protection by adding a PIN to your account.
◆ Apple Health & Fitbit Integrations: Share data from Ovia to the Apple Health app. Sync your Fitbit to share steps, sleep & weight with Ovia.
OVIA HEALTH BY LABCORP
Ovia Health by Labcorp is the leading digital health companion for women across their entire health journey, from general and preventive health through perimenopause and menopause.
Have Ovia Health by Labcorp through your employer or health plan? Download the app, enter your plan info, and access premium tools like health coaching, personalized content, and programs for birth control tracking, endometriosis, PCOS, & more.
CUSTOMER SERVICE
We're always working to improve your experience. Email us: support@oviahealth.com

bluejetty:00017114:ios.description:
From the makers of the Persona series, Shin Megami Tensei Liberation Dx2 is the latest entry in the three-decade-long Megami Tensei video game franchise; bringing its dark themes, thrilling battles and mysterious storylines to life, to mobile platforms!
Take on the role of a Devil Downloader, also known as a Dx2.
Dx2s are able to summon and command demons using a special smartphone app.
Led by a mysterious man, you gain access to this special app and become a member of the Liberators, a secret organization that fights to protect the world from an opposing faction of Dx2s.
The enemy is known only as the Acolytes.
Driven by their own ideology, the Acolytes abuse their demon-summoning capabilities to wreak chaos, and are secretly eliminating people with high empathy quotients (EQ) who pose a threat to their goals.
Pick up your smartphones and join us in this quest to protect the world from the evil Acolytes!
Classic gameplay
- Summon and Fuse new demons.
- Press Turn battle system.
- Collect, Enhance, and Evolve demons; customize your Party, and apply different tactics to defeat your opponents.
Massive collection of demons
- Over 160 unique demons from the original series.
- High quality 3D graphics brings demons to life like never before!
- Each demon has its own skills. Transfer skills, and take advantage of each demon’s strengths to win in battles against tough opponents!
Augmented Reality Ready
- View demons in 360-degrees with the Augmented Reality mode.
- Pose and take pictures with your favorite demons!
Optimized for mobile with new game elements
- Enhance, Evolve and Awaken different Archetypes to form a formidable party!
- Battle Assist feature allows you to lend a hand to fellow Liberators in battle, and allows others to help you.
- Auto-battle and Speed Up mode for more play in less time.
Feature-packed for hours of fun!
- Deep JRPG storytelling. Explore modern Tokyo, including places such as Akihabara, Shinjuku and Kudanshita.
- Investigate the Aura Gate to find valuable materials.
- Participate in seasonal events and win rewards that can make your team stronger.
- Challenge other players in the PVP “Dx2 Duel” mode.
- Summon and interact with demons in real life with the new AR function: Demon Scanner!
Japanese voice acting
- Turn on the sound for the full Shin Megami Tensei experience, complete with vivid narrations by the original Japanese cast!
Developer: SEGA
Original Work: ATLUS
Script: Makoto Fukami
Character Design: Tatsuro Iwamoto
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/d2megaten.official/
Official Website: https://d2-megaten-l.jp/en

bluejetty:00043977:ios.description:
Interview Pilot is the top ranked AI Interview Assistant, trusted by 450,000+ users to help you move from job search to interview day with more preparation and confidence. Discover jobs, prepare with real interview questions, practice with an AI interviewer, and get personalized guidance during conversations. It is all in one app.
INTERVIEW GUIDANCE
Get personalized support for your interviews. Interview Pilot can listen for questions and suggest relevant ways to structure your response, drawing on your experience, resume, target role, and company details. Use Conversation Mode for a flowing discussion or Question Mode for focused Q&A. Customize your response style and instructions to make the guidance your own.
MOCK INTERVIEWS & FEEDBACK
Rehearse with an AI interviewer before the real conversation. Practice speaking through your answers, then review a detailed evaluation covering relevance, structure, depth, delivery, and more. Revisit your transcript, see what worked, and identify specific ways to improve.
10,000+ INTERVIEW QUESTIONS
Prepare with a curated question bank spanning companies, roles, and difficulty levels. Explore behavioral, technical, and role-specific questions, practice at your own pace, and save questions to revisit.
1M+ JOBS & COMPANY RESEARCH
Explore 1M+ jobs and narrow your search by role, location, and work preferences. Review job details, explore company profiles, and find relevant interview questions as you prepare to apply. Bookmark opportunities and export your saved jobs when you need them.
CAREER RESOURCES
Find practical guides, resume templates, and email templates to support every step around the interview.
MADE FOR YOUR WORKFLOW
• Personalized guidance using your resume, background, and job details
• Support for 99+ languages and any accents
• Image and coding support
• Apple Watch and external Bluetooth keyboard support
• Interview history and saved sessions
From finding the right role to preparing your next answer, Interview Pilot helps you move forward with confidence.

bluejetty:00042153:ios.description:
Haggen Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Haggen’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Haggen for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Haggen locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Haggen app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00128852:ios.description:
Live free in the Sun! An elegant and modern solution for showing the Sunrise, Sunset, First and Last Light times to the exact minute for precisely where YOU are right now - not the "closest" city. The app also shows exactly how much daylight is left in the day - in a large, easy to read display - so you can plan ahead to the last ray of sunlight. Download it now.
It shows: 
• Sunrise time 
• Sunset time 
• First Light time (Dawn) 
• Last Light time (Twilight)
• A full Sun Events timeline: astronomical, nautical and civil twilight times, solar noon, and the current time moving through the day (Premium)
• Converts timezones for foreign locations
• Counts down the amount of daylight left in the day until last light 
• At night, counts down the time left until the first light of the new day 
• Counts down days, hours and minutes left until the shortest and longest days 
• Dates of the equinox and solstice 
• Times of the equinox and solstice for premium users
• Many widgets available
• Very accurate timezone conversion and handling, local times anywhere in the world
• Correct handling of locations where the sun may not rise or set
• See the Sunrise, Sunset, First and Last light times for any day in the future. 
• Length of daylight for today - or any day in the future.
• Percentage of the day or night completed.
• Correctly handles Daylight Saving times. 
• GPS access is not required.
• Landscape support on iPad.
An indispensable tool for those who don't want to waste a moment of the day - or the night! 
• We wrote this app for ourselves, but love sharing it and getting your positive feedback. Visit our support site to give us feedback - thank you in advance for your great ratings and reviews :)

bluejetty:00018336:ios.description:
Stop guessing what you made — or what you'll make.
ServerLife is a powerful Tip Tracker and Income Tracker built for tipped and commission-based workers who want to clearly see their real take-home pay — shift by shift.
Over 750,000 workers have used ServerLife to log more than 65 million income entries and understand exactly where their money comes from.
If your income changes week to week, ServerLife brings clarity.
Built for Variable Income
Perfect for:
• Servers & Bartenders
• Gaming Dealers
• Uber, Lyft & Delivery Drivers
• Shipt & Instacart Shoppers
• Stylists, Barbers & Makeup Artists
• Fitness & Yoga Instructors
• Commission Sales
• Freelancers & Independent Contractors
• Self-Employed Workers
If you earn tips, commissions, or shift-based income — ServerLife helps you track it all.
Track Your Shifts in Seconds
Log your earnings at the end of your shift and instantly see:
• Total earnings
• Hourly averages
• Weekly & monthly totals
• Your best-paying days
• Income trends over time
No more mental math. No more guessing if it was a "good week."
Free Features
• Track tips
• Track hours
• Add notes
• Daily, weekly, monthly & yearly totals
• Custom pay week start
• Entry reminders
• Income forecasting — see your projected month-end total based on your own shift history
ServerLife makes it simple to stay consistent and build a clear record of your earnings.
Know What You'll Make Before the Month Ends
ServerLife's Forecasting tab uses your last 90 days of shifts to predict what you're likely to earn for the rest of the month — based entirely on your own patterns, not industry averages.
• See how much you've earned so far and what's projected for the rest of the month
• Understand your average earnings and how often you work each day of the week
• Confidence level shows how reliable your estimate is as your history grows
The more you log, the smarter your forecast gets.
Upgrade to Premium for Advanced Income Tracking
Unlock deeper insight and powerful comparison tools:
• Forecast range — see a realistic earnings spread, not just a single number
• What-if scenarios — find out what picking up an extra shift would add to your month
• Goal check — see how many shifts you'd need to hit your monthly target
• Separate Cash & Credit tips
• Service charges
• Tip Out & Tip In
• Hourly wages
• Sales totals & Tip %
• Covers & sales per cover
• Expenses
• Work schedule
• Multiple jobs & positions
• Goals & progress tracking
• Mileage & delivery fees
• Shift, job & role comparisons
• Advanced filtering
See which shifts, sections, or roles make you the most money — and plan smarter.
Built for Real Workers
Cash income is easy to spend and hard to measure. ServerLife gives you a clear, organized view of your earnings so you can make better financial decisions with confidence.
Safe & Secure
Your data is securely backed up to the cloud automatically.
Switch phones? Nothing is lost.
Access your income history anytime across devices.
ServerLife — The Tip Tracker trusted by over 750,000 workers.

Dive into a world brimming with vibrant images, challenging levels, and exciting gameplay modes. Whether you're a seasoned puzzle master or a casual gamer, this game will captivate and challenge you at every turn. Ready to become the ultimate tiles master?
How to Play：
● Match Pairs: Find two identical tiles without any blocks between them.
● Connect Tiles: Tap the tiles to link them with up to three straight lines.
● Use Tools: Stuck? Use hints, shuffles, bombs, and skips to progress.
● Beat the Timer: Clear all tiles within the time limit to advance.
● Level Up: Pass levels to earn stars and become a tiles master. Compete with friends to see who’s the best!

● Variety of Tiles: Fresh fruits, beautiful flowers, colorful butterflies, world flags, delicious foods, festive Christmas designs, and over 20+ unique patterns.
● Stunning Themes: Unlock over 30+ beautiful scenes like Space and Field.
● Thousands of Levels: New, exciting levels. Never run out of fun!
Powerful Tools：
● Search: Quickly find one pair.
● Exchange: Rearrange the tile matrix.
● Changing Pictures: Swap out entire categories of tiles for a new look.
Brain Training：
Enhance focus and concentration with engaging gameplay. Perfect for players of all ages!

From playing a single note to complete pieces, Piano Maestro hel
bluejetty:00120464:ios.description:
Piano Maestro is a fun and engaging piano practice tool for families and teachers. Chosen by Apple as #1 Education App in over 20 countries. Works with any piano or keyboard.
From playing a single note to complete pieces, Piano Maestro helps your student master sight-reading, rhythm, technique and playing with both hands to make sheet music come to life. Fun piano learning for the entire family with positive screen time!
What is included:
- Journey - progress by chapters, rising in difficulty level. Collect SKILL POINTS as you play
- Library - over 2,800 songs & exercises according to level or genre for songs or by exercise type. From classical, pop, rock, TV & movie songs and themes all songs have fun background music
- Method Books - tons of lesson books from leading publishers like Hal Leonard
- Receive a 3-star score after mastering rhythm, timing and sight-reading
- Practice options to learn songs step-by-step to personalize your learning experience
How it works:
- Download Piano Maestro to your iPad, place it on your piano/keyboard and the app will immediately recognize what you are playing!
- Get instant feedback on your playing to quickly learn and improve your skills
- No piano? No problem! TOUCH MODE also available
Piano teachers:
Created by music educators, Piano Maestro is used as a resource in lessons by tens of thousands of piano teachers worldwide. Includes many teacher management features, reports and a Home Challenge Center to easily assign and assess homework to increase practice time between lessons, helping students learn faster. Join our thriving Piano Maestro Teachers community on Facebook to get ideas on how to use Piano Maestro in your lessons and to connect with other like-minded teachers.
“This is the kind of app that if I could get in the hands of every single student, I would!”
How the subscription works:
All app users can play several free skill levels. Upgrade to a subscription package at any time
- Subscribers will receive FULL access to the entire app including all pop songs, method books and other licensed content. New content added every month!
Choose from one of the following subscription options.
Parents and students learning without a teacher:
- Monthly recurring subscription for $9.99/month
- Recurring yearly subscription for $59.99/year
Teachers:
- My Studio: full access to all content, for $12.99/month or $9.99/month (annual)
- Studio+Home: Unlocks everything for you and ALL your students, for $19.99/month or $14.99/month (annual)
- All recurring subscriptions will auto-renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings
- Your subscription is for your iTunes account and can be used on your iOS device
- Payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active subscription period
Piano Maestro is developed by Simply (formerly JoyTunes), creators of award-winning apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar and Simply Sing. Created by music educators, the apps are used by tens of thousands of music teachers worldwide with over 1 million songs learned every week. Simply are experts in creating educational and fun music apps for learning piano quickly and easily.
Awards & Recognition:
- "EMI’s Innovation Challenge”
- "World Summit Award", by the United Nations
- “Best Tools for Beginners”, NAMM
- "Best Tablet Game", GameIS
- “Parents' Choice Award”
- “Golden App”, Apps for Homeschooling
Have questions, feedback or suggestions? Reach out to us at education@hellosimply.com
Enjoy Playing!

bluejetty:00123727:ios.description:
The smash-hit idle clicker where you mine virtual bitcoins to amass a simulated fortune!
Bitcoin Billionaire is an idle mining game that's all about earning virtual bitcoins through fast tapping, smart investments, and cool upgrades. Go from rags to riches as you upgrade and unlock new items and time travel to the distant past and the far future, all without leaving your comfy chair!
In Bitcoin Billionaire you start with almost nothing: a run-down office, a rickety old desk, and a terrible computer. By tapping the screen you can mine virtual bitcoins to slowly increase your wealth. Spend your earnings on fancy things like entertainment centers and priceless works of art, or upgrade your mining equipment to earn more with each tap. If you're smart, you'll use some of those bitcoins to invest in new technologies that help you earn even when you're not playing!
Just when you think you've seen it all, Bitcoin Billionaire sends you hurtling through time and space. Travel to new eras where you'll earn all new upgrades, unlock extra achievements, and experience the thrills of bitcoin mining from a whole new perspective. If you thought tapping was fun in a modern-day office chair, just wait 'til you park your posterior in a finely crafted stone seat from prehistoric times!
Features:
-Upgrade investments to earn bitcoins while offline.
-Grab bonuses from hovering delivery drones.
-Customize your character to mine in style.
-Free holiday updates and extras.
-Adopt a kitty! Or a robot! Or a T-Rex! Or something else!
Bitcoin Billionaire is an idle mining game that's fun for everyone. Seriously, everyone can play it, you don't have to know anything about bitcoins or mining. If you can tap, you can earn, and if you can earn, you can upgrade all of the things. Now quick, sit down and start tapping!
Note: This game is for entertainment purposes only. You do not mine real bitcoins. You will, however, feel like a billionaire when you finally unlock those expensive upgrades.

bluejetty:00092300:ios.name: Aventon: MyRide
bluejetty:00092300:ios.summary:
The Aventon app allows ebike riders to record and track their bike rides, receive milestone medals, connect with other Aventon ebike riders and more!
CONNECT WITH YOUR AVENTON EBIKE:
The Aventon app easily connects with your Aventon ebike
bluejetty:00092300:ios.description:
The Aventon app allows ebike riders to record and track their bike rides, receive milestone medals, connect with other Aventon ebike riders and more!
CONNECT WITH YOUR AVENTON EBIKE:
The Aventon app easily connects with your Aventon ebike color display by using your mobile device camera to scan a unique QR code on the display. Pairing with the Aventon app with the Aventon visual display enables tracking capabilities, awards, metrics and more.
RIDE RECORD KEEPING:
Keep a detailed record of all your ebike rides with data such as calorie burn, cycling time, distance traveled and more. View how you’ve progressed over time by viewing ride data by day, month and year. Understand the environmental impact you’ve had by riding your ebike instead of a gas powered vehicle. 
FRIENDLY COMPETITION:
View how you rank with other riders and start a little friendly competition amongst other Aventon riders on who has cycled the furthest. Watch yourself rise through the ranks by day, week, month or total ride distance and share your progress.
RIDE TRACKING:
Start tracking and mapping your rides in real time while receiving valuable insights such as:
• Max Speed
• Average Speed
• Trip
• CO2 Reduced
• Time
• Calories burned
• Elevation
• And more
CONNECT & SHARE:
With the discover feature, you can be a part of the broader Aventon community by updating your profile and sharing updates along with images of you on your rides. Browse through other Aventon riders’ posts as they share their travels and connect by liking and commenting. 
REACHING MILESTONES:
Get notified when you have reached major milestones in your riding. Receive medals for anything from riding your first 10 miles to when you’ve reached your 10,000th mile and many more. Challenge yourself to collect as many medals as possible!
AVENTON SERVICE:
• Get various services with the Aventon app.
• Get the help you need by reaching out to customer service
• Learn more about your Aventon ebike by accessing our FAQs
• Want to check out an Aventon ebike? Look for bike shops near you that carry Aventon Ebikes.

EasyFit will be your ultimate companion for achieving your fitness goals by offering a range of benefits:
- Simple and convenient design
- Stress-free programs unlike the traditional ones
- No equipment required
- Effective weight loss solutions
- Convenient chair and wall workouts
- Tailored for female fitness and getting fit
- Suitable to follow anytime, anywhere
- Variety of exercises for every fitness level
Say goodbye to the hassle of scheduling gym sessions or rushing to make it to a class on time. With EasyFit, you can enjoy lazy workouts from the comfort of your own home, whenever it suits your busy schedule. Whether you prefer to work out in the morning, during your lunch break, or before bed, our easy-to-follow routines fit seamlessly into your daily routine.
From gentle yet effective wall pilates to stress-reducing somatic exercises, EasyFit offers a diverse range of workouts to suit every fitness level and preference. Whether you're a beginner just starting your fitness journey or a seasoned yogi looking for a new challenge, our app has something for everyone. With options to target specific areas such as belly fat or to engage in chair yoga for seniors, EasyFit ensures that everyone can find a workout that suits their needs.
We’re also aware that female body’s needs are different from the male’s. EasyFit offers a range of gentle yet effective workouts designed specifically for the female body to empower women to prioritize their health and well-being. Whether you're looking to tone up, lose weight, or simply improve your overall fitness level, our carefully selected routines appeal to women's needs and preferences from every age.
With EasyFit, losing weight has never been easier. Our expertly designed workouts combine elements of yoga, pilates, and strength training to help you torch calories and burn fat effectively. Say goodbye to crash diets and extreme workouts – with EasyFit, sustainable weight loss is within reach.
Don't let the word "lazy" fool you – with EasyFit, lazy workouts are anything but ineffective. You can kickstart your day with a quick and easy workout, whether with gentle stretches or targeted strength training exercises, by simply using a chair or a wall. This will immediately set the tone for a productive day ahead.
Our app is designed to help you achieve your fitness goals with minimal effort and maximum results. Whether you're a busy mom, a working professional, or a retiree looking to stay active, EasyFit has everything you need to make fitness a seamless part of your daily routine.
Download EasyFit - Lazy Workout at Home now and discover a new approach to fitness that fits your lifestyle. Join the Lazy Workout Revolution!

We deliver everything y
bluejetty:00162630:ios.description:
Taxovichkof is a modern and convenient service for calling a taxi in St. Petersburg, Moscow, Astana, Tver, Tula, Omsk, Gatchina, Vsevolozhsk, Krasnoye Selo, Kolpino, Pushkino, Peterhof, Kronshtadt and other cities. 
We deliver everything you need!
You can send food, documents and any other small packages using option “Courier”. Delivery to the door is available.
∙ Runs are cheaper than the ones from operator 
Create an order in the app and save your money. Use the “My Rules” option and set your price for the run! Send your club number to friends and give them a discount on their first run. Earn tefics for their successfully completed orders. And don’t forget the promo codes. 
∙ Watch the movement of the driver 
Watch the car when ordered, and also share the route with friends so that they can see your movement. 
∙ Silent call in all circumstances 
Is there a lecture, are you afraid to wake your child or is it too noisy on the street? Ordering a taxi via the app will allow you to call for a car without saying a word
∙ Apple Pay, card or cash payment 
Now you do not need to look for the change in your wallet. Choose the appropriate payment method in the options when placing an order. 
∙ Pre-order 
Do you need to call a taxi to the airport or train station? Create an order in advance! Indicate the required date and time in the “Delivery time” section. Turn on the “Alarm” option so that the auto-informant calls and wakes you up. 
∙ Everything is automated 
The delivery address can be omitted if you allowed the app to determine the geolocation at the first start. The cost of the run, the time of delivery and travel time are calculated and displayed automatically. 
∙ Rate drivers 
View information about drivers, rate their service and influence the rating. 
∙ Do you often go to the same addresses? 
Use your favorite addresses and routes (for example, from home to work and from work to the fitness studio) so you don’t have to enter them manually each time. 
∙ Did you forget something in a taxi? 
Click on the “Help” section in the side menu on the left, select the run you need and fill in the information about the forgotten item. And we will promptly help in its return. 
∙ Call a car for a friend or colleague 
Order a taxi to the phone number of a friend or colleague using the “Other passenger” option. 
∙ Business taxi for legal entities 
Do you need corporate taxi services? Apply directly in the app or on the website. We will help your employees to always be on time, ensure a worthy meeting of guests or partners, bring your customers with comfort. We provide priority delivery of cars, a dedicated line of operators, a detailed account statement. 
Calling for a taxi in the Taxovichkof app takes place instantly, and low price will delight every customer! The functionality of the app differs depending on the city and the services provided by the partner service. The app is translated into English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Kazakh and Chinese.

bluejetty:00090415:ios.description:
Shape Tess's romances, friendships, and future in an anime-style otome game about travel, fashion, and influencer life.
Tess is ready to leave routine behind and see the world. Follow her from Bangkok and sunny Koh Samui to Seoul, Tokyo, and Kyoto as she begins a new life as a travel blogger. Every chapter brings new places, new feelings, and new decisions in this choice-driven visual novel and interactive romance story. You decide how Tess responds when love, ambition, and life in the public eye collide.
CHOOSE TESS'S STORY
Pick replies, guide Tess through emotional moments, and shape her relationships, career, and journey. Your choices influence who she trusts, who she grows closer to, and how the story unfolds.
FIND ROMANCE
Chat, flirt, go on dates, and get to know memorable characters with dreams, secrets, and feelings of their own. Follow the connections that feel right for Tess—from sweet attraction to complicated romance.
TRAVEL THE WORLD
Explore places inspired by Thailand, South Korea, and Japan. Discover local culture, food, beautiful scenery, and landmarks as Tess collects memories for TessTravels.
BUILD HER INFLUENCER CAREER
Take photos, create posts, react to fans, and grow Tess's online presence through in-game social apps. Experience both the excitement and the pressure of becoming a travel influencer.
DRESS FOR EVERY MOMENT
Choose outfits for dates, parties, photo shoots, travel days, and special events. Mix casual looks with glamorous dresses and accessories as Tess finds her own style.
MEET AN UNFORGETTABLE CAST
Friends, rivals, and love interests bring their own ambitions, emotions, and secrets. Some may become the people Tess can count on through fame, drama, creative dreams, and difficult choices.
PLAY THE MAIN STORY OFFLINE
Continue Tess's main story wherever you are—no Wi-Fi required.
Leave the expected path behind. Make choices that matter—and discover where Tess's heart will take her.
Note: Where's Tess is currently available in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Latin America), Russian, Vietnamese, Korean, and Indonesian.
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/whereistess
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/gm7JSspgGv
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/whereistesslovenotes/
Official X (Twitter): https://x.com/wherestessnotes

bluejetty:00166869:ios.name: Maui GyPSy Guide Driving Tour
bluejetty:00166869:ios.summary: Explore Maui’s stunning landscapes, vibrant culture, and hidden gems with just one easy download. Our GPS-triggered audio tour covers 8 unique routes and 465+ stories, guiding you through everything Maui offers—no expiry and no need for mul
bluejetty:00166869:ios.description:
Explore Maui’s stunning landscapes, vibrant culture, and hidden gems with just one easy download. Our GPS-triggered audio tour covers 8 unique routes and 465+ stories, guiding you through everything Maui offers—no expiry and no need for multiple downloads.
• Road to Hana Adventures
1) Original Route – Journey the classic Road to Hana with immersive stories.
2) Return Route – Fresh tales on your drive back, offering a new perspective.
3) Loop – Experience a full-circle journey showcasing Hana’s best spots.
4) Backroad – Discover off-the-beaten-path gems on the less-traveled Hana route.
5) Haleakala
Ascend to the summit for breathtaking sunrises and views of the massive volcanic crater, with stops in charming Upcountry towns like Pukalani and Makawao.
6) Iao Valley
Unwind in this lush valley, home to the famous Iao Needle and peaceful hiking trails. It offers a tranquil escape.
7) West Maui
Discover dramatic coastlines, historic Lahaina, and hidden beaches like Honolua Bay and DT Fleming Beach Park.
8) South Maui
Relax on the sun-soaked beaches of Kihei and Wailea, or snorkel in Turtle Town before heading to the remote beauty of La Perouse Bay.
• Why Choose GyPSy Guide?
‣ One Download, Full Access: Get all 8 routes in a single app—cover the entire island without juggling multiple tours.
‣ GPS-Triggered Audio: Explore effortlessly as 465+ stories play automatically, packed with local legends and insider tips.
‣ Offline Navigation: No Wi-Fi or data needed—enjoy offline freedom with seamless GPS guidance.
‣ Expert Insights: Discover Maui’s top highlights and hidden gems with advice on must-see viewpoints, side trips, and cultural stories.
• Must-See Stops:
‣ Seven Sacred Pools at Oheo
‣ Wai’anapanapa State Park and Black Sand Beach
‣ Haleakala Crater and Kalahaku Overlook
‣ Iao Needle
‣ Lahaina Town and Ka’anapali Beach
‣ Makena Beach, Wailea Beach, and Molokini Crater
• Experience Maui Like a Local
From scenic drives to iconic landmarks, GyPSy Guide brings the entire island to life. Whether tackling the Road to Hana, hiking Haleakala, or relaxing on South Maui’s beaches, this tour is your key to unlocking Maui’s most unforgettable moments. It’s like having a personal tour guide in your car!
• Important Notes:
‣ Reservations Required: Some parks like Wai’anapanapa require reservations.
‣ Road Restrictions: Some routes, like the Backroad on the Road to Hana, may have driving restrictions with rental cars—check before you go.
What Our Ohana is Saying:
“We downloaded Gypsy Maui and used it every day in Maui. Great information and great tips...funny too”
“If you are visiting Maui, you absolutely need to download this app. The guide gives so much valuable and interesting information while driving. During the Road to Hana, the guide gives must see stops that we normally would not know about. On the drive back, the guide dives into the history of Hawaii which made the drive itself so much easier. My wife and I ran this app every single time we were on the road. It’s worth the money.”
“We saw in another review, the user named the tour guide. Our family named him Toddson Dukelely (yes there is a story behind that). This app was super relevant and when plugged into the Car Play app in the rental car, he just piped in with his stories and instructions as we drove. This app definitely enhanced our trip and was very informative about the entire island and it’s history. Worth purchasing, no doubt!”
Important Info:
iPad Compatibility: Use an iPad with GPS (WiFi + Cellular) for full functionality.
Battery: GPS drains battery—bring a car charger.
No Expiry: Tours never expire—revisit anytime.

bluejetty:00084771:ios.name: News18: Latest News & Updates
bluejetty:00084771:ios.summary: News18 is the flagship digital news destination of Network18, India’s largest news and media conglomerate, and is also the digital face of the News18 network’s leading television news channels that include market leaders such as CNN-News18
bluejetty:00084771:ios.description:
News18 is the flagship digital news destination of Network18, India’s largest news and media conglomerate, and is also the digital face of the News18 network’s leading television news channels that include market leaders such as CNN-News18 (Formerly CNN-IBN and earlier known as IBNLive), News18 India, News18 Lokmat, News18 Bangla and many more. For long-time viewers familiar with CNN IBN, the platform continues its legacy of credible journalism through ibnlive news archives and updated ibnlive India reports—seamlessly integrated within the current News18 ecosystem.
NEWS & LIVE TV IN 12 LANGUAGES:
News18 is currently available in 12 different languages spanning the length and breadth of India. The News18 app offers news and live TV in English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Punjabi, Assamese and Odia. The app allows you to select the language of your choice and set your default television channel.
PERSONALIZED NEWS BASED ON YOUR INTERESTS:
News18 offers you a personalized news experience, based on your interests. Select the categories of news you are interested in, and find a personalized feed of curated news based on the categories you have selected. News18 offers a wide range of news categories: Politics, Technology, Business, Gadgets, Sports, Auto, Lifestyle, World, India, Health & Fitness, Football, Cricket, Opinion, Entertainment.
BOOKMARKS & OFFLINE READING MODE:
News18 is a multi-platform news destination and is an amalgamation of the highest standards of journalism and cutting-edge technology and design. The News18 app brings you the latest news across text, photo and video formats. You can easily switch between reading the news and watching it live on television in the language of your choice. If you see something you want to come back to, you can bookmark it and visit it later. You can save articles, photos and videos in your bookmarks. If you know you are going to have poor network connectivity, you can download articles, photos and videos to consume later in offline mode.
AWARD-WINNING JOURNALISM:
News18 is known for its high-quality and award-winning journalism and is one of the top digital news destinations in India. News18 draws its strength from its unmatched network of thousands of journalists who bring in news as it happens from every nook and corner of the country. This also makes News18 the default destination for any breaking news.
SHORT VIDEOS:
Now enjoy news in a refreshing short video style and catch up with the day to day's top news and highlights.

Take control of your health and reach your fitness goals with Eatwise AI, the ultimate Calorie Tracking App! Whether you're aiming to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain a healthy lifestyle, Eatwise AI is your perfect companion on the journey to better nutrition and well-being. Disclaimer: Consult a professional before acting.
Key Features:
Calorie Counting Made Easy: Effortlessly track your daily calorie intake with Eatwise AI's intuitive interface. Log your meals, snacks, and beverages in seconds, and see a detailed breakdown of your nutritional intake, including macronutrients like carbs, protein, and fats. With our extensive food database that includes millions of items—from popular restaurant meals to homemade dishes—you can accurately count your calories wherever you are.
Track Your Foods: Keep a close eye on what you eat with our advanced food tracking feature. Search for your food items or scan barcodes to quickly add them to your daily log. Save your favorite meals for quick logging, and create custom recipes to track complex dishes with ease.
Customizable Goals: Whether you're focused on weight loss, muscle gain, or simply maintaining a balanced diet, Eatwise AI lets you set personalized goals tailored to your needs. Monitor your progress with real-time updates and adjust your targets as you move closer to your objectives.
Nutritional Insights: Go beyond just counting calories. Eatwise AI provides you with a comprehensive overview of your daily nutrition, including vitamins, minerals, and other essential nutrients. Understand your eating habits better with detailed reports and gain insights into how to improve your diet.
Progress Tracking: Stay motivated with Eatwise AI’s progress tracking tools. View your weight loss or gain over time, monitor your body measurements, and celebrate your milestones with visual charts and graphs. Set reminders to log your meals and stay consistent with your tracking habits.
Community Support: Join a vibrant community of like-minded individuals who are also on their health and fitness journeys. Share tips, recipes, and motivational stories to keep each other inspired and accountable.
Data Privacy: Your health data is important, and Eatwise AI prioritizes your privacy. Rest assured that your information is securely stored and will never be shared without your consent.
Make Informed Choices: With Eatwise AI, you'll gain the knowledge and tools you need to make informed decisions about your diet and lifestyle. Whether you're dining out, cooking at home, or planning your meals, you'll have the confidence to stay on track and achieve your goals.
Start your journey towards a healthier you today! Download Eatwise AI and take the first step toward better health, one calorie at a time.
Upgrade to Eatwise Pro for unlimited access to all features and take your meal planning to the next level. A subscription is required to unlock the full experience, ensuring you get the most out of every feature designed to support your goals.

bluejetty:00196788:android.description:
Explore the Disney theme parks like never before with the Play Disney Parks app—and delight in interactive adventures, attraction-themed games, Disney trivia, unique achievements and other fun experiences that bring the environments around you to life!
Use the Play Disney Parks app to join the Disney Fab 50 Quest and find golden sculptures of 50 fabulous Disney characters across 4 theme parks.
The Play Disney Parks app is also a vital tool for living your own Star Wars story. Track down targets in Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters and collect credits from the Guildmaster. Experience adventures in Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge—hack into droids, scan crates, tune into transmissions, translate languages, and so much more!
Turn wait time into playtime! Play with family and friends while waiting in line and enjoy a variety of fun—from activities that interact with attraction queues to games that immerse you in Disney stories. 
Earn and share themed achievements—digital collectibles all their own, awarded for experiences in the app.
Test your knowledge with Disney trivia—and see if you and your crew have what it takes to become Disney trivia masters.
There’s so much to play with the Play Disney Parks app!
Note:
Before you download this experience, please consider that this app contains:
The option to sign in using a Disney account. If your mobile device has a registered Disney account, you can visit your device settings to disable the account syncing to this app. 
Location-based services that will require access to your location data for certain features. If location-based services are enabled on your device, this app will also collect your location information through beacon technology in order to enable certain features and interactive and personalized experiences within the Disney theme parks.
Notifications for information relating to the app and your visit to the Disney theme parks. You may control notifications in your device settings.
Location notification alerts. You can disable local notifications in your settings.
Linking to social media links to share your app achievements.
Advertising for some third parties as well as for The Walt Disney Family of Companies .
Features that may request access to your camera to participate in the game or activity.

bluejetty:00088327:ios.summary: Send birthday gifts, flowers, cakes and personalized gift boxes to someone you love, at home or abroad. Sugary connects you with local gift stores near your recipient, with options for India, Dubai, the UK, Bangladesh and other supported de
bluejetty:00088327:ios.description:
Send birthday gifts, flowers, cakes and personalized gift boxes to someone you love, at home or abroad. Sugary connects you with local gift stores near your recipient, with options for India, Dubai, the UK, Bangladesh and other supported destinations.
HOW DO I SEND A GIFT WITHOUT AN ADDRESS?
Choose Gift Link and share the private link by text, email or WhatsApp. Your recipient adds their delivery details. Delivery is arranged after they respond.
CAN I SCHEDULE A GIFT OR GET SAME-DAY DELIVERY?
Choose the destination first, then browse gifts and available delivery dates. Same-day options depend on the store, item, destination and order cut-off time. Check the delivery charge and date before paying.
WHAT MAKES A GOOD LONG-DISTANCE GIFT?
Choose a bouquet, birthday cake, hamper or personalized keepsake from a store serving your recipient. Most gifts are prepared locally, so sending from abroad need not mean shipping a parcel internationally.
WHY SENDERS ABROAD CHOOSE SUGARY
• Gifts made by local florists and bakers near your recipient, fresh rather than shipped across the world
• A real photo of your gift before it's dispatched
• No address? Send a private gift link by text, email or WhatsApp
• Live tracking and human support 7 days a week
• Apple Pay and cards in 135+ currencies
WHAT YOU CAN SEND
• Fresh bouquets: roses, tulips, lilies and orchids
• Birthday cakes, desserts and chocolates
• Gift hampers and sweet boxes
• Balloons, teddy bears and plants
• Jewelry, keepsakes and digital gift cards
MAKE IT PERSONAL
Build a custom gift box and add engraving, a handwritten card or a voice message. Our concierge team can help you plan something special.
FOR EVERY OCCASION
Birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, new babies, graduations, Diwali, Eid, Rakhi, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, get well and thank you.
SMARTER GIFTING
Sugary Profile suggests gifts they'll love, and Gift Swap lets them exchange an eligible gift before dispatch.
CORPORATE GIFTS
Bulk orders, branded packaging, invoicing and delivery to multiple addresses for clients and teams.
Download Sugary and close the distance today.

Dogness （International）Corporation is the world´s leading pet smart technology brand operator and is the builder of the “Pet Smart Ecosystem.” Currently, the company has three major focus areas: pet technology, pet care, and leashes&collars.  Dogness plans to enter the pet health care area to create a pet networking platform that links pets and pet caregivers and will ultimately integrate the “Pet Smart Ecosystem” onto “one platform.” 
The Dogness slogan is: “Simplifying Pet Lifestyle.”  The pets you love and care about are our inspiration, therefore the products you desire are what we strive to pursue.  Dogness ensures that all aspects of product development, production, sales, and profit will derive from the fundamental philosophy of “pet comes first.”
