bluejetty:00186539:ios.name: Kahoot! Play & Create Quizzes
bluejetty:00186539:ios.summary: Play engaging quiz-based games (kahoots) at school, at home and at work, create your own kahoots, and learn something new! Kahoot! brings the magic of learning to students, teachers, office superheroes, trivia fans, and lifelong learners.
bluejetty:00186539:ios.description:
Play engaging quiz-based games (kahoots) at school, at home and at work, create your own kahoots, and learn something new! Kahoot! brings the magic of learning to students, teachers, office superheroes, trivia fans, and lifelong learners.
Here’s what you can do with the Kahoot! app, now available in English, Spanish (LATAM), French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, Ukrainian and Korean:
Young students
- Make your school projects awesome by building kahoots on any topic using pre-made templates, fun question types, themes, and background music.
- Supercharge your games with unique rewards including new characters and accessories.
- Enjoy premium game modes, perfect for birthday parties and family game nights!
- Ace upcoming exams by setting learning goals and testing yourself with advanced study modes.
- Make math fun with interactive games to get ahead in algebra, multiplications, and fractions.
Students
- Study with unlimited free flashcards and other smart study modes
- Join kahoots hosted live - in class or virtually - and use the app to submit answers
- Complete self-paced kahoots
- Challenge your friends in study groups with kahoots you found or created
- Create your own kahoots and add images or videos
- Host kahoots live for family and friends directly from your mobile device
Families and friends
- Find a kahoot on any topic, fit for any age
- Host a kahoot live by sharing your screen to Apple TV or via video conferencing apps
- Play a live kahoot using SharePlay. Start a FaceTime call and select the kahoot you want to play. No host is required - everyone can participate!
- Engage your kids with studying at home
- Assign a kahoot to challenge family members and friends
- Create your own kahoots and add different question types and image effects
Teachers
- Search among millions of ready-to-play kahoots on any topic
- Create or edit your own kahoots in minutes
- Combine different question types to increase engagement
- Host kahoots live in class or virtually for distance learning
- Assign student-paced kahoots for content review
- Assess learning outcomes with reports
Professionals
- Create kahoots for e-learning, presentations, events and other occasions
- Encourage audience participation with polls and word cloud questions
- Host Kahoot! live in person or in a virtual meeting
- Assign self-paced kahoots, for example, for e-learning
- Assess progress and results with reports
Premium features:
Kahoot! is free for teachers and their students, and it’s our commitment to keep it that way as part of our mission to make learning awesome. We offer optional upgrades that unlock advanced features, such as an image library with millions of images and advanced question types, such as puzzles, polls, open-ended questions and slides. To take advantage of these features, users will need a paid subscription.
To create and host kahoots in a work context, as well as get access to additional features, business users will need a paid subscription.
Recurring billing, cancel anytime
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://kahoot.com/privacy
Terms and conditions: https://kahoot.com/terms

bluejetty:00021657:ios.description:
Love Wordle, Jumble, or the NYT Crossword?
Meet Joggle, the original, mildly cerebral word game that turns classic crossword solving into a quick, addictive one-minute challenge!
HOW TO PLAY:
----------
You get a 6-letter word and a clue. Your mission? Swap just two letters in the word to find the answer that fits the clue.
 Example: Clue: A baffling problem. Word: DAZZLE.
 Answer: Swap D for P and A for U to get PUZZLE! a.k.a. a baffling problem.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE JOGGLE:
----------
• ONE-CLUE SERVINGS: If you lack time and appetite for 30-minute crossword grids, try our delicious one-clue bites.
• THOUSANDS OF PUZZLES: From "Fun" and "Wiz" (easy) to "Pro" and "Zen" (cryptic levels for crossword veterans).
• LEARN CRYPTIC SOLVING: Perfect training wheels for beginners wanting to master British-style cryptic crosswords.
• TRAIN YOUR BRAIN: Improve your vocabulary, spelling, logic, and lateral thinking skills - in just one minute at a time.
• NO STRESS: Race or Relax? Your choice. Play against the clock for a dopamine rush, or turn it off for relaxed playing.
• BEAUTIFUL ART: Puzzles with a backdrop of beautiful, curated artworks by famed as well as up-and-coming artists.
• FREE & FUN: You win coins for every solve, so you can play more for free. A small in-app purchase also removes ads.
Whether you're an ESL student looking to build vocabulary or a cryptic expert seeking a new daily habit, Joggle is the ultimate brain-teaser.
Download Joggle now and start your daily word workout! Join thousands of avid players who use Joggle to keep their minds agile. Whether you have 30 seconds or 30 minutes, there’s always a riddle waiting.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00157724:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00157724:ios.description:
Know what's coming, and keep it to yourself.
Lunation predicts your next period, your fertile days and your pregnancy week from your own cycle, then says it plainly: "Tuesday, give or take." No ads, no data sold, no scare screens. Everyday tracking is free and stays free.
WHY PEOPLE SWITCH TO LUNATION
• Your next period is on screen after two questions, before you create an account.
• No ads. Your health logs are never sold, shared with advertisers or used for ads.
• One calm notification the day before, never more than two a day, never at night.
• Widgets, Control Center and Siri log a period without opening the app.
• Rated 4.6 on the App Store and available in 18 languages.
◆ PERIOD PREDICTIONS YOU CAN PLAN AROUND
Each period you log sharpens the next prediction. See the date, the give-or-take, the cycle day and the phase at a glance. Free accounts see three months ahead.
◆ OVULATION AND FERTILE WINDOW
The fertile window and ovulation day are worked out from your cycles. Trying to conceive? Conceive mode widens the window and marks the best days.
◆ PREGNANCY, WEEK BY WEEK
Switch to pregnancy mode for your week, trimester and days to go, with size comparisons and checklists for the hospital bag and the nursery. If a pregnancy ends, one tap pauses reminders for two weeks and keeps your history.
◆ SYMPTOMS, MOOD AND PMS, ONLY WHEN YOU WANT
Flow, pain, cramps, mood, energy, sleep, skin, cravings and more across 22 categories. Log what matters, skip the rest. Lunation never nags you to fill in a form.
◆ CALM, NOT CLINICAL
Plain words, no "abnormal", no diagnoses. When you want a second opinion, export a doctor report of the last six months in one tap.
◆ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sign in with Apple or Google. Your data lives in your own account for backup. Apple Health sync is optional. Delete everything, including your account, in one tap.
◆ FREE STAYS FREE
Logging, the calendar, three months of predictions, reminders and widgets are free today and will stay free. We will not move them behind a paywall later.
◆ LUNATION PLUS, IF YOU WANT MORE
A daily briefing written for your phase, your full cycle history, twelve months of predictions and the doctor-ready PDF report. Monthly or yearly, cancel anytime. Everyday tracking never depends on it.
Lunation is a wellness app, not a medical device, and it is not a method of contraception. Predictions are estimates based on the dates you log.
Privacy Policy: https://lunation.me/privacy
Terms of Use: https://lunation.me/terms

* Builds vocabulary: children learn the names of animals, fruits, vegetables, and everyday objects.
* Develops logical thinking: sorting and matching tasks encourage analysis and classification.
* Strengthens fine motor skills: moving pieces on the screen improves hand and finger coordination.
WHO IT’S FOR:
Suitable for children aged 1 to 4. Ideal as a first game without text — children can interact and learn independently.
WHAT’S INSIDE:
* Large, colorful elements easy for small hands to grasp
* Simple tasks with gradually increasing difficulty
* Calm, pleasant animation and sound
WHY PARENTS LOVE IT:
The game keeps children engaged without overstimulation and makes learning a natural part of play. Even short play sessions bring meaningful benefits.
Download and try it for free — early learning should be gentle and joyful.

bluejetty:00088872:ios.name: Up Ahead: Countdown Widgets
bluejetty:00088872:ios.summary: Up Ahead is a playful, beautiful way to keep track of everything you’re looking forward to. Create events in seconds, and build yourself an eclectic timeline full of birthdays, weddings, holidays, vacations, game releases, sporting events,
bluejetty:00088872:ios.description:
Up Ahead is a playful, beautiful way to keep track of everything you’re looking forward to. Create events in seconds, and build yourself an eclectic timeline full of birthdays, weddings, holidays, vacations, game releases, sporting events, or anything coming up that brings you joy. As your timeline grows, you’ll unlock themed patterns that can be used to give your events personality. Keep your countdowns top of mind with customizable widgets for your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
---
CREATE EVENTS
Up Ahead events are quick and simple to create — just give your event a name, a date (with optional time), a category icon, and a color. 
EVENT TIMELINE
View your events in a unique timeline format that gives you visual information about how much time is passing between events, and allows you to easily look back on your entire event history.
PATTERNS
As you create events, you’ll start to unlock decorative patterns that can be applied to any of your events and appear in both your in-app timeline and your widgets. Patterns are unlocked based on the content of your events, or as weekly gifts. How many can you find?
REMINDERS
Schedule flexible reminders to get notified about the events you don't want to miss.
ATTACHMENTS
Keep all your event information in one place by attaching short notes or links to your events.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
* "Countdown" widgets are simple widgets for counting down to a specific event.
* "Coming up" widgets come in multiple sizes and will dynamically count down to whatever event is coming up next. They can be customized with filters and display names, allowing you to create widgets such as “Next Raptors game” or “Upcoming game releases”.
* "Timeline grid" widgets give you a colorful high-level overview of all your upcoming events.
LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Simplified versions of “Countdown” and “Coming up” widgets are available to place right on your Lock Screen.
SIRI SHORTCUTS
Automate event creation or ask Siri about your events with Siri Shortcuts.
TIMELINE FILTERING
Quickly filter your events temporarily so that you can get a clean look at just the film releases you’re looking forward to, or the birthdays you want to remember.
RECURRING EVENTS
Mark an event as recurring — weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or yearly — to have it automatically replace itself in your timeline when an instance of the event has passed.
MULTI-DAY EVENTS
Give an event an optional end date to countdown to both an event’s beginning and its end.
ICLOUD BACKUPS
Automatically back up your events and pattern unlocks to iCloud Drive to ensure you never lose access to your data.
EVENT SHARING
Lightweight event sharing allows you to export and share colorful images of any event.
SOUND AND HAPTICS
Delightful sound effects and haptics bring the app to life.
...and lots more fun stuff to discover.
---
The free version of Up Ahead is free forever, and contains no ads. If you’re looking for the best way to simply pop a few good-looking countdown widgets onto your Home Screen or Lock Screen, downloading Up Ahead for free is a great place to start. 
With an in-app subscription to Up Ahead Plus, you’ll get all the bells and whistles: unlimited event creation, recurring and multi-day events, the full suite of widget types, and more.
---
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed. 
Privacy policy: https://upaheadapp.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186557:ios.name: INSIGHT HEART
bluejetty:00186557:ios.summary:
INSIGHT HEART - The human heart expedition
- Gold at the 2025 German Design Award
- Platinum at the 2021 MUSE Creative Awards
- German Design Award Winner 2019 – Excellent Communications Design
- Apple Keynote 2017 (Demo Area) – USA / Cupe
bluejetty:00186557:ios.description:
INSIGHT HEART - The human heart expedition
- Gold at the 2025 German Design Award
- Platinum at the 2021 MUSE Creative Awards
- German Design Award Winner 2019 – Excellent Communications Design
- Apple Keynote 2017 (Demo Area) – USA / Cupertino, Sept 12
- Apple, BEST OF 2017 – Tech & Innovation, Australia
- Apple, BEST OF 2017 – Tech & Innovation, New Zealand
- Apple, BEST OF 2017 – Tech & Innovation, USA
This is the first augmented reality App to be rolled out in a series of Apps created and designed for medical education purposes.
Our goal is to make medical education fascinating, explorable, and fun for students, physicians as well as accessible to patients – anywhere and anytime, in or out of the classroom, lecture hall, or living room. We have committed ourselves to take medical education one step further and have developed visually stunning and highly interactive content based on real-life medical and scientific specifications.
Have you ever wondered what your heart looks like during a workout? No problem! You can either use our live heart rate function with Apple Watch (*NEW Companion App) or the integrated Health app support to let your last workout data drive the heartbeat in realtime!
Using ARKit, INSIGHT HEART lets users easily scan their physical surroundings and place the three-dimensional heart without the need for predefined markers. Our virtual assistant ANI will guide you through various states of the heart.
Explore the human heart like never before. In the latest app version, we've integrated our brand-new heart model based on real CT data, showcasing breathtaking resolution and medically accurate anatomy. Rotate and scale the high-resolution heart floating in front of you and feast your eyes on highly detailed 4K textures.
Trigger impressive visualizations of various conditions, such as:
- Normal Heart Rate
- Myocardial Infarction
- Arterial Hypertension
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Heart Failure
NEW - Condition
- Transthyretin-Amyloidose
Transthyretin-Amyloidose is a rare condition caused by the deposition of misfolded proteins in various tissues and organs.
Dive into the detailed Mode of Disease of:
- Coronary Artery Disease
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Heart Failure
NEW - MOD
- Transthyretin-Amyloidose
Transthyretin-Amyloidose is a rare condition caused by the deposition of misfolded proteins in various tissues and organs.
NEW - FILTER-SYSTEM:
The interactive FILTER-SYSTEM allows you to explore the anatomical structures of the heart, such as:
- Cardiac Skeleton
- Heart Base
- Myocardium
- Epicardium
- Epicardium - Cut
NEW - Blood Flow Simulation:
Explore the new blood flow simulation, which adapts dynamically to the selected condition.
NEW - Updated Apple Watch Companion App:
- Now featuring the brand-new heart model.
NEW - UI:
- Now an easier to use interface with a burger menu to navigate all the chapters.
Explore this spatial application. As you walk towards the heart, the heartbeat becomes louder due to the integrated spatial sound. 
Tap on the spatial annotations to get more dedicated information for each region of the heart from every angle.
The 'Insight Apps' have won the following awards:
INSIGHT KIDNEY
- Winner of the 'German Medical Award 2023'
- Nominated for the ‘German Design Award’ 2023
INSIGHT PROSTATE
- ‘German Brand Award’ 2025 - Excellence in Brand Strategy and Creation – Brand Communication – Digital solutions & Apps
- ‘German Brand Award’ 2025 - Excellence in Brand Strategy and Creation – Lighthouse Project of the Year
INSIGHT LUNG - The human lung expedition
- Winner of the 'German Medical Award 2021'
- Platinum at the 'Muse Creative Awards 2021'
- Gold at the 'Best Mobile App Awards 2021'

bluejetty:00121256:ios.description:
Obtenez les derniers résultats d’EuroMillions et EuroDreams dans les secondes qui suivent le tirage. Cette application facile à utiliser affiche les numéros gagnants EuroMillions (y compris les tirages associés comme la loterie My Million, le Joker+ de Belgique et Extra Lux). Vous découvrirez aussi la répartition complète des gains, incluant le nombre de gagnants et la somme remportée à chaque rang (y compris les gains Etoile+ du tirage français).
L’application comporte aussi les fonctionnalités suivantes :
Vérificateur de ticket
--------------------------------------
Saisissez et sauvegardez les numéros que vous avez choisis pour découvrir si vous avez gagné ou pour savoir combien de fois ils ont été tirés dans le passé. Vous pouvez également donner un nom à vos combinaisons, ce qui est très pratique si vous jouez plusieurs fois ou si vous dirigez un syndicat de joueurs. Le vérificateur de billets met également en évidence les montant remportés pour chaque combinaison. Si vous ne jouez à EuroMillions que certains jours, ou alors tous les vendredis ou bien tous les mardis, vous pouvez exclure les tirages auxquels vous n’avez pas participé pour vérifier vos combinaisons.
Notifications personnalisables

bluejetty:00094406:ios.description:
Conversations Feel Real. Stories Feel Personal. Worlds Feel Alive.
Welcome to Dream Mate, the AI roleplay chat where characters, fantasy worlds, and emotional conversations help you feel connected, confident, and prepared for real-life relationships.
AI FRIENDS YOU CAN TALK TO ANYTIME
Dream Mate helps you feel heard by offering AI characters and companions who listen, respond, and remember.
Chat, talk, joke, vent, or simply exist in a shared world where conversations feel warm and personal.
No pressure.
No judgment.
Just AI roleplay conversations and caring companions that meet you where you are.
SIMULATE REAL-LIFE CONNECTIONS
Human connections can be confusing.
Sometimes something feels off – and you don’t know why until it’s too late.
With AI roleplay chat, you can explore real-life relationship dynamics in a safe space, like interacting with a potential partner. 
Practice conversations, boundaries, flirting, and emotional pacing; and learn to recognize when something feels wrong before it happens in real life.
Pause. Reflect. Try again.
This AI roleplay is designed to help you build awareness, confidence, and emotional intelligence, without unexpected consequences.
CREATE YOUR ROLEPLAY MATE AS A CHARACTER
Want to understand your feelings better?
You can create a character inspired by your crush, companion, or partner – their style, personality, and energy – and explore conversations you wish you could have.
Talk things through.
Explore different responses.
See how conversations feel from different angles.
Dream Mate lets you understand love, attraction, and emotional patterns — safely and privately.
EVERY ROLEPLAY CHAT BUILDS A STORY
Every chat shapes your story.
Every choice changes the world.
Choose your experience:
- Fantasy adventures
- Anime AI chat worlds
- Romance, love, drama, or slice-of-life
- School, office romance, royal courts, sci-fi futures
No scripts.
No fixed endings.
Just stories driven by you and your roleplay mate.
YOUR IMAGINATION BECOMES A WORLD OF CHARACTERS 
Dream Mate lets you create AI characters with:
- Emotional depth and memory
- Speaking style and personality
- Romance rules and boundaries
You can publish your character and let others experience your AI roleplay world.
Your dream mate, your design.
ANIME AI, FANTASY, AND ROLEPLAY – YOUR STYLE
Anime AI chat, anime AI roleplay, or a fanta

bluejetty:00135878:ios.description:
Dear reader, thank you for your interest in the app. I am happy to bring it closer to you.
The app has been around since 2019. I am happy about the average rating of 4.5 to 5 out of 5 stars.
There are several hundred people using it around the world, with Apple only showing the number that have given their consent.
The main focus is on simple user guidance. In the future, I plan to further optimize the app for people who use it often, without sacrificing the simplicity.
I would appreciate if you would install the app. You will then see that you can simply enter a number. Miles or kilometers are initially selected. The number is converted to the other unit as you type.
You can change the default units via a button called "Unit". E.g. in kilograms and pounds. To do this, simply tap on the two units in the list one after the other, that's it.
You can also use the app as a calculator with basic arithmetic commands. You can also hide the unit conversion for this, but you don't have to.
Thank you for reading this description. The app is constantly evolving, but without making it more complicated, which isn't easy. Stability and quality are also important to me.
Best regards

bluejetty:00154480:ios.description:
An app for all things Tarot – get a live detailed personal reading with an experienced tarot reader for any life area when and where you need it, or explore the vast world of tarot on your own with the super-fun tools we created just for you.
Whether it’s your love life, career, finances, family, social life, well being or health that have you curious or worrying, the web’s best live readers are here to offer you accurate tarot predictions, personal advice and spiritual guidance based on insightful tarot layouts and spreads. Benefit from their fascinating expertise, or use our free Daily card, 3-card or full-spread reading options and interpret your own reading!
Also, enjoy 3 free minutes with the first 3 Tarot readers you connect with. Get to know the different psychic readers who offer their services through our platform, ask them questions, get a short reading or start a detailed one, get a quick preview into their reading style to be able to choose the best reader for your changing wants and needs. 
No screening or extra steps – currently, everyone who downloads our app is entitled to FREE 3 minutes with every new Tarot reader – unlimited, any day, any time, in any Tarot reading category – love and romance, career and finances, family, friends, social life, wellbeing, health, general readings, yes/no readings, one-card, 3-card or full spread readings, and more.
When you find a reader you like, who gives you that amazing reading you deserve, in the way you want it, our app gives you the instant ability to save them to your Favorite readers for future reference, and easy access and view. Reach them with just one tap and start chatting anytime you want.
Using your favorites link, you can find your own favorite personal psychic reader for all your future readings and develop a meaningful supportive long-term relationship with them, allowing them to empower you at life’s difficult moments, and expand your joy when life is joyous. You can also have a preferred reader for each life area.
Tried, tested, reviewed and rated by millions of users from around the world, many of our tarot card readers have been working in their psychic specialties for many years. Short on time? Simply check out their average rating. The number of stars they got is listed right there for you to view before you make your selection. We’ve made it visually super easy for you to be able to choose your reader at a glance.
But if you’ve got a few minutes on your hands, take a look at the reviews other querents have written – they were written by people like you, app users who have gotten real readings from real readers who then went onto share their experience to benefit you and to give feedback to the reader. Read at least a few reviews, and maybe even more, to get a good sense of the reader before you start a reading with them.
Here’s something you should know – we don’t edit user submissions – neither the ratings nor the reviews. What you see is what other users have submitted, to a tee. This helps ensure 100% trust – a value we don’t compromise on at any level, to ensure all our app users can experience, time after time, year after year, the excellent psychic service our platform is renowned for.
We encourage you to send us feedback as well – let us know how we’re doing, how our platform can be further improved, and how our psychics can serve you even better. Tell us what you think about the tools and the automatic readings we offer, too.
So, why wait? Our app is 100% FREE to download. Within seconds you too can get private and detailed readings from top readers, readings that answer your very specific questions, that help you explore options, and make better, more informed decisions.
Real card spreads, live advice, in full privacy, at your fingertips any day and time you want. Join millions of users from around the world who’ve benefited from our amazing Tarot platform already.
Download the Best Tarot App now.

bluejetty:00071014:ios.description:
Flip Clock turns your iPhone, iPad, and Mac into a beautiful retro split-flap clock — the satisfying flip of a classic railway or bedside display, right on your screen.
Prop it up on your nightstand, desk, or home-office shelf and let the cards flip the hours away.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Enjoy a smooth, true-to-life split-flap flip animation
• Show the time in 12- or 24-hour format, with optional seconds, weekday, and date
• Keep it in portrait or landscape, or lock it to the orientation you prefer
• Choose from a variety of display fonts
• Dim the screen with a swipe for a gentle, glare-free glow at night
• The display stays awake, so the clock is always there when you glance over
BUILT-IN TIMER
• Countdown timer, stopwatch, and a Pomodoro mode with work and break intervals
• Pick your own alarm sound
WIDGETS
• Add Flip Clock to your Home Screen and Lock Screen
FLIP CLOCK PRO
Make it truly yours with a one-time upgrade:
• Set custom digit, background, and card colors
• Use your own photo as the background
• Turn on the classic flip sound effect
• See the track currently playing in the Music app
• Display any time zone in the world
However you like to keep time — a stylish desk clock, a calm bedside companion, or a focus timer for work — Flip Clock has you covered.

bluejetty:00061271:ios.description:
The ultimate last-mile delivery management app for drivers and couriers.
Cartwheel helps drivers know where, how, and when to go next. 
The route is optimized to save the driver’s time. 
One-click navigation.
Call or text the customer with one tap via a masked phone number.
Proof of delivery tools: take photos, scan barcodes, and collect signatures.
Verify customer age with an ID scanner.

bluejetty:00159970:ios.summary: Agrio helps crop advisors, farmers, and gardeners remotely monitor, identify, and treat plant diseases and pests in the field, farm, and garden. Our precision agriculture app leverages artificial intelligence algorithms to offer you a perso
bluejetty:00159970:ios.description:
Agrio helps crop advisors, farmers, and gardeners remotely monitor, identify, and treat plant diseases and pests in the field, farm, and garden. Our precision agriculture app leverages artificial intelligence algorithms to offer you a personal assistant with expertise in plant diagnosis and plant disease identification. The algorithms contain the knowledge of numerous agronomists and agriculture experts and continuously improve to ensure accurate plant care.
Harvie is Agrio’s built-in assistant, continuously monitoring your plants, anticipating risks, and delivering personalized guidance to optimize growth and yield.
To optimize plant health and help you to maximize yield, we are offering the following features:
1. Plant disease identification and plant diagnosis app: Agrio acts as a plant doctor, providing quick and accurate plant disease identification and diagnosis. By analyzing smartphone-captured images of sick crops, the app offers solutions within seconds, making it an essential tool for plant care.
2. Integrated pest management (IPM) protocols: We provide detailed IPM protocols to optimize yield and crop quality while reducing treatment costs. These protocols are based on extensive research and aim to ensure plant health and minimize the impact of pests on crops.
3. Effortless monitoring of large fields: The ability to monitor crop progress and spot problems early is crucial for a successful harvest. Agrio offers satellite imagery and advanced indices, such as NDVI, for easy monitoring. With our interpretation and recommendations, you can effortlessly track growth progress and address any plant health issues promptly.
4. Leaf chlorophyll content monitoring: Chlorophyll content is a key indicator of plant health and nitrogen status. Agrio monitors the chlorophyll index, enabling variable-rate fertilizer application and site-specific crop management. This feature ensures that plants receive optimal nutrition, contributing to their overall health.
5. Crop scouting app: Agrio's scouting app allows you to manage your farm effectively. By leveraging satellite insights, you can identify problematic regions and capture images of symptomatic plants. These insights are shared in real time with your team, enabling collaborative decision-making and efficient plant care.
6. Hourly hyper-local weather data: Our app provides farmers and home growers with accurate weather forecasts at the field and garden level. These forecasts help anticipate potential diseases and pests, allowing timely preventive measures. Additionally, we calculate growing degree days (GDD) to estimate the plant growth stage and optimize pesticide applications accordingly.
7. Warning notifications: Agrio utilizes big data and weather models to alert you to potential problems in your field or garden. By receiving early warnings, you can protect your plants from damage and take proactive measures. Our accurate disease and pest spread modeling ensures reliable predictions and effective plant care.
8. Easily shareable digital crop scouting reports: Agrio simplifies the process of creating digital crop scouting reports. Crop scouts, Field technicians, inspectors, and growers can generate interactive reports quickly, using voice-based geotagged reporting. These reports are easily shareable, facilitating collaboration and knowledge exchange beyond the app.
By enhancing response times to crop anomalies, dispatching warning alerts, and delivering precise agriculture input guidance, Agrio empowers agriculture workers, home growers, and gardeners to make informed decisions, reducing pre-harvest waste and ensuring plant health.
Join our community today, and together, let's revolutionize plant diagnosis, plant disease management, and plant care. We are committed to helping you grow your plants to their full potential, improve your yield, and enjoy abundant harvests.
Privacy policy: https://tinyurl.com/48eumm4e | Terms of use: https://tinyurl.com/pz5ax5fz

SMART CHARGING SOLUTIONS
Have you recently started driving an electric vehicle or are you considering making the switch? With the Smappee EV Line charging solutions you can charge safely, easily and economically. No more blown fuses while charging with this smart charging station. Your car also taps maximum energy during off-peak hours or solar power. You can control your charging sessions and see them in real-time.
Download the Smappee App now to unlock insights and control of your energy consumption and start saving energy, costs and the planet!

Learn to lucid dream in 30 days with the ultimate lucid dreaming coach.
As you explore the life-changing technique of lucid dreaming you'll be guided by experts. With tools like Am-I-Dreaming reminders, sleep cycle tracking, peak dreamtime, audio guides, and a dream journal designed for nighttime, it has never been more possible to awaken within the dreamworld. 
You are about to make a major upgrade to your mind with the Shape app for lucid dreaming. 
––
ACTIVATE DREAMTIME / UPGRADE YOUR MIND
Humans sleep for more than 30% of their lives. Activate dreamtime and upgrade your mind.
LEARN THE LIFE-CHANGING TECHNIQUE OF LUCID DREAMING
Open an audio guide, press play, and learn the technique of lucidity.
AM I DREAMING?
Create the habit of questioning reality with Am-I-Dreaming reminders.
DREAM JOURNAL / DESIGNED FOR NIGHTTIME
Familiarize yourself with the dream state and remember your dreams.
DREAMSIGNS
Identify the dreamworld and become lucid.
SLEEP PATTERNS
Understand your night's sleep: REM, Deep, Core, and Awake sleep phases.
PEAK DREAMTIME
Know when you're dreaming and use these insights to set a wake-back-to-bed (WBTB) alarm.
ARTICLES + LEARNING
Prime the mind for lucidity by reading about lucid dreaming and sleep before bedtime. 
––
TESTIMONIALS + CUSTOMER REVIEWS
"I had a lucid dream the night I downloaded this app" (5-Star App Review)
"I feel more creative and grounded just by using the app" (5-Star App Review)

"The quality of dreams is becoming less agitated and more peaceful. This app has changed my life." (5-Star App Review)
"I have remembered more of my dreams than ever before" (5-Star App Review)
"I had a dream breakthrough within the first few days of using the app" (5-Star App Review)
"This is a great way to track progress. There are no limits to your dreams... to be what you want to be, go where you want to go, and talk to who you want to talk to." (5-Star App Review)
"The narration is incredibly relaxing and easy to follow" (5-Star App Review)
"Shape is the best lucid dreaming app I’ve ever encountered" (5-Star App Review)
––
What is lucid dreaming? It's the art of awakening within the dream world. Once lucid, dreamers can fly, face fears, perform deep personal work, practice a skill, meditate, visit a wise person, anything.
Lucid dreaming clarifies the nature of reality and the role perception plays in defining how we exist in the world, freeing the dreamer from self-imposed limitations.
––
Shape is made with love and designed to help people improve self-awareness and achieve their highest aspirations. We love architecture, design, meditation, nature, and lucid dreaming.

WORKOUTS, ROUTINES, AND GROUPS
Build Workouts
bluejetty:00144980:ios.description:
Designed for weightlifters. Catering to all gym enthusiasts, from beginners to bodybuilders and powerlifters, IRON revolutionizes user experience for workout trackers, planners, and gym logs.
WORKOUTS, ROUTINES, AND GROUPS
Build Workouts with Ease
• Craft your workouts in advance using "Build Workout" feature, catering to various fitness goals such as muscle growth, tone, strength, bodybuilding, and powerlifting.
• Use "Start Now" to perform weightlifting workouts on the fly without building a workout ahead of time.
• Save your workouts to your Library for future use.
Organize with Groups and Routines
• Streamline your training routines by creating groups; for instance, label a group "5 Day Split" for easy organization.
• Pin your favorite workouts at the top of your Library for quick and convenient access.
WORKOUT LOGGING AND EXERCISE TRACKING
Efficient Set Logging
• Logging sets is the heart of our Exercise Stats, automatically updating your progress as you log sets.
• We simplify your experience by autofilling previous weights and rep counts, reducing manual entries.
• Log weightlifting workouts without building them ahead of time with Start Now.
Insightful Performance Metrics
• Delve into your Workout Stats to view analytics aggregated from your entire workout history, offering insights into overall performance trends and progress over time.
• Explore your Exercise Stats, providing detailed analytics for individual exercises, identifying areas for improvement (red) and celebrating progress (green).
• Navigate to your Muscle Group Stats to access analytics broken down by specific muscle groups, allowing for targeted assessment and optimization of your training approach.
Comprehensive Exercise Statistics
• Dive into detailed exercise data for individual exercises on the "Exercise Stats" page, featuring powerful charts showcasing your progress over time for each weight lifting exercise.
• Quick stats offer insights like average lift, lowest lift, most frequent lift, average rep count, and more.
EXERCISE INFO AND EDUCATION
Visual Learning with Exercise Videos
• Access demonstration videos for every exercise to ensure proper form and technique.
• The Exercise Info page provides step-by-step instructions for each exercise, promoting safe and effective workouts.
WORKOUT HISTORY
Track Your Progress
• Review your workout history, filtering data by muscle group, and sort by workouts or logged sets.
MORE INFO
• Tailor your workout plans for muscle growth, strength, or weight loss.
• Enjoy home workouts or hit the gym with confidence with a powerful weight lifting tracker.
• Utilize weightlifting for effective weight and fat loss.
• Replace your traditional workout journal and gym log.
• Experience the freedom of a free workout planner and weight lifting tracker.
• Achieve your fitness goals with a simple gym log, gym planner, and weight lifting tracker.
IRON: Your go-to companion for weight lifting, workout tracking, and gym logging. Optimize your weight lifting routine with our free workout planner. Say goodbye to traditional workout journals, trackers, and gym logs and elevate your fitness goals with IRON - your ultimate gym partner. Start tracking your weight lifting workouts today.

bluejetty:00167484:ios.name: Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival
bluejetty:00167484:ios.summary: A roguelike shooter with a top-down view where you play as a Miner whose spaceship has crashed on a planet, filled with underwater monsters! Use the time between each attack to power up your diver, mech, or weapon. Build automatic turrets,
bluejetty:00167484:ios.description:
A roguelike shooter with a top-down view where you play as a Miner whose spaceship has crashed on a planet, filled with underwater monsters! Use the time between each attack to power up your diver, mech, or weapon. Build automatic turrets, use drones to gather resources and improve your skills to increase your chances of survival. Discover mysterious locations and fantastic undersea deep biomes. EACH time you explore the underwater worlds, the layout changes, making every journey unique. You never play the same scenario twice in this drill dungeon core roguelite.
Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival Features:
* Procedurally generated caves: each dungeon you enter is unique.
* Mech customization: Upgrade and personalize your Submarine Mech.
* Underwater casual game with roguelite and roguelike elements.
* Horde Battles: Fight waves of sea monsters and bosses.
* Meta-progression: Constant upgrades and new abilities for your survivor.
* Artifact System: Unlock and equip powerful artifacts.
* Multiple Weapons: Choose from a huge arsenal of weapons.
* Diverse Bosses: Slay unique and challenging alien bosses.
* Multiple biomes: Explore different underwater dungeons.
- How to Play Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival:
Play with two hands and swipe your finger across the screen to move the diver in any direction, or use the virtual joystick. Find a mine (a deep hollow lighted in blue), dive into it and start digging to find resources. Since you don't have a backpack, you need to drag the resources yourself up to the mech. Get out of the mine as soon as you hear the sound of an attack or see the timer expire. Attack aliens by aiming at them and firing bullets. Collect various resources to unlock powerful upgrades: improve your weapons, increase the impact of your drill, boost your jetpack's max speed, and many other upgrade paths - each of which gives you and your dome the best chance of survival until dawn!
- Join The Fans of Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival:
Join our community and become an part of Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival development! In our Discord, you can chat directly with our developers, share your valuable feedback, and have a real impact on the final version of Ocean Keeper: Dome Survival roguelike game.

bluejetty:00000579:ios.name: GAMEYE
bluejetty:00000579:ios.summary:
Elevate your game collecting experience with GAMEYE! Seamlessly track games, systems, accessories, guides, amiibo, and your backlog—all in one place. Uncover the worth of your collection and make savvy deals with confidence.
GAMEYE 6.0 has
bluejetty:00000579:ios.description:
Elevate your game collecting experience with GAMEYE! Seamlessly track games, systems, accessories, guides, amiibo, and your backlog—all in one place. Uncover the worth of your collection and make savvy deals with confidence.
GAMEYE 6.0 has arrived! Along with the user driven database that 5.0 brought, we are proud to now allow users to optionally sync their accounts to the website with a free account at www.GAMEYE.app!
KEY FEATURES:
Privacy First:
No personalized tracking, no ads, and no account required. Keep your data completely local and managed by you or create a free account to sync with the website and be able to share with friends. 
Sync to website and share with friends!
All account data private by default with the option to either go public, or only allow select people to be able to view your data. Settable on a per type basis. So have your collection private but viewable by friends but have your wishlist viewable for the whole world! You can even fully manage your collection online. All operations across mobile apps and website will synchronize to keep your data up to date.
Expansive Coverage:
Dive into nearly 200 platforms and an ever-growing 160,000+ game collection, complete with full regional support, rich imagery spanning pictures of the actual items to advertisements and more. You can even explore the manuals, documentation, and maps that came with them!
Incredible Filtering:
Filter by platform, metacritic score, release type, release region, price, price change, games you beaten or not, entries missing components, etc... 
Easy list creation:
Use the manual adder to tick off huge lists of games at a time or use the barcode scanner.
Cart Scanner:
GAMEYE's own proprietary on device image recognition can immediately identify a growing list of platforms for various regions for easily adding to your collection. No AI or server used!
Comprehensive Tracking:
Monitor games, consoles, peripherals, guides, and amiibo, skylanders, Disney Infinity and more, and watch your collection grow! Use GAMEYE's tag system to mark up your entries however you like! Want to keep track of items you want to replace? Want to keep track of items you loaned to Ted?
Thorough Record-Keeping:
Keep every component, condition, and cost in check.
Expanding Community Features:
See how many users have the item your browsing, or how many want it. See how many users have backlog entries for a game. User-driven reviews, playtimes, and ratings coming soon!
Pricing Insight:
Know what your collection is worth and ensure you're always getting a good deal. Explore beautiful, interactive price history graphs. Optionally hide prices if you're not interested.
Growing article repository:
With our newly built, in-house tool for creating and publishing articles we plan to have an expansive list of articles spanning any and everything related to gaming.
Backlog Tracking:
Keep track of every play through, notes on games you've played, and how long you've played them.
Contributions Welcomed:
Join in by adding missing games/editions/details directly to the database at www.GAMEYE.app.
JUST A FEW OF THE PLATFORMS:
Nintendo NES, SNES, N64, GameCube, Wii/U, Switch/2, Game Boy, Virtual Boy, GBA, Nintendo DS, 3DS, Sega Master System, Genesis, 32X, Saturn, Dreamcast, Game Gear, NEC TurboGrafx, NeoGeo, NeoGeo Pocket, Xbox, Xbox 360, Xbox One, Series-X, PlayStation, PS2, PS3, PS4, PS5, PSP, Vita, Evercade, Atari, Commodore, Game.com, Wonderswan, and the list goes on! 
If you game it, we got it!

bluejetty:00060829:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00060829:ios.description:
Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider
Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.
IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ
Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.
Business calling features
Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:
- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.
Works with your PBX or VoIP provider
Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.
On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.
Key features of the softphone
- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.
A softphone app without the fees
Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.
Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.
Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

bluejetty:00094978:ios.name: Emoji Kingdom Adventure
bluejetty:00094978:ios.summary: Get ready for a vibrant, energy-filled adventure in Emoji Kingdom Adventure — a super fun matching game that takes you into a world ruled by emojis! Here, every match is not just a simple elimination but a key step toward endless joy and su
bluejetty:00094978:ios.description:
Get ready for a vibrant, energy-filled adventure in Emoji Kingdom Adventure — a super fun matching game that takes you into a world ruled by emojis! Here, every match is not just a simple elimination but a key step toward endless joy and surprises. Whether you're an experienced match-3 player or a first-time gamer, this game will keep you hooked and coming back for more!
 Why Choose Emoji Kingdom Adventure?
- Easy to Start, Deep to Master! Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, you can quickly dive into the game and enjoy its charm. But as you progress through the levels, you'll find each challenge filled with strategy and excitement. The deeper you go, the more fun it gets, and the more addictive it becomes!
- Endless Creative Game Content! From planting emoji plants to building emoji structures, from decorating your kingdom to hosting grand parties, every step is brimming with creativity and enjoyment. Use your imagination to create your very own emoji kingdom and craft unique adventure stories. The possibilities are endless!
- Stunning Visual Effects! Enjoy a visual feast with detailed graphics and smooth animations. Every emoji comes to life, and every match feels like a dazzling fireworks show, lighting up your screen. Your eyes will be dazzled, and your spirits will soar as you explore this colorful world!
 Game Features:
- Crazy Matching with Chain Reactions! Match three or more emojis to trigger amazing chain reactions and unlock new levels and challenges! Each level is packed with unexpected surprises, making it impossible to put down. From simple matches to complex puzzles, every step is a new adventure, and every successful match opens a door to a new world.
- Hundreds of Challenging Levels! Explore over hundreds of carefully designed levels, each with unique goals and obstacles. From easy-going starts to mind-bending puzzles, you'll always find something new and exciting. Every match is a fresh experience, keeping you engaged and entertained for hours on end.
- Adorable Emoji Characters! Interact with a cast of super-cute emoji characters who will assist and support you on your adventure. From playful kittens to clever foxes, and lovable bears, each character has its own unique abilities and personality. They'll join you in laughter and exploration, bringing endless fun. These emojis aren't just game elements; they're your loyal companions on this journey!
- Rich Tasks and Generous Rewards! Complete daily tasks and achievements to earn generous rewards and powerful power-ups. Use these to overcome tough levels and achieve higher scores. Every successful match brings you closer to victory and a sense of accomplishment. You might even unlock rare emojis to add to your collection, adding more surprises and fun to your kingdom!
- Immersive Audio and Visual Feast! Immerse yourself in cheerful background music and stunning visuals that transport you to a real emoji kingdom. Every twinkling emoji and exploding effect adds to the charm of this colorful world. Even the rustling leaves and chirping birds seem to be cheering you on, creating an immersive and joyful atmosphere.
 Regular Updates with Fresh Content!
The game regularly introduces new levels, events, and content to keep your experience fresh. There's always a new challenge waiting for you, ensuring you never get bored. Join the non-stop party of fun and surprises!
 Start Your Emoji Adventure!
Download Emoji Kingdom Adventure and begin your journey filled with joy and surprises! In this vibrant land, create your own emoji legend and enjoy endless hours of fun and excitement. Join the colorful carnival and explore this magical world with millions of players worldwide!

bluejetty:00060770:ios.description:
Vikatan App is India’s one of the leading daily Tamil news and magazine publishing app, delivering exclusive news articles, breaking news updates, and in-depth analyses across various categories, specially curated for Tamil speakers worldwide.
The Vikatan App offers access to 8 beloved premium Vikatan magazines, enabling you to download single issues or subscribe to your favorites. Stay updated with the latest news, politics, current affairs, Tamil cinema & more in an easy-to-read format, tailored for the smart Global Tamilian.
This app includes a daily selection of our best journalism, digital editions of our premium tamil news articles, short news, magazines and an exclusive collection of tamil audiobooks.
Get extensive News Coverage on:
-> Latest Tamil News: Keep yourself updated with the daily news in Tamil, including Tamil Nadu news, political updates, sports news, cinema news, and more. Get coverage on a wide range of topics like technology, fashion, lifestyle, finance, astrology & more news updates in Tamil.
-> Trending & Viral News: Get the latest viral news, trending Tamil news, and Tamil Short News in just 60 seconds, including updates on your local district and major stories happening now.
-> Specialized Sections: Enjoy in-depth updates on politics, Tamil movie news, reviews, gossip, live cricket scores, and sports news Tamil, plus gold & silver rates and NSE/BSE market updates.
Features:
-> Exclusive Tamil audiobooks and series (Vikatan Play)
-> Personalized section based news updates.
-> Notifications alerts of important breaking news in Tamil 24x7.
-> 30 days free trial for all Vikatan magazines.
-> Read 30+ in-depth articles and 70+ news content daily, written by our expert journalists on relevant topics.
-> Download various e-book collections in our app and read it later.
-> Save your favorite article, review or video in the My Bookmarks section.
-> Play your favourite daily word game Soliyadi, Solvalam & more.
-> Listen to magazine content on the go.
-> In-app search functionality seamlessly directs you to the news you want to read.
-> Chat with our customer care for any feedback related to content or subscription plans.
-> Download your favourite magazine and access each issue offline at your leisure.
Subscription Benefits:
-> Ad-free experience on Vikatan app & web
-> Access 8 premium magazines incl. Ananda, Junior & Naanayam Vikatan
-> Explore years of Vikatan archives & treasures
Why do you subscribe to Vikatan Magazine?
-> Ananda Vikatan – Tamil Nadu’s No.1 entertainment magazine, offering diverse content on politics, cinema, literature, and arts.
-> Junior Vikatan – Popularly called “Juvi,” this biweekly is Tamil Nadu’s best-selling socio-political investigative magazine.
-> Aval Vikatan – A women-centric fortnightly featuring empowering essays, inspiring stories, and insightful articles tailored for the modern woman.
-> Shakthi Vikatan – Published during auspicious full moon and new moon days, this fortnightly celebrates Tamil traditions and enriches readers’ spiritual journey.
-> Naanayam Vikatan – A trusted weekly for personal finance and business insights, helping readers make smarter money decisions.
-> Pasumai Vikatan - This agricultural fortnightly welcomes readers with the latest developments in the field of organic farming, animal husbandry and fisheries.
-> Motor Vikatan - Motor Vikatan is the No. 1 automobile magazine in Tamil Nadu; this premium monthly is equipped with breathtaking photographs and top notch automobile content for the motor heads of Tamil Nadu.
-> Vikatan Plus - Offers premium Tamil content—exclusive news, stories, serial novels, true events, politics, entertainment, and more.
Download & install the Vikatan App to explore a wide array of news categories tailored for Tamil speakers worldwide.
Privacy Policy: https://www.vikatan.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174063:android.description:
Get ready to dive into an enchanting journey through Panda's Dreamland Quest, a magical world full of vibrant colors, whimsical landscapes, and challenging puzzles! This match-3 adventure will take you through a dreamlike realm filled with sweet candies and thrilling gameplay. Whether you are a match-three pro or a casual puzzle fan, this game offers the perfect blend of fun and challenge!
At the heart of Panda's Dreamland Quest is the classic match-3 gameplay that players love. With simple, intuitive controls, you can swipe to match similar objects. But it's not just about matching — it’s about strategy. Panda's Dreamland Quest offers a feast for the senses with its beautiful, high-quality graphics and immersive sound effects. Plan your moves carefully, unleash powerful combos, and watch your score skyrocket! 
Features of the Panda's Dreamland Quest:
- Engaging Match-3 Gameplay.
- Challenging Levels.
- Easy To Play.
- Beautiful And Stunning Graphics.
- Addictive Gameplay.
- Play Offline.
HOW TO PLAY?
The rules of the game are simple, but mastering it will take strategy and skill! Swipe to match 3 or more identical items, clearing them from the board and triggering amazing chain reactions. The more items you match, the bigger the rewards and the closer you are to completing your quest. Match three or more items to clear them and score points. Match 4 or more for special boosters! Navigate through multiple fun levels, each with unique goals.
Ready to help Panda reclaim his dreamland? Download Panda’s Dreamland Quest now and immerse yourself in this addictive match-3 adventure! With exciting puzzles, magical boosters, and a world full of wonder, this game will keep you entertained for hours. Don’t miss out on the fun—Panda is waiting for you to join his quest! If you like this game, do not forget to check our other games and please give us feedback in the review section. Thanks.

Use the Kiteworks mobile app to access and share data through a Kiteworks cloud application provided by your employer or a partner business. Its Kiteworks Private Data Network (PDN) effortlessly protects your organization’s sensitive data no matter where you go. 
Share files and send emails simply and securely. Take compliant, encrypted photos that automatically upload to your organization’s Kiteworks cloud. Data, email, and photos never leak to the other apps, camera roll, or folders in your device.
Key features:
• Strong encryption of your organization’s data in the phone, in transit, and in the cloud
• Tracking that shows you when recipients accessed your emails and shared files
• Invitation-only email that never exposes you to phishing and spam
• Secure access to your organization’s internal data repositories, such as file shares, home drives, SharePoint, Box, etc., without needing a VPN
• Automatic, effortless enforcement of your organization’s compliance policies for regulations like HIPAA, GDPR, CMMC, CCPA, NIS 2, FedRAMP, and many more
If you're a Kiteworks customer, download the mobile app today! To become a customer, visit us at www.kiteworks.com!

bluejetty:00029802:ios.description:
Carpin is a tracking app that reports you the real-time locations of your family & friends. You can easily find the live locations of your loved ones on the map and ensure their safety even when you can’t reach them.
Everyone wants to make sure their family & friends are safe. Whether you are on the road or at work, Carpin allows you to track and locate them without disturbing them. Using reliable GPS data, Carpin draws a safe circle around your family members and instantly notifies you of any location change.
Stay connected with your loved ones and ensure their safety!
Features:
• Pin Locations: With Carpin, you can track when your family & friends arrive at or leave locations.
• GPS Tracker: Using the GPS tracker, you can view your family members' location history.
• SOS Notifications: In case of emergency, you can send or receive SOS emergency messages, share your location to inform your family, and send help alerts to the people you choose, and they can see where you are on the map.
• Battery Notification: Carpin notifies you of your family and friends’ battery percentage. You can track the battery percentage of their phones.
• Check-In: You can check-in with your family and friends by sharing your location, and sending texts or photos to your family. An effective and easy way to know your family is safe.
How to use Carpin:
• Install the app and sign up.
• To join a circle, you need to enter the invitation code your circle admin sent you.
• Each invitation code is unique to your circle. You cannot use the code for other circles.
Things You Need to Know:
• You must have an active internet connection to use Carpin.
• You must allow access to your location to use Carpin with full performance.
• You must allow your notifications to get notified with your family’s location and when the location is changed on the map.
Information on subscription terms;
Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term may vary depending on your country. You will see the total price before you complete the payment. In-app subscriptions are renewed weekly or annually, depending on your plan. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. You can turn off automatic renewal at any time in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
- You can cancel your subscription via this URL: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Privacy policy: https://carpinfamily.com/privacy_en.html 
- Terms of use: https://carpinfamily.com/terms_en.html

bluejetty:00179904:ios.description:
In our busy lives, it can be difficult to remember what is important in life. The SikhNet Daily Hukamnama App brings the words of the Guru to the hustle & bustle of your daily life, creating a moment of reflection & peace.
Read, listen & share the Daily Hukamnama from Harimandir Sahib. Gurmukhi, Punjabi, English, Hindi and Spanish options. Daily Inspirational Gurbani quote notification when the Hukam becomes available. 
►► FEATURES ►►
● DAILY GURBANI QUOTE - Inspirational Gurbani quote notification each day as Hukam from Harimandir Sahib becomes available. 
● PERSONAL HUKAM - Ask a question of the Guru & receive your own Personal Hukam any time.
● MULTIPLE LANGUAGES - Gurmukhi, Punjabi, English, Hindi and Spanish options for viewing hukam.
● SHARING - With a touch, you can share the daily Hukam via email, SMS/Facebook/Twitter. 
● BEAUTIFUL LAYOUT - Keeping the royalty and respect for the Guru
● HUKAM ARCHIVE - Select any previous date to view hukams from the past.
● FULL SCREEN landscape option great for Apple TV mirroring on large screens (Like to display at your local Gurdwara) 
● DAILY HUKAM AUDIO - Connect with the meaning of what the Guru is saying. Multiple options for each hukam.
 - Original Hukam audio from Harmandir Sahib
 - English Explanation
 - Punjabi Explanation
►► SIKHNET ►►
This app is made available by support from individual donations by SikhNet users. SikhNet has helped connect the world-wide Sikh community through the Internet since 1995. We are a platform for people to easily connect with the heart and wisdom of the Guru and with each other.
Visit us on-line at http://www.sikhnet.com

bluejetty:00073538:ios.description:
Want to watch movies, show photos or play games on a bigger screen?
Screen Mirroring: TV Cast View instantly connects your iPhone/iPad to any Smart TV in seconds. Enjoy smooth wireless display, HD video casting, and AirPlay streaming — all wireless, no extra hardware required.
Turn your small screen into a big experience today! 
With Screen Mirroring: TV Cast View you can mirror screen or screen share from iPhone/iPad to your Smart TV with TV Smart Player. Protect your eyes from small screens by mirroring to a widescreen TV for a more immersive experience.
Easily mirror anything on your TV, including games, videos, photos, music, or presentations. Screen mirroring with Samsung TV, Google Chromecast, Roku, and all major Smart TVs. AirPlay supported — no extra devices needed. It’s your all-in-one SmartTV Cast tool for home entertainment, study, and work.
MAIN FEATURES
- Screen Mirroring & Smart TV Cast: Stable, fast connection to Samsung, LG, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV, and more.
- IPTV Streaming: Access global channels and shows in HD quality.
- Work & Study Sharing: Cast PDFs, files, whiteboards, and presentations — ideal for meetings or classes.
- Photo & Video Casting: Share your gallery, albums, or HD videos on the big screen
- Web Video Caster: Play videos from YouTube, Facebook, or any website directly on TV.
- Music Casting: Enjoy your favorite music on Smart TV with dynamic sound.
HOW TO USE
1. Connect your iPhone/iPad and Smart TV to the same Wi-Fi network (Turn off VPN/Proxy if enabled).
2. Open the app and allow local network access.
3. Select your device (Samsung TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV,..)
4. Start mirroring photos, videos, games, or presentations instantly.
TRUSTED WORLDWIDE
Join 1M+ users enjoying seamless screen sharing & AirPlay streaming every day.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
- Subscriptions will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
If offered, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
DISCLAIMER: This app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned. Thanks for downloading Screen Mirroring TV Cast View.
Policy privacy: https://smarttvcast-screenmirroring.web.app/policy.html

bluejetty:00186434:ios.description:
Exercise your brain!
Mind Games is a great collection of games based in part on principles derived from cognitive tasks to help you practice different mental skills. This app includes many excellent free games. There are many trial games from Mind Games Pro that allow you to play 3 times. All games include your score history and a graph of your progress. Using some principles of standardized testing, your scores are also converted to a standardized scale so that you can see where you need work and excel.
Not sure where to focus? Training Center does the work for you by picking the perfect mix of exercises to keep you engaged.
Mind Games is intended to be brain challenging entertainment. No research has yet been conducted to determine if this app has cognitive benefits.

bluejetty:00124251:ios.summary:
Do you like pushing buttons and shouting at your friends? Do you like discharging Clip-jawed Fluxtrunions? If you answered yes, or no, then you might have what it takes to be on a Spaceteam.
Spaceteam is a cooperative party game for 2 to 8
bluejetty:00124251:ios.description:
Do you like pushing buttons and shouting at your friends? Do you like discharging Clip-jawed Fluxtrunions? If you answered yes, or no, then you might have what it takes to be on a Spaceteam.
Spaceteam is a cooperative party game for 2 to 8 players who shout technobabble at each other until their ship explodes. Each player needs a mobile device (phone, tablet, iPod Touch, etc)
You'll be assigned a random control panel with buttons, switches, sliders, and dials. You need to follow time-sensitive instructions. However, the instructions are being sent to your teammates, so you have to coordinate before the time runs out. Also, the ship is falling apart. And you're trying to outrun an exploding star.
Good luck. And remember to work together... as a Spaceteam!
Features:
- Teamwork
- Confusion
- Shouting
- An untimely demise
- Beveled Nanobuzzers
- Auxiliary Technoprobes
- Four-stroke Pluckers
Awards & Recognition:
* Winner - GameCity Prize 2013
* Winner - IndieCade 2013 (Interaction Award)
* Winner - A MAZE. Indie Games Award 2013 (The Most Amazing Indie Game)
* Winner - International Mobile Gaming Awards 2013 (Innovation Award)
* Finalist - Independent Games Festival 2013
* Selection - PAX East Indie Showcase 2013
* Featured Game - IndieCade East 2013

- Send directly to you or your family member's bank account utilizing Brightwell's competitive exchange rates.

WeGoTrip: Your Ultimate Adventure Companion - Discover Tours and Museums Across The World.
Welcome to WeGoTrip, your all-in-one adventure buddy that redefines the way you explore the world! Are you tired of spending hours planning your trips, navigating numerous travel websites, or getting lost in unknown places? 
With WeGoTrip, you can discover, book, and experience guided tours and adventures in destinations across the globe, all from the palm of your hand. Never be a tourist; be an explorer! 
Key Features: 
* Explore Worldwide Tours Discover exclusive audio tours. From city sightseeing and historic landmarks to outdoor adventures and cultural experiences, WeGoTrip offers something for every kind of traveler. 
* Instant Booking and Confirmation Say goodbye to waiting and hello to adventuring! Book your tour instantly and receive immediate confirmation. 
* Personalized Recommendations Based on your preferences and past activities, WeGoTrip suggests new tours and destinations that are tailored to your interests. 
* Multilingual Guides Our tours come with multilingual guide support, ensuring you can explore without language barriers. 
* Social Media Integration Share your epic adventures instantly on your favorite social media platforms. Show your friends the world through your eyes. 
* Safety Measures Your safety is our top priority. All tours come with verified safety protocols, including COVID-19 measures. 
* 24/7 Customer Support Got questions? 
Our dedicated support team is available around the clock to help you out. 
How It Works: 
* Download the App - Available on your iOS.
* Create an Account - Quick and easy sign-up. 
* Search or Browse Tours - Use the intuitive search function or get inspired by our curated collections. 
* Book and Pay - Securely book your adventure with our hassle-free payment system. 
* Enjoy the Tour - Meet your guide and fellow adventurers at the designated spot and make unforgettable memories! 
* For support, please contact us at support@wegotrip.com 
* Visit our website at www.wegotrip.com 
Embark on a journey you'll never forget with WeGoTrip. Let’s explore the world together!

bluejetty:00174513:ios.summary:
Incognito is a private web browser you can pull up anywhere. From any app: long-press a link or select text, tap Share, and then choose the Incognito action extension. Boom: instant web browser!
Need to lock people out of your web history
bluejetty:00174513:ios.description:
Incognito is a private web browser you can pull up anywhere. From any app: long-press a link or select text, tap Share, and then choose the Incognito action extension. Boom: instant web browser!
Need to lock people out of your web history or bookmarks? Incognito can do that too!
Incognito is great for:
• Viewing a web page inside the current app without jumping to Safari.
• Opening sketchy links without risking your privacy.
• Reopening a web page with cookies disabled — and yes, that means Incognito lets you dodge most paywalls.
• Searching Google from anywhere — just select the text you want to search, choose “Share” from the popup menu, and then choose the “Search in Incognito” action.
• Searching with something besides Google: use Kagi, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Qwant, Yahoo, or whatever search engine you prefer.
• Keeping your web history and bookmarks private and passcode-locked. Or you can disable browsing history and leave no trace!
Incognito is also a Swiss Army Knife of web tools:
• Open a page in another browser such as Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Brave, or DuckDuckGo.
• Remove AMP so you can browse or share the original URL. 
• Translate the page using Google Translate (beta).
• Open a web page with the archive.today service (Incognito is not affiliated with archive.today or archive.is).
• Save a PDF of an entire web page.
• Set Incognito as your default browser.
• Clear your session history.
Incognito is all about privacy:
• All web browsing is in “private mode” by default, so all cookies and web data are discarded after each session.
• Incognito has no ads, no third-party trackers, and does not send or re-route your web searches anywhere.
• If you require extra privacy, Incognito has options to disable browsing history and/or exclude it from your iCloud Backups.
Incognito is paid upfront with a small, one-time fee. There are no subscriptions, in-app purchases, ads, or deals with sketchy "search engines" like many of the "free" so-called private browser apps. You can trust me with your privacy because you know how I got paid: once, by you, that's it.
Incognito was created by an independent developer living in California.

bluejetty:00180902:ios.description:
Smart Kidz Club collection of 3000+ flash cards for young children helps improve cognitive development & strengthen visual memory. The beautifully illustrated pictures and the word text help with word recognition, object identification, and early vocabulary skills. The human-narrated audio promotes early language skills, boosts speech articulation, and helps kids acquire the correct pronunciation through hearing.
The learning games accompanying each deck of flashcards help kids practice the skills they have acquired with the flash cards.
These 3000+ English and Math flash cards for kids, and young children are interactive and highly functional. Toddler flashcards help children learn English vocabulary fast.
English flashcards for kids help to improve vocabulary. Flashcard apps provide a visual representation of new words, which can help kids learn and retain them more effectively.
Flashcards help to enhance kids' memory. Repetition is a key factor in memory retention, and flashcards allow kids to review and practice new words multiple times.
Flashcards can help kids better understand and make connections between new words and their meanings, which can improve comprehension overall.
Flashcards app is a useful tool for helping kids learn and retain new vocabulary, as well as improve their language skills and comprehension.
Smart Kidz Club Flashcards, a learning app for kids is divided into the following main sections to cover all areas of early learning and make it super easy to use.
FIRST SIGHT WORDS FLASHCARDS
The toddler first word cards section helps children learn new words and concepts. These cards feature alphabet flash cards, pictures of common objects, people, animals, birds, foods, and actions, along with the corresponding words.
Some tips for using first word cards with kids is to introduce a few new flashcards at a time and allow your child to play with and explore them.
Point to each object on the flashcard, and tap on the card to hear the word out loud. Encourage your child to repeat the word.
Use the flashcards to engage in interactive activities with your child, such as asking them to name the object on the screen
Play games with the flashcards, such as memory games, find the right image, and what is this? to reinforce learning and to make it more fun.
PHONICS FLASHCARDS
Phonics flashcards are used for teaching children how to read and spell.
They provide a concrete and visual representation of the sounds and spellings of words, which can be helpful for children who are learning to read and spell.
Phonics cards are used to reinforce the sounds and spellings of words that children are already familiar with, as well as to introduce new words and concepts.
Phonics cards help children learn to blend sounds and read words by sounding them out.
They can be used in a variety of settings, including at home, in the classroom, or in a tutoring session.
SIGHT WORDS FLASHCARDS
Sight words are common words that are often difficult to sound out using phonics for kids. Sight word flashcards are useful in helping children learn to recognize these words quickly and automatically, which can improve their reading fluency.
Sight word flash cards provide a quick and easy way to introduce and practice sight words.
They can be used to reinforce the recognition of sight words that children are already familiar with, as well as to introduce new sight words.
Learning sight words can improve reading fluency and comprehension, as children are able to recognize and understand the words more quickly and automatically.
MATH FACTS FLASHCARDS
Math facts flashcards are used to help children learn and practice basic math cards concepts, such as subtraction, addition, multiplication, and division facts flashcards.
Math facts cards are a quick and easy way to practice math facts.

bluejetty:00086336:ios.name: Tailscale
bluejetty:00086336:ios.summary: Securely connect people, workloads, and even AI agents to anything on the internet with Tailscale, the secure connectivity platform built on WireGuard®. Tailscale brings identity to the network layer so you can control access based on users
bluejetty:00086336:ios.description:
Securely connect people, workloads, and even AI agents to anything on the internet with Tailscale, the secure connectivity platform built on WireGuard®. Tailscale brings identity to the network layer so you can control access based on users, groups, tags, and devices instead of IP addresses, applying Zero Trust principles end-to-end across every environment.
Tailscale transforms your existing network from a legacy hub and spoke model to a modern, lightweight, and responsive mesh networking architecture that eliminates single points of failure and delivers better performance, scalability, and security for your end users, devices, and remote resources. 
Tailscale can be used for your Homelab VPN and connectivity, Business VPN, Workload Connectivity across clouds, Kubernetes clusters, regions, and environments, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Edge & IoT, CI/CD, and Securing AI – all on the same platform.
Replace legacy VPNs, connect workloads across on-prem and cloud infrastructure providers, power Zero Trust initiatives, and make remote access secure by simplifying software-defined networking and security operations. Modernize your home, your organization, and your enterprise networking at scale with Tailscale.
Tailscale is hardware-agnostic, so you can make decisions about your hardware independently from decisions about your network. Tailscale creates an overlay network, using your existing network, so you can incrementally deploy Tailscale without needing new network switches or to change your network architecture.
Tailscale integrates with 100+ technologies and dozens of identity providers, and is available on a wide range of platforms — including Apple’s macOS, iOS, and tvOS — so you can securely connect from wherever you work.

bluejetty:00071552:ios.summary:
