No Way To Die is a free offline post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore locations inhabited by creatures survived the apocalypse and mutated into dangerous symbionts. Collect food and resources to survi
bluejetty:00071552:ios.description:
Survive in a post-apocalyptic world!
No Way To Die is a free offline post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore locations inhabited by creatures survived the apocalypse and mutated into dangerous symbionts. Collect food and resources to survive. Craft weapons and defend your shelter from the raging hordes of zombies and enemies coming each night.
Your character awakens in a secret bunker, several years after a mysterious asteroid collided with the Earth. In return for the chance to shelter their family from the disaster, your character has been given the ability to regenerate—upon death, they are reborn as a clone with all the memories of the original body. The artificial intelligence that runs the bunker sends you to the surface to assess the situation and eliminate any possible threats. 
Surviving in a post-apocalyptic world is the object of the game.
No Way To Die features:
● dynamic action with a large variety of different zombie enemies
● the ability to make stealthy kills and avoid unnecessary attention
● many different types of weapons, from a club to an AK-47
● bunker defense mode—outfit and defend your shelter using strong walls or sneaky traps
● a complex crafting system giving you a wide range of options
● procedural generated locations
● a real survival simulator
● nice low poly graphics
● (SOON) a multi-floor underground location with rogue-like style gameplay
SEARCH FOR FOOD AND WATER
You must keep your current physical form alive. In the game, just like in real life, you can die from hunger or thirst. Collect mushrooms and berries in the forest, or hunt live game—this is the price you must pay to survive during a zombie apocalypse.
EXPLORE YOUR SURROUNDINGS
Collecting resources at different locations is a key factor in survival. You’ll need an axe and pickaxe to chop down trees or mine for clay and ore in the forest. You might come across trash, chests or abandoned cars which may contain something useful.
FIGHT FOR PROFIT
Once you leave your cozy little base, you’ll run into all kinds of different enemies: from unfriendly animals to mysterious, bloodthirsty zombie-symbiotes which can knock you out with one hit.
CRAFTING IS THE KEY TO SUCCESS
Craft different types of equipment, weapons and armor in the field to help you survive, or set up a production facility with different crafting stations in your bunker. Use these stations to craft deadly weapons and process the resources you win in battle.
OUTFIT YOUR BUNKER
Your bunker is surrounded by the ruins of a destroyed structure made from walls of varying strengths. Once you’ve handled the basics of survival, you can repair and strengthen the walls and install crafting stations or chests to store your items. Build a shelter and survive.
BUNKER DEFENCE
Your home is a safe place... until night, when they come. A horde of symbiotes hunger for just one thing: to break into your bunker and destroy it. Surround your bunker with strong walls to keep it safe. Setting up traps isn’t a bad idea, either.
LEVEL UP YOUR HERO
There are currently 50 character levels available, which can be reached by earning the necessary amount of experience and then defending your bunker at night from the hordes of zombie symbiotes.
UNCOVER SECRETS
No one knows what happened to the planet after the asteroid hit. Be the first to uncover the truth and save your family members who are still inside the bunker. New locations become available as your level increases, giving you more information about the world.
DON’T FORGET—THERE’S NO TIME TO DIE!
This game is a free-to-play survival simulator, but in-game purchases are possible in the in-game store.

bluejetty:00082077:ios.description:
Embody isn't your typical period tracker—it's a privacy-forward app that accompanies you throughout every phase of your cycle. We understand that your personal data deserves the utmost protection, which is why we've created Embody with a strong commitment to safeguarding your privacy at all times.
Embody is designed to empower and support you on your menstrual journey, helping you build your body literacy and deepen your understanding of your unique cycle.
Here's what makes Embody a game-changer:
* Private by default: At Embody, we take your privacy seriously. Our app is local-only, meaning your data never leaves your phone without your explicit permission. We can’t share your personal health information, because we don’t have it. The information on your device is encrypted for extra security. 
* Effortless logging: Embody boasts a user-friendly interface that simplifies cycle tracking. Log symptoms during all phases of your cycle, moods, cycle disruptors, and more with ease. Stay on top of your well-being by effortlessly maintaining a comprehensive record of your entire cycle.
* Comprehensive cycle insights: Embody goes beyond tracking periods and PMS symptoms. We provide a holistic approach to cycle tracking, offering valuable insights into all phases of your cycle. Explore patterns, track ovulation and understand how your moods, emotions, and body change throughout the month. Embody is your guide to building body literacy.
* Empowering knowledge and resources: Embody equips you with educational resources to deepen your understanding of each cycle phase. Explore informative articles, expert tips, and supportive content that addresses various aspects of menstrual health. Embody empowers you with knowledge to make informed decisions about your body.
Embody is more than just a period tracker—it's your comprehensive cycle companion that nurtures your overall well-being, helps you build your body literacy, and respects your privacy. Download Embody now to embark on a journey towards understanding and embracing your entire cycle.
Privacy. Empowerment. Embody.
Best regards,
The Embody Team
Disclaimer: The content provided by Embody is for information and education purposes only. It's not intended to replace medical advice from healthcare professionals. Please seek your doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions

BANK-GRADE ENCRYPTION
When accepting payments, you must do so in a PCI compliant manner. 
1000'S OF CUSTOMERS
Users from all around the world make payments every day.
RESPONSIVE SUPPORT
Simply contact us inside the app if you have any question. We reply very quickly.
INSTANT PAYMENT IN SECONDS

Your continued use of our website/app will be regarded as acceptance of our practices around privacy and personal information. If you have any questions about how we handle user data and personal information, feel free to contact us.
This policy is effective as of October 2026.

bluejetty:00026745:ios.description:
Tide charts and currents near you - fast.
See the last and next tide at a glance, with clear tide charts, tide tables, current predictions, and marine weather for stations worldwide.
Designed for real planning:
• See whether the water is rising or falling right now
• Check high and low tide times quickly
• Check wind, seas, and marine warnings before you head out
• Plan fishing, boating, surfing, beach walks, and dock access
• View sun and moon rise and set alongside tides
Features:
• Nearby tide and current stations
• Every station in three tabs: Now, Week, and Map
• Graphical tide and current charts
• Simple, readable tide tables
• Current direction and timing
• Marine weather: wind, seas, air and water temperature, visibility, and marine warnings where available
• Insights on the Week tab, such as the highest and lowest tides and the most active weekend
• A map with layers: Depth Chart, Wind & Waves, Weather Radar, Moving Tides, and Moving Currents
• Sun and moon information
• Speeds in mph, knots, or km/h
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone, a two-pane layout on iPad
• Home Screen widgets for quick access
• Apple Watch app and complication support
Free core features are available. Two optional subscriptions add more:
• Premium: 30-day forecasts, 30-day insights, and no ads.
• Go Mode: nautical charts with depths, marks, and hazards that follow your position on the water, heading up, with depth, speed, wind, and seas along the bottom of the screen. Includes everything in Premium. Available in US waters. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The War of the Magi caused magic to
bluejetty:00073878:ios.description:
A remodeled 2D take on the sixth game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
The War of the Magi caused magic to disappear from the world. A thousand years later, humanity relies on machines - until they find a young woman with mysterious powers. The magicite system allows players to customize which abilities, magic spells, and summons the party members learn. All the playable characters have their own stories, goals, and destinies. Journey through their interwoven fates in this sweeping melodrama.
The pinnacle of the FF series at the time of its release, FFVI remains critically acclaimed and beloved to this day.
-------------------------------------------------------------
■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.
・Reimagined cinematic-style opera scene, complete with newly recorded vocal performances.
■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.
*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY VI" game released in 1994. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher
[Applicable Devices]
iPhone 7 Plus, iPad (7th generation), iPad Air (3rd generation), iPad mini (5th generation) and higher

bluejetty:00073359:ios.summary:
Valhalla is calling!

In this competitive global game, what enemies will you encounter? What friends
bluejetty:00073359:ios.description:
Valhalla is calling!
Play as the leader of the Vikings and lead your Tribe to conquer Midgard! Embark on your quest alongside famous Heroes from Viking history.
In this competitive global game, what enemies will you encounter? What friendships will you gain?
[Viking Rise] is an online multiplayer, real-time war strategy game. You play as a Viking ruler, guiding your Tribe throughout Valhalla in the uncharted world of Midgard. Explore, plunder, hunt, and fight your way across Valhalla to accrue massive wealth, fame, and power. Form alliances with other players, protect one another, and defeat all enemies to conquer Midgard!
Features
▶ Audiovisual Masterpiece ◀
Experience realistic seasonal changes and explore the vast Nordic landscape. Immerse yourself in the world of Midgard with an original soundtrack composed by the renowned Mikolaj Stroinski.
▶ Global Multi-Player Battles ◀
Challenge players around the world or fight alongside allies. Balance strategy, diplomacy, and warfare as you build your empire in Midgard and stake your claim to glory in Valhalla.
▶ Design Your Territory ◀
Conquer Midgard and recruit talent to expand your territory and grow your Tribe. Personalize your territory with Viking-style structures. Develop your land into a commercial trading center, an area of rich resources, or a powerful military fortress.
▶ Naval Combat ◀
Lead your Vikings across unknown waters to seize new lands in Midgard! Use the sea to your advantage to ambush enemies and plunder their resources, set sail for strategic territories, or use your ship to retreat from unfavorable situations. Combine your navigational and naval combat skills to invent greater strategies!
▶ Real-Time Combat ◀
Fight your enemies in real-time on a massive world map. Survey your battlefields and give commands in real-time. Form alliances and adjust your strategy to devastate your foes and become the strongest in Midgard.
▶ Fight Alongside Viking Heroes ◀
Recruit legendary Viking Heroes to join you! Summon Ragnar Lothbrok, Bjorn Ironside, Sigurd Snake-In-The-Eye, and other famous figures from Norse mythology to fight for you.
▶ Tame the Ancient Dragon ◀
Send your Heroes to hunt down raging beasts from Norse mythology. Seek treasure in mysterious ruins and caves. Tame the mighty mythical dragon and obtain a powerful combat boost!

3. Exclusive buffs: Energy Recovery Limit +500, Research Speed +10%, Construction Speed +10%, Training Speed +10%, Healing Speedup +20%, Trap Point Recovery Speed +30%
4. Worker Exploration time reduced by 10%

6. Auto Translate chat messages

bluejetty:00168501:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating endless runner adventure with Maxwell the cat, Capybara, Long Nose Dog, and a delightful cast of friends in the captivating mobile game, "Maxwell Capybara & Friends." Prepare for an adrenaline-filled journey through vibrant landscapes, exhilarating challenges, and endless fun!
In this whimsical world, players assume the role of Maxwell, a nimble and adventurous cat with an insatiable hunger for exploration. Maxwell's escapades are complemented by the mischievous and playful Capybara, who adds an extra dash of excitement to the journey. Alongside them is Long Nose Dog, an expert at sniffing out hidden treasures and uncovering secret paths. Together, they form an unbeatable team ready to conquer any obstacle that comes their way.
As an endless runner, the game immerses players in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Dash, jump, and slide through dynamically generated levels with simple and intuitive controls, allowing players of all ages to join in on the action. Test your reflexes and agility as you navigate perilous gaps, avoid obstacles, and overcome thrilling challenges while aiming for the highest score.
Compete with friends and players from around the world through THE BEST online leaderboard, striving to claim the top spot. Share your achievements, challenge others, and showcase your skills as you aim for record-breaking runs.
With its charming characters, thrilling gameplay, and captivating visuals, Maxwell Capybara & Friends delivers an endless runner adventure that will keep you entertained for hours on end. So, join Maxwell, Capybara, Long Nose Dog, Shiba and their friends on this epic journey and prepare for an unforgettable and endlessly enjoyable experience!
Play now and let us know what you think!

bluejetty:00118850:ios.description:
Print your Calendar and Reminders to any printer. You can print your Day, Week, Month and custom list calendar views to ANY printer, not just AirPrint. Email your calendar or reminders as a PDF file to share with others. Print out your monthly calendar and stick it to the fridge or office wall. Print out a shared family reminder shopping list.
Full support for Shortcuts eg. "Print today", "Print tomorrow", "Print this week", "Print this month" 
Print maps and driving directions for appointments.
Add, delete and edit your appointments inside CalPrint and print them out straight away. Choose from a range of print options, including layout, mini calendar inserts, text size, single page and more.
Create a list view of upcoming appointments for the next week, month or any date range you choose. Each appointment is itemized and printed in a list.

• Search for events and print the results

• Easily create new appointments
• Print event maps and driving directions
• Print your calendar as a PDF for use in other apps
• Utilizes existing calendars, no new calendar setup needed.
• View and Print by Day/Week/Month and a custom list view
REMINDER FUNCTIONALITY
• Choose which reminder lists to display and print
• Print your shopping list, to do list, or other lists shared with your family
• Filter by scheduled and completed
• Search for text in reminders to filter results
• Email your reminder lists as PDF files
FULLY FUNCTIONAL PRINTING
• Print to ALL printers (Network/WiFi/USB/Bluetooth) via your Mac or PC or direct to most WiFi printers without additional software. Also print to Apple AirPrint printers.
• USB & Bluetooth printers can be used with free print server software (Windows & Mac)
• Print remotely via 3G/4G
• Print using ALL the same document formats to ALL printers used by your Mac/PC

- Display current, average, and maximum values
- Display peak frequency

bluejetty:00045200:ios.name: Western Edge
bluejetty:00045200:ios.summary: Nestled in the miles of Iowa Corn Fields, you will find one of the most unique Western Stores of the modern day. As a family owned and operated business, we have grown and flourished since 1988. Built on a passion of persevering the Western
bluejetty:00045200:ios.description:
Nestled in the miles of Iowa Corn Fields, you will find one of the most unique Western Stores of the modern day. As a family owned and operated business, we have grown and flourished since 1988. Built on a passion of persevering the Western Heritage from those whom came before us; we still believe in a firm handshake, a sun up to sun down work day, and the genuine friendship that is made from doing so. 
Though we have grown and flourished in the Iowa farm lands, we have now expanded to Oklahoma with a third Brick & Mortar location. You can also, find us all across the US at Road Shows, from Las Vegas to Denver to all the way to San Antonio, TX…we are on the road approximately 160 days of the year at Rodeos, State Fairs, Horse Fairs, and Trade Shows. Of course we keep up with modern demands, you can shop with us online from the middle of New York City to the Mountains of Montana any day of the year. 
Unique in the fact that we design and bring you the largest selection of exclusive western boots and shoes from the largest retailers; such as, Twisted X, Ariat, Hey Dude, Anderson Bean, Olathe, Fenoglio, Justin & more. We are the largest saddle and tack dealers in Iowa. Specializing in Crircle Y, Tucker, HR, and Double J Saddles. We offer In House Saddle Fittings, by our specially trained team of experts. We carry all the brands of tack and horse supplies that you know and love. Professional Choice, Classic Equine, Cactus, Weaver, and many more. 
While Supplying you with all of your modern Western Needs, we take pride in offering you the most unique and hard to find western clothing, Native American jewelry, home decor, and more. We strive to provide you with clothing and products that you can be proud of, knowing they will stand the test of time. 
 From our family to yours, we want to thank you for stopping by and shopping with us. Once you shop at the Edge, you are no longer a customer, you are now a friend! 
~The Western Edge Family~

bluejetty:00186120:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00186120:ios.description:
The #1 math app for early learners — from counting to multiplication.
■ #1 in the App Store in 20+ countries and created by an award-winning team. More than 10 million parents and 5,000 teachers have made Todo Math their go-to app for young learners
› COMPREHENSIVE: 2,000+ interactive math activities for Pre-K through 2nd grade.
› LOVED BY KIDS: math practice kids ask to play. Engaging gameplay, beautiful graphics, and adorable collectibles.
› EDUCATIONAL: Common Core State Standards-aligned curriculum. 5,000+ elementary classrooms have used Todo Math.
› INCLUSIVE & ACCESSIBLE: playable in 8 languages, left-handed mode, help button, dyslexic font and other accessibility features empower ALL children to learn independently.
Try Todo Math for free today!
› Easy email signup.
› No commitment, no credit card information collected.
■ Todo Math covers all the fundamentals of early math education
› Counting and Number Concepts - learn to write and count numbers.
› Calculation - practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and word problems.
› Mathematical Logic - number-based memory games and pictographs.
› Geometry - Learn basic geometry, such as drawing and learning shapes.
› Clocks & Calendars – learn days of the week, months of the year, and how to tell time.
■ Todo Math lets you select the right challenge level for your child
› Level A (Preschool) – Count to 10 and identify the names of shapes.
› Level B (Kindergarten Basics) – Count to 20, and add and subtract within 5.
› Level C (Kindergarten Mastery) – Count to 100, add and subtract within 10, tell time to the hour.
› Level D (1st Grade Basics) – Place value and simple geometry.
› Level E (1st Grade Mastery) – Carry-over addition, subtraction with borrowing, and dividing a plane figure equally.
› Level F (2nd Grade Basics) – Three-digit addition and subtraction, measurements with ruler, and graph data.
› Level G (2nd Grade Mastery) – Comparing three-digit numbers, addition and subtraction of two-digit numbers, foundation of multiplication.
› Level H (3rd Grade Basics) – Learn to do basic division. Understand the concept of fractions and know how many faces, edges, vertices each 3D shape contains.
› Not sure of which level is right for your child? No problem! Use the in-app placement test.
■ Parents Page
› Easily change your child’s level, edit their learning profile, and review their learning progress.
› Sync profiles across multiple devices, including cross-platform.
■ Built by Experts
› Leading education experts from Harvard, Stanford, UC Berkeley, and Seoul National University.
› Award-winning children mobile app designers.
› Team was named co-winner of the Global Learning XPRIZE competition, a worldwide competition to have children teach themselves math and literacy skills.
■ Awards & Recognitions
› #1 in the App Store (education category) in 20+ countries, including USA, China, the United Kingdom, Korea and Japan.
› SIIA CODiE award finalist (2016).
› Winner of the Parents’ Choice Award — Mobile App category (2015, 2018).
› Awarded Best Design at the LAUNCH Education & Kids Conference (2013).
› 5 out of 5 star rating from Common Sense Media.
■ Safety and Privacy
› Todo Math complies with the US Children's Online Privacy Policy, does not contain any third party advertising, and can be played without an internet connection.
■ The Todo Math app that was serviced separately in the the Australian App Store has been unified with the global version. Please search for Todo Math in the App Store and install again. Log in with an existing account to continue where you left off.
■ Have questions?
› Please check the FAQ on our website's help section (http://todomath.com/help).
› You can get the fastest response by going to the website > Help > Contact Us or the in the Todo Math app > Parents Page > Help.
∙ ∙ ∙
We empower ALL children to learn independently.

No estás solo en esto. En tyba la inversión digital tiene nombre, cara y alguien que te entiende. Tú marcas el ritmo, nosotros te acompañamos con tecnología y personas reales disponibles cuando las necesites.
Invierte a tu manera, según tu momento:
Colombia 
Desde cualquier monto , puedes gestionar tu inversión desde la app o el portal web, cuando quieras y donde estés. 
Desde $50 Millones contarás con un experto disponible bajo demanda para identificar las oportunidades que más te convienen. 
Desde $300 Millones, tendrás un acompañamiento preferencial con un asesor dedicado y un portafolio más amplio.
Productos de inversión digital pensados para ti:
CDT Digital : Plazos y tasas fijas respaldadas por Fogafín. Administrado por Mibanco. FICs Digital : Fondos locales y globales para invertir en acciones. 
FPV Digital : Complementa tu pensión y accede a beneficios tributarios. 
tyba Pocket : Invierte con bajo riesgo, parece ahorro pero es mucho más.

bluejetty:00186551:ios.name: IQ Test: Intelligence Quiz
bluejetty:00186551:ios.summary: How smart are you really? Take a free, full-length IQ test, see your IQ score on the bell curve right away and find out where you stand compared to others. No sign-up needed. Developed with students of the University of Rostock and inspired
bluejetty:00186551:ios.description:
How smart are you really? Take a free, full-length IQ test, see your IQ score on the bell curve right away and find out where you stand compared to others. No sign-up needed. Developed with students of the University of Rostock and inspired by the WAIS-IV.
WHAT YOU GET
- A complete IQ exam with realistic tasks from many categories – free, with your result at the end
- Your IQ score on a bell curve (normal distribution) – instantly see how you compare
- Detailed statistics for every category: discover your strengths and weaknesses
- Review your right and wrong answers after each category
- Puzzles and exercises in three difficulty levels, with hints, solutions and explanations
- Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish and Dutch
- Pro without ads – as a one-time purchase, so you don't need a subscription
WHAT THE IQ TEST MEASURES
Inspired by the WAIS-IV (Wechsler Adult Intelligence Scale), the test covers six areas:
- Perceptual reasoning
- Processing speed
- Working memory
- Verbal comprehension
- Numerical reasoning
- Logical thinking
You solve tasks such as matrix reasoning, number sequences, cube folding, image memory, patterns, analogies, estimation, ordering numbers and letters, logic questions and more.
WHAT IS AN IQ TEST?
An IQ test shows how you perform compared to other people. Intelligence itself is not clearly defined – it is simply what an IQ test measures. That's why only results of the same test can be compared: an IQ above 100 means you solved the tasks better than average, below 100 means worse. So don't take your score too seriously – see it as an exciting comparison with others!
BRAIN TRAINING AND TEST PREPARATION
Preparing for an aptitude test, an assessment center or a psychological test? Use the puzzles and exercises to train your brain and sharpen your logical thinking, memory and math skills.
QUICK BREAKS: IQ TEST CHALLENGE
Looking for short brain teasers on the go? Try our second app IQ Test Challenge: over 5000 quick IQ tasks, and for every task you see how others solved it – plus daily challenges and modes like Sudden Death.
In short: IQ Test is the full IQ exam, IQ Test Challenge is for a quick break.
PRO: UNLOCK EVERYTHING
The IQ Test app is free to download. Pro is optional and unlocks:
- All IQ tests
- All explanations and solutions
- All exercises
- Detailed statistics
With Pro there are no ads. You can get Pro as a one-time purchase that stays unlocked forever. A subscription is also available if you prefer: it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed or cancelled in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://iqtest-app.de/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://iqtest-app.de/privacy-policy/

Whether you're a professional content creator, an artist, or just love sharing your moments, SCRL offers everything you need to make your posts stand out.
• EXCEPTIONAL PHOTO COLLAGE MAKER
SCRL lets you create stunning photo collages with full control over layout, spacing, and visual balance. Move between freeform and structured layouts depending on your workflow - from simple grid collages to complex, layered compositions. SCRL gives you the precision to build exactly what you envision.
• TEMPLATES NO ONE ELSE HAS
A curated library of collage, carousel, and story templates designed in-house by our designers' team. Each one is hand-crafted with focus on composition, proportion, and visual rhythm, not just assembled from generic patterns. Regularly updated with new designs across different styles and use cases.
• PHOTO EDITOR BUILT INTO YOUR WORKFLOW
Adjust exposure, dial in color, apply filters, all without leaving the app. Edit, compose, and publish in one seamless flow. No switching, no quality lost in transit.
• INSTAGRAM CAROUSEL POSTS THAT FLOW
SCRL was designed for creators who think beyond a single post. Build seamless carousels with panoramic layouts, precise alignment, and transitions that flow from slide to slide.
• GRID LAYOUTS FOR A COHESIVE FEED
Multi-post grids that span several photos, giving your feed a structured, unified look. Your profile is a portfolio and SCRL helps it look like one.
• MORE THAN 10 PHOTOS IN ONE POST
Break the limitations of traditional posts & Instagram layouts. With SCRL, you can add more than 10 photos in a single post, providing more room for your creativity and storytelling. 
• FREEFORM CANVAS
Design your way with our freeform canvas. Zoom in and out to perfect every detail or get an overview of your entire project. Create a layout that’s uniquely yours. 
• STICKERS & OVERLAYS
A growing library of overlays and stickers to add texture, depth, and detail to any design. Whatever your style, you’ll find elements that complement your collages and carousels perfectly.
• DIRECT POSTING TO INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK
When it's ready, it goes live - exactly as designed. No exporting, no re-uploading.
• WHERE PROFESSIONAL CONTENT GETS MADE
From property listings to campaign launches, social media schedules to client pitches - SCRL handles the volume without sacrificing the craft.
• SCRL PREMIUM
Every template, every layout, every tool, plus features built for work that demands more. Monthly and yearly plans, starting with a free 7-day trial.
• TRUSTED BY THE BEST
SCRL is trusted by Grammy Award-winning artists, NBA players, and major international music festivals. We’ve been featured numerous times in the App Store and recognized by top industry publications:
"14 Best Apps For Instagram Collages" - Hootsuite
"20 Mobile Apps to Create Stunning Social Media Visuals" - HubSpot
"8 Trendy Apps To Create Collages For Instagram" - Later
TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Start SCRL Premium Collage Maker with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you'll be charged an annual subscription fee. SCRL Premium will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms of Use: https://scrl.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://scrl.com/privacy-policy
Follow @scrlgallery on Instagram for inspiration from our community. Add #scrlgallery to your posts to get featured on our page. Questions or feedback? DM us at @scrlgallery.
Create unique photo collages, Instagram stories & carousel posts with SCRL. Browse hundreds of curated templates for every occasion.

bluejetty:00131945:ios.description:
＊ Phone Style, iScreen it! ＊
iScreen - personalized homescreen with various Widgets & Themes & Wallpaper to make your phone screen stand out!
＊ iOS 27 Unlocked! Introducing upgraded 4×6 ExtraLarge Widget. Spacious layout at a glance!
Special feature: 
【iOS 27】
Upgraded 4×6 ExtraLarge Widget: super-sized photos, albums, Polaroids, calendars, panels, watch faces, music players, schedules, folders, and more. Also DIY your own personalized ExtraLarge Widget!
【Liquid Glass】
All widgets support Liquid Glass dreamy style. Real-time weather Liquid Glass widget, Liquid Glass theme sets. Unlock your desktop's hidden beauty!
【Space Wallpaper】
Massive space wallpaper templates (viral cliff-jumping wallpapers, naked-eye 3D photo DIY, anime, futuristic tech space). Instant impact the moment you open phone!
【Control Center】
Customize your Control Center style with colorful icons. Features include a Counter, Water Reminder, Book of Answers, Dice Roll, and Quick Launch—combining beauty and practicality.
【DIY Wallpapers】
Create static or dynamic wallpapers with rich templates like Polaroid, Heart Puzzle, Flip Card, and Animated Marquee Lights to make your home screen unique.
【Widgets】
Includes popular widgets such as Dynamic Panel, Photo Wall, Weather, Battery, Countdown, Calendar, X-Panel, Emoji Notes, Digital Clock, Ferris Wheel, Windmill, and Air Conditioner. It also offers creative lock screen styles like Emojis, Animations, and Icons, with support for transparent effects — making your phone both fun and practical.
【Charging Animation】
Cool and interesting charging animations with custom effects for a personalized charging experience.
【Couple Widgets】
Sweet widgets designed for couples and friends. Send messages and photos to each other’s screens, and check real-time distance, weather, and moods.
【Interactive Widgets】
Quickly complete to-do check-ins or play games like Whack-a-Mole and Arcade without opening the app—adding fun to your daily routine.
【Themes & Wallpapers】
A vast collection of daily updated themes and wallpapers, including trending styles like Ins, minimalist, pink & black, AI art, and paper-cut designs. Easily elevate your home screen’s style and personalize your phone!
【Dynamic Island】
We offers a variety of fun features, such as Pet Island, Plant Island, Animation Island, Weather Island, Panel Island, Calendar Island, Signature Island, Launcher Island, Timer Island, and more. It comes with multiple built-in creative animations, and you can also custom upload images or avatars to your Dynamic Island and set exclusive quotes

Privacy Policy: http://www.xmzerone.com/about/deskprivacy.html

bluejetty:00068500:ios.description:
Follow your social media accounts' progress right from your Home Screen with Social Widget. 
How does it work? 
1. Download the app 
2. No Login required 
3. Add as many accounts as you want
4. Select a widget template 
5. Plug the accounts you want to track to it 
6. Head over to your Home Screen and add a new Widget
7. Select SocialWidget and select the desired widget size 
8. Long press on the widget you just added to your Home Screen 
9. Tap “Edit Widget” 
10. Select the template you created in the app 
11. You’re good to go 
The widgets will refresh periodically to show you your latest follower counts. You can add as many templates as you want and track as many accounts as you want. 
Platforms supported: TikTok, Reddit, X (Twitter), Twitch, Mastodon, Instagram, Telegram, Medium, Patreon, Pinterest, Facebook, and YouTube. More coming soon.
I value all feedbacks and suggestions and you can contact me directly inside the app (check the Settings tab). I read every single message and try to reply as fast as humanely possible for a solo-developer. Yup, no big company here. I'm part of a rare breed called "Indie Developers". We think, design, code, build and ship apps all by ourselves and that's how we make a living. All support is always appreciated. 
If you like the app, please consider leaving in a positive rating and a review, that helps support the development. 
Thanks for reading. 
Best, 
Ed 
––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––

Basketball Manager 2025 - Create Your Own Basketball Legacy!
■ The First Idle Basketball Game for True Basketball Fans! ■
Make critical decisions that shape your team's destiny. 
Basketball Manager 2025 delivers thrilling basketball action with automatic matches and easy management, letting you enjoy the game anytime, anywhere.
Train players, customize tactics, and compete globally to become the ultimate basketball manager.
■ Special Features of Basketball Manager 2025 ■
- Smart Basketball Management with Automatic Matches
Watch exciting games unfold as you develop your players' skills. Enjoy simple controls and idle gameplay for a seamless experience.
- Player Development and Customized Tactics
Recruit legendary players to match your team's strategy and dominate the court with your unique tactics. Choose your playstyle, from 90s classics to modern fast breaks.
- Global Leagues and Fierce Competition
Challenge players from around the world! Win weekly playoffs and climb to the top of the global leaderboards.
- Mini-Games for Extra Fun
Fuel your passion for basketball with mini-games like Drafts, Skill Challenges, and Quizzes.
- Multi-Language Support
Play anywhere in the world with support for multiple languages:
English, العربية (Arabic), Français (French),日本語 (Japanese), 简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)
繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese), Deutsch (German), Español (Spanish), Português (Portuguese)
Русский (Russian), Türkçe (Turkish), Italiano (Italian), 한국어(Korean)
■ Your Team, Your Legacy! ■
Draft new player cards daily to build your dream lineup.
Master tactics and strategies to dominate matches and establish yourself as the best manager on the court.
Basketball Manager 2025 offers simple yet profound gameplay that provides an unparalleled experience for basketball fans.
Download now for free and rewrite basketball history!

bluejetty:00062699:ios.description:
1200 HISTOIRES AUDIO POUR ENFANTS DE 3 À 12 ANS
Avec Souffleur de Rêves, transformez chaque instant en moment magique.
Découvrez près de 1200 histoires audio originales, créées par des experts de la petite enfance pour captiver les enfants de 3 à 12 ans.
Des aventures inédites, sans écran, pour toute la famille.
Plongez dans nos séries audio captivantes, réparties en épisodes et saisons, pour des centaines d’heures de divertissement. Et devenez le héros de votre enfant en lui lisant nos histoires grâce aux textes offerts dans l’app.
UNE BIBLIOTHÈQUE UNIQUE EN SON GENRE
 • 1200 histoires audio adaptées à chaque âge, entre 10 et 15 minutes.
 • 100 séries passionnantes de plusieurs épisodes et saisons.
 • 120 histoires en anglais pour apprendre en s’amusant.
 • 900 textes à lire ensemble.
 • 52 personnages attachants pour éveiller leur imagination.
 • 220 heures de contenu audio enrichissant.
DES CONTENUS CONÇUS AVEC AMOUR
Toutes nos histoires sont écrites avec un objectif éducatif clair :
 • Un langage adapté à chaque tranche d’âge, validé par des spécialistes.
 • Un contenu sécurisé, validé par un comité de mamans attentives.
POUR TOUS LES MOMENTS DE LA JOURNÉE
 • Accompagnez les moments de jeu.
 • Rendez les trajets captivants.
 • Instaurez une routine apaisante avec nos méditations et musiques du soir.
 • Encouragez leur épanouissement grâce à 900 thématiques ludo-éducatives.
DES BÉNÉFICES QUI CHANGENT LA VIE
Votre enfant traverse un moment difficile ? Une peur à surmonter ? Des questions sur l’écologie ?
Nos histoires offrent des clés pour grandir, comprendre le monde et développer leur confiance.
UNE EXPÉRIENCE 100% SÉCURISÉE
 • Aucune donnée personnelle collectée ni partagée.
 • Zéro publicité.
 • Une interface pensée pour votre tranquillité d’esprit.
L’ABONNEMENT, SANS CONTRAINTE
Accédez à toutes nos histoires et débloquez des fonctionnalités premium :
 • Reprise d’écoute.
 • Lecture continue.
 • Textes intégrés.
 • Gestion des coups de cœur.
 • Partage familial.
Sans engagement : résiliez en un clic, quand vous voulez.
BESOIN D’AIDE ? ON EST LÀ POUR VOUS
Notre équipe est joignable à tout moment via notre centre d’assistance. Partagez vos idées, vos questions ou vos retours : nous sommes à l’écoute !
Informations sur l’abonnement :
En vous abonnant, vous serez facturé(e) via iTunes tous les 30 jours, avec renouvellement automatique 24 heures avant la fin de chaque période. Vous pouvez gérer ou annuler votre abonnement directement dans les réglages de votre compte.
Conditions d'utilisation : https://souffleurdereves.com/conditions-generales-dutilisation-et-de-vente/
Politique de confidentialité: https://souffleurdereves.com/politique-de-confidentialite/

Magical Effects
 Create breathtaking animated videos in one tap with cinematic quality.

• Class A credits logged as you listen
• Certificates ready to download when you need them
• No paperwork and no separate reporting

• 1800+ practice questions with rationales that explain the answer
• Custom quizzes across 19 anesthesia categories
• See which topics are strong and which need work
• High-yield cheat sheets and procedure videos
• Search that finds the episode, sheet, or clip you meant
TAKE IT OFFLINE
Download episodes and cheat sheets for flights, commutes, and dead zones. Anything you save stays available with no signal.
For SRNAs preparing for boards and CRNAs maintaining certification.

bluejetty:00119196:ios.name: HCSS Plans: Revision control
bluejetty:00119196:ios.summary: Get everyone on the same (digital) page with this easy app, designed for heavy civil construction. Upload PDF plans from the office, and then collaborate with your entire project team in real time, no matter where they are, using markups, c
bluejetty:00119196:ios.description:
Get everyone on the same (digital) page with this easy app, designed for heavy civil construction. Upload PDF plans from the office, and then collaborate with your entire project team in real time, no matter where they are, using markups, call-outs, notes, photos/videos, and more. Smart revision control ensures everyone works off the latest set of plans and site instructions so your crews can build correctly the first time, every time.
~~~~~ Collaboration ~~~~~
SEAMLESS TEAMWORK
Align your entire project team — from foremen and managers to estimators, executives, and owners.
• Management gains detailed insight into how the project was bid.
• Foremen get instant access to project managers’ notes, clarifications, and calculations.
• All team members can add and share layers, annotations, notes, photos, and videos.
• Subcontractors can collaborate with your team for free while your sensitive information is protected.
SMART REVISION CONTROL
Avoid rework and delays when everyone works off the most up-to-date set of plans.
• Sync revisions, annotations, and photos between the office and field. 
• Overlay new and old versions to identify design changes immediately.
INSTANT ACCESS TO DOCS
Digitally store all project documents in one, easy-to-use system for instant access in the office and field, even without Internet.
• Organize your permits, contracts, shop drawings, vendor agreements, manuals, specs, and more.
• Pin RFIs, issues, dig permits, and submittals directly onto plan sheets to quickly reference relevant info.
~~~~~ Heavy Civil Focused ~~~~~
CALCULATIONS & QUANTITIES
Save time and money with effortless calculations, right in your app. 
• Accurately determine volume, tonnage, trucking, and more with built-in, heavy civil calculators.
• No more guessing — report true quantities rather than eyeballing.
• Supports both horizontal and vertical measurements for profile views.
REAL-TIME LOCATION SERVICES
No other digital plans solution provides this level of location services for your construction sites.
• Easily locate yourself on the plans sheet, even in a green field, without a survey crew.
• Catch issues early by walking the site to identify any obstacles that may not be accounted for in drawings.
• Auto-pin photos in the exact place they were taken to more clearly communicate issues or work progress.
SHEET OVERLAYS
Overlay sheets to gain a more comprehensive view of your project.
• Stack related sheets, such as electrical and sewer, to verify there are no conflicts in the area before each stage of work.
• Stitch sheets over Apple Maps to see your plans in relation to existing structures in road or satellite view.
~~~~~ Smart Integrations ~~~~~
HCSS Plans is part of the HCSS suite, providing even more efficiency and accuracy across your teams. 
HeavyBid estimating software
• Takeoff integration: Import HCSS Plans takeoff quantities into HeavyBid.
• Easy reference: Link biditems and activities to relevant sheets for easy reference.
• Better collaboration: Instantly share estimators’ notes and calculations with your Operations team after winning the bid.
HeavyJob field entry & job management software
• Accurate quantities: Pull in sheet calculations for accurate production quantities without double entry.
• Quick reviews: Relevant sheets are one click away for easy quantity checks during web time card reviews.
• Issue alerts: Get notified when an issue is logged on a sheet, and elevate it to an RFI if necessary.

bluejetty:00022855:ios.description:
The Fear and Greed Bitcoin Index measures how scared or greedy investors are with respect to Bitcoin. By analyzing market sentiment, the index provides valuable insights into whether investors are bullish or bearish on Bitcoin. The index is updated daily and is displayed as a simple number between 0 and 100. A value of 0 indicates extreme fear, while a value of 100 indicates extreme greed. The Fear and Greed Bitcoin Index can be a useful tool for investors who are looking to gauge market sentiment and make informed investment decisions.
This index shows if the crypto market it's fear or greedy. To get this index, different key points are evaluated, like volatility, market volume, social media, dominance or trends. With all that data crunched, we obtain a single number that represents the Fear And Greed Index.
You will be able to:
- Set reminders to be the first to know the current index.
- Comment the current index.
- Check out the historical data. Filters of 30, 60, 90 or 180 days.
- Read bitcoin related news and check their sentiment.
- App for Apple Watch
Also you will be able to check the index from outside the app using the widget.
We obtain all the data from 'alternative.me'.
Thank you Satoshi Nakamoto.

bluejetty:00018972:ios.summary:

2. Commanding freely as if it became the admiral of the space fleet!
3. Online support (only offline play is possible)
4. Overwhelming graphics and sound effects to challeng
bluejetty:00018972:ios.description:
1. Easy! Space fleet warfare like SF movies with simple operation!
2. Commanding freely as if it became the admiral of the space fleet!
3. Online support (only offline play is possible)
4. Overwhelming graphics and sound effects to challenge the limits of smartphones!
After downloading Celestial Fleet, in just three minutes you can experience the powerful exhilaration of a 3D space fleet war!
With simple rules, powerful performance, and high-speed development as victory or defeat are decided in three to five minutes, this is a real-time strategy game (RTS) that has never been seen before. 
The game is made exciting through real-time 3D, and the power of non-stop animated performance while playing.
Due to perfect real-time 3D, this is surely a powerful space fleet battle masterpiece that will make you think it is not on a smartphone!
If you have the latest device, it is possible to play the powerful space war game with high-definition (HD) images.
While commanding a space fleet, aim for the annihilation of the enemy fleet and hold supremacy in the galaxy. 
While assessing the war situation, select the formation and direct the attack on the enemy fleet. 
Also supporting online matches, divide into two forces (federation and empire), and with the galaxy as your stage you can compete for power. 
Federation battleships and empire battleships each have their own features.
With the ingenuity of each other as weapons, one can compete with global rivals for strategy and tactics. 
Fleet battles, combined with a real-time system and a command-type turn system, are semi-RTS. 
Instant decisions about such things as the timing of attacks will determine victory or defeat. 
It is possible to enjoy a sense of urgency just like one was actually commanding a fleet war battlefield. 
As one has more victories, it is possible to get more powerful space battleships.
Discover your own way to organize the strongest space fleet, and your own way of fighting. 
As much as possible, eliminate the complex and cumbersome aspects of strategy, and focus on the tactical elements of organizing the fleet, strengthening the battleships, and battling with the fleet. 
If you have three to five minutes it is possible to play. Optimal for playing during a commute, etc. 
For mission bosses, such things are large fortresses, large bases, and the strongest large battleships are ready and waiting. 
- Features - 
(1) Breathtaking 3D action all in real time
(2) Visual effect controls to match the specifications of your device
(3) Awe-inspiring sound powered by the 3D audio system [OpenAL]
(4) Quick battles that develop rapidly (One battle will last approximately 1 minute). 
(5) Online battles
(6) Rankings
(7) Full support for iPad
(8) Offline mode
(9) Export logs to services such as YouTube, save screenshots
- Other -
This version will be the First Impression Version. 
The design, rules, and balance of the game may undergo significant changes later. 
Save data will be supported in newer versions. 
The First Impression Version has items on sale at discount prices! 
We will keep on adding new ships, missions, and other things to the game!

bluejetty:00103662:ios:1.name: WhatsApp Messenger
bluejetty:00103662:ios:1.description:
WhatsApp from Meta is a free messaging and calling app used by over 2 billion people across 180+ countries. It's super simple, reliable and private, making it perfect for staying in touch with your friends and family worldwide. WhatsApp works across mobile, tablet, and desktop even on slow connections, with no subscription fees*.
Private messaging and calls across the world
Your privacy is our priority. With end-to-end encryption, you can be sure that your personal messages and calls stay between you and who you send them to. And no one, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them.
Simple and secure connections, right away
All you need is your phone number - no usernames or logins needed. Easily view your contacts on WhatsApp and start messaging. And what's more, you can easily link your other devices, including iPads, for seamless connectivity.
High quality voice and video calls
Enjoy free, secure video and voice calls with up to 32 people for free. Your calls work across devices, even on slower connections, using your phone or tablet’s Internet service.
Group chats to keep you in contact
Stay close to friends and family through end-to-end encrypted group chats and calls. Share messages, photos, videos and documents across mobile, tablet, and desktop. You can also use call links and screen-sharing to make group calls and collaboration easy.
Stay connected in real time
You can share your location with those in your individual or group chats while using WhatsApp on your mobile phone. Or record a voice message for those moments when just text isn't good enough.
Share daily moments through Status
Share your everyday life with those who matter. With Status you can share text, photos, video, and GIF updates that disappear after 24 hours. You're always in control of who sees your status. Just choose who you want to share it with - all your contacts or selected ones. And bring your everyday to life.
*Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you have any feedback or questions, please go to WhatsApp > Settings > Help > Contact Us
Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service 
Learn more about messaging privately: https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy 
Learn more about WhatsApp safety: https://www.whatsapp.com/security

bluejetty:00086799:ios.name: KMI-IRM - Weather for Belgium
bluejetty:00086799:ios.summary:
The official Belgian weather forecast by the RMI
• Forecasts and observations for any Belgian commune
The local geographic particularities are taken into account in the forecasts.
• Hourly forecasts for the next 48 hours
Get the local for
bluejetty:00086799:ios.description:
The official Belgian weather forecast by the RMI
• Forecasts and observations for any Belgian commune
The local geographic particularities are taken into account in the forecasts.
• Hourly forecasts for the next 48 hours
Get the local forecast for any Belgian commune for temperature, precipitation, wind and atmospheric pressure.
• Daily forecasts for the next 7 days
 For any Belgian commune: minimum and maximum temperatures, wind, weather type and descriptive texts (only in NL or FR).
• 14 days of trends
Long term forecasts for day and night temperatures and precipitations.
• Radar: observations and rain forecasts
Observations and forecasts of precipitations per 10 minute time step for your favorite Belgian communes (up to 3 hours in advance).
• Daily notification of the weather forecast
Be prepared for the weather everyday
• Notifications of weather flashes
 In order to be informed from 10 minutes to maximum one hour in advance that intense rain or winter precipitations will happen 
• Meteorological warnings
Notification push in case of meteorological warnings: customizable for each province and for each warning level.
 • Pollen, UV, sunrise and sunset time
 • Send us your weather observations 
Take a look outside and share your current weather with everyone on a clickable map of Belgium 
• Widget
Keep an eye on the weather of your favorite commune with the widgets.
Dutch:
Het officieel Belgisch weerbericht van het KMI.
• Voorspellingen en waarnemingen voor elke Belgische gemeente
Met de lokale geografische kenmerken wordt rekening gehouden.
• Uurlijkse voorspellingen voor de komende 48 uur
Voor elke Belgische gemeente de lokale voorspellingen van de temperatuur, neerslaghoeveelheid, wind en luchtdruk.
• Dagelijkse voorspellingen voor de volgende 7 dagen
Voor elke gemeente de minimum- en maximumtemperatuur, wind, weertype en verklarende teksten.
• Trends tot 14 dagen
Langetermijnvoorspellingen van de maximum- en minimumtemperatuur en de neerslaghoeveelheid.
• Radar: waarneming en neerslagvoorspellingen
Waarnemingen en neerslagvoorspellingen per tijdsstap van 10 minuten voor uw favoriete gemeenten (tot 3 uur op voorhand).
• Dagelijkse melding van het weerbericht
Wees steeds voorbereid op de weersituatie.
• Meldingen van weerflashes
 Om van 10 minuten tot maximum één uur vooraf te informeren over de komst van intense neerslag of winterse neerslag 
• Meteorologische waarschuwingen
Push van de berichten bij meteorologische waarschuwingen: aan te passen per provincie en per waarschuwingsniveau.
• Pollen, uv-index, zonsopgang en -ondergang
• Widget
Hoe het weer voor jouw favorite gemeente steeds in het oog dankzij de wigdet.
French:
La météo belge officielle de l'IRM.
• Prévisions et observations par commune belge
Les spécificités géographiques locales sont prises en compte dans les prévisions.
• Prévisions horaires pour les prochaines 48 heures
Par commune, retrouvez les prévisions locales de température, précipitation, vent et pression atmosphérique.
• Prévisions journalières jusqu’à 7 jours
Par commune, température minimale, température maximale, vent, type de temps et textes explicatifs.
• Tendances jusque 14 jours
Prévisions à long terme des températures maximales et minimales et des précipitations.
• Radar: observations et prévisions de pluie
Observations et prévisions de pluie par pas de temps de 10 minutes pour vos communes favorites (jusqu'à 3 heures à l'avance).
• Notifications journalières de la météo
Soyez toujours prêt pour la météo du jour.
• Notifications des flashs météo
Afin de vous informer de l’arrivée de précipitations intenses ou de type hivernal dans les 10 à 30 minutes à maximum 1 heure à venir. 
• Avertissements météorologiques
Push des notifications lors d'avertissements météorologiques : paramétrable par province et niveau.
• Pollen, index UV, lever et coucher du soleil
• Widget
Gardez un oeil sur la météo de votre commune favorite grâce au widget.

You were looking forward to chilling this summer in NYC... but your plans have changed. Against your will, you’re sent to middle-of-nowhere-Kentucky, to spend the summer with your grandma on a horse farm.
You better make the most of it! Put on those cowgirl boots, style your new horse, and start racing like a champ! Watch out for southern belles - they're not all as sweet as they pretend to be. And enjoy spending time with the stable boy... ooh la la! 
Features:
> Make the most of the summer - become a horse racing champ!
> Train every day till you’re ready to compete in international horse races.
> Raise your horse. Feed him, groom him, dress him up in an eye-catching saddle. 
> Do farm chores. Too lazy? Too bad! Grams won’t let you off easy. Upgrade your farm and build new facilities.
> Get help perfecting your horse racing skills, from the sultry stable boy. (Is that LUUUURVE in the air?!)
> Do NOT let that prissy, snooty “champion” named Kaitlyn stand in your way - show her who’s the new champion in town!
> Compete in exciting horse racing competitions around the world! 
> Wow the crowd with your amazing jumps. 
> Climb the leaderboard and make your family proud!

bluejetty:00014878:ios.description:

bluejetty:00141931:ios.description:
Lock Master Secret Album is a versatile app that serves as a secure vault for hiding and storing your most private photos, videos, notes, files, contacts, and more. It also includes a private web browser that leaves no trace of your browsing history on your phone and allows you to save secret bookmarks within the app.
Features:
1. Save Your Secret Photos and Videos: Securely store and hide your personal photos and videos from prying eyes.
2. Write and Store Unlimited Private Notes: Keep your thoughts, plans, and secrets in private notes that only you can access.
3. Import and View Top-Secret Files: Import and view confidential files such as .doc, .ppt, .xls, and more from Windows and Mac.
4. Store Contacts You Don’t Want in Your Regular Address Book: Keep your private contacts separate from your main address book.
5.Save All Your Passwords in One Place: Manage and store all your passwords securely in one location.
6. Browse the Internet Without Leaving Any Traces: Use the built-in private web browser to surf the web without leaving any history on your phone. It also supports multiple tabs for convenient browsing.
7. Make Secret Website Bookmarks: Save your favorite websites as secret bookmarks within the app.
8. Fingerprint or Face Unlock (Requires iOS Device Support): Secure access to your private data using your fingerprint or face. This feature requires an iOS device that supports Touch ID or Face ID.
9. Easy toolkit: Flashlight and Calculator in toolkit box for quick access.
Lock Master Secret Album offers a discreet and secure way to protect your privacy and personal data.

bluejetty:00108163:android.summary:
IMPORTANT: Before you use this app, please see the tutorial video on how to use it. 
- https://youtu.be/I9X7u_z0JCA
In industry the PLC is the most important automation device because of its role as the brain in running industrial processe
bluejetty:00108163:android.description:
IMPORTANT: Before you use this app, please see the tutorial video on how to use it. 
- https://youtu.be/I9X7u_z0JCA
In industry the PLC is the most important automation device because of its role as the brain in running industrial processes. This brain uses a syntax to be able perform tasks in an orderly, sequential manner.
The native language of the PLC is called “ladder logic”. Ladder logic is graphical, in that it can be laid out in a form that resembles a ladder with rails and rungs. Ladder logic diagrams were developed originally from relay-circuit diagrams that were used for electronic circuitry prior to the advent of PLCs. 
PLC Ladder Simulator is a simulator for the Android operating system with input and output objects that simulate the I/O ports of a real PLC. You can used PLC Ladder Simulator to create ladder-logic diagrams using components from the standard set used in these diagrams.
PLC Ladder Simulator features an unique option available in the world and it's the possibility of program an Arduino board with a ladder design using an Android phone. So actually what it does is that transforms an Arduino into a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller). The app writes a code into the Arduino by using an USB OTG cable or a Bluetooth module.
The Arduino mode it's compatible with the Arduino UNO (atmega328) and the M5Stack ESP32.
Note: This app doesn't work in tablets, only for Android phones, you can try it if you want to. 
It doesn't work in some Samsung Galaxy Tab 4.
To ensure the possibility that the app works on your device, follow the example in the video tutorial.
Video Tutorial (english): https://youtu.be/I9X7u_z0JCA
PLC Ladder Simulator Website: http://plcladdersimulator.weebly.com/
If you have any question or problem, you can contact me at: casdata@gmail.com

bluejetty:00021074:ios.name: Sleep Music Alarm
bluejetty:00021074:ios.summary:
Wake up to your favorite YouTube videos and Apple Music songs.
Sleep Music Alarm is an alarm clock, sleep timer, and sleep tracker in one app. Fall asleep to music or sleep sounds from YouTube and Apple Music, then see how you slept — no A
bluejetty:00021074:ios.description:
Wake up to your favorite YouTube videos and Apple Music songs.
Sleep Music Alarm is an alarm clock, sleep timer, and sleep tracker in one app. Fall asleep to music or sleep sounds from YouTube and Apple Music, then see how you slept — no Apple Watch required.
Your alarm rings even in Silent Mode and switches to a backup sound if streaming fails. Wake-up missions like math problems and step counting help heavy sleepers get out of bed. Downloaded over 1,000,000 times worldwide.
WAKE UP YOUR WAY
– Use YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists, or a channel’s latest video as your alarm sound
– Apple Music, imported songs, and your own recordings work too
– Shuffle for a different song or video every morning
– Fade in gently, or turn up the volume for heavy sleepers
– Hear the current time and your alarm memo read aloud
SLEEP SOUNDS & SLEEP TIMER
– Fall asleep to YouTube or Apple Music, and let the sleep timer stop playback
– Keep playing in Picture in Picture, even on the Home Screen or Lock Screen
– Dim the screen to reduce glare and battery use
WAKE-UP MISSIONS
– Pedometer: the alarm rings again if you don’t walk enough steps after stopping it
– Math (Easy or Hard), Color Match, Whack-a-Mole, and Rolling Ball
– Shake, Squats, Torso Twist, Enter Passcode, or a random mission
SLEEP TRACKING
– Estimates Awake, REM, Core, and Deep sleep from your movement
– Edit records, view trends in charts, and save to Apple Health (optional)
SMART ALARM
– Wakes you during REM sleep or when you’re already stirring, within your chosen window
– Set the window from 5 to 60 minutes before your alarm
– With Apple Watch, heart rate is used too
RELIABLE ALARMS
– AlarmKit Assist (iOS 26+): a backup system alarm in case the app closes unexpectedly
FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING
– Repeat on weekdays, weekends, or custom days
– Skip public holidays in over 100 countries
– Set alarms for sunrise or sunset
– Snooze from 1 to 60 minutes
– Group alarms, such as Weekdays and Weekends, and turn a whole group on or off
– See today’s calendar events after you stop the alarm
TIMER
– Multiple timers for cooking, studying, workouts, naps, and more
– Use YouTube or Apple Music as the timer sound
– Group timers and start, pause, or reset them together
– Log labeled timers to Activity History
FOCUS TIMER (POMODORO)
– Alternate focus and breaks with presets like 25/5 minutes × 4 sets, or set your own
– Use YouTube or Apple Music from the Clock screen as background music
– Get alerts by vibration, voice, or notification
– Track how often you pick up your phone and for how long
– Label each set and log focus time to Activity History
– See your focus time and completed sets after each session
– Get warned in advance if an alarm or timer overlaps your session
STOPWATCH
– Track lap and split times, and save them to Activity History with a label
– Hear elapsed time announced at a set interval, such as every minute
ACTIVITY HISTORY
– See time from the Timer, Focus Timer, and Stopwatch in one place
– Organize with custom labels and categories
– View totals for today, this week, and this month, with breakdowns and daily charts
– Set weekly or monthly goals and track your progress
WIDGETS & LIVE ACTIVITIES
– Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
– Live Activities on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
PREMIUM
Most features are free. With Premium, you can also:
– Remove all ads
– See current weather plus hourly and 10-day forecasts
– Auto-stop alarms
– Stop alarms without unlocking your iPhone
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC. Sleep Music Alarm is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.
Terms of Use: https://alarmclock.jp/en/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://alarmclock.jp/en/privacy.html

bluejetty:00119652:ios.description:
Tax Calc Aussie - Australia's easiest income tax and take-home pay calculator.
No myGov. No myID. No login. No account. Just type in your salary and see your income tax, take-home pay and estimated refund in seconds.
WHAT YOU GET
- Take-home pay shown daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly and yearly
- Income tax, Medicare levy and the tax-free threshold, worked out for you
- Medicare levy surcharge, including spouse and dependants
- HELP/HECS and SFSS study loan repayments
- Superannuation shown alongside your pay
- Salary sacrifice
- Dividend income with refundable franking credits
- Seniors and pensioners tax offset (SAPTO)
- An estimated tax refund for the year
- Switch between financial years to compare
HOW IT WORKS
Type in your salary. Pick your pay period. That's it - no sign-up, no linking accounts, no verification codes sent to a phone you no longer own, no waiting on hold.
COMMON QUESTIONS
How much tax will I pay on my salary in Australia?
Enter your annual salary and Tax Calc Aussie shows your income tax, Medicare levy and take-home pay for the current Australian financial year.
What is my take-home pay after tax?
The app shows your net pay daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly and yearly, so you can see exactly what lands in your bank account each payday.
Do I need a myGov or ATO account to use this?
No. Tax Calc Aussie asks for a salary figure and nothing else. There is no login, no account, and no personal details required.
Does it include HECS/HELP and the Medicare levy?
Yes. Study loan repayments (HELP/HECS and SFSS), the Medicare levy and the Medicare levy surcharge are all included, and each can be toggled to match your situation.
Can it handle salary sacrifice and dividends?
Yes. You can enter salary sacrifice amounts and dividend income with refundable franking credits, and see how each changes your result.
Will it estimate my tax refund?
Yes. Alongside your payslip breakdown, the app shows an estimated annual tax position so you can see whether you're likely to get money back.
Is it up to date?
Yes - rates are updated for the current Australian tax year, including 2026-27, and you can switch financial years to compare.
WHO IT'S FOR
Employees checking a payslip, anyone weighing up a job offer or a pay rise, contractors and sole traders estimating what they'll owe, retirees with franked dividends, and anyone budgeting around their real take-home pay rather than their headline salary.
FREE AND PAID
Tax Calc Aussie is free to use and supported by ads. A single one-off in-app purchase removes ads for good - there is no subscription.
Disclaimer:
This calculator provides general estimates only. Your actual tax outcome may differ based on your personal circumstances and details this app cannot capture.
Questions/feedback: help@lamigsoftware.com
Privacy Policy: https://lamigsoftware.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://lamigsoftware.com/terms

bluejetty:00085724:ios.summary: Con Certificado Digital FNMT podrás obtener tu certificado electrónico de la Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre de forma cómoda y segura. En tan solo unos pocos clics habrás completado todo el proceso para obtener tu certificado en tu disp
bluejetty:00085724:ios.description:
Con Certificado Digital FNMT podrás obtener tu certificado electrónico de la Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre de forma cómoda y segura. En tan solo unos pocos clics habrás completado todo el proceso para obtener tu certificado en tu dispositivo móvil.
Certificado Digital incluye el nuevo sistema de vídeo-identificación “Identifícate estés donde estés”, que permite realizar la solicitud del certificado totalmente online de forma rápida, segura y sin desplazamientos. Con este nuevo servicio no necesitarás desplazarte a una oficina de registro. ¡Ahora puedes hacerlo todo desde tu dispositivo móvil!
No obstante, si así lo deseas, siempre puedes acudir a una oficina de registro presencial para acreditar tu identidad de forma totalmente gratuita.
Adicionalmente, tienes a tu disposición a nuestro equipo de soporte para ayudarte en caso de que tengas algún problema o consulta. Puedes contactar con nosotros a través de la cuenta soporteceres@fnmt.es.
Los certificados electrónicos que expide la Fábrica Nacional de Moneda y Timbre para toda la ciudadanía tienen una duración de 4 años. Durante todo ese tiempo podrás utilizar tu certificado digital para realizar tus trámites electrónicos de forma ágil, segura y sin desplazamientos.
Además, puedes tener la tranquilidad de que tus datos, imágenes y videos serán custodiados con total garantía de seguridad.
¡Descarga la App de Certificado Digital y empieza a simplificar tus trámites administrativos!
Para obtener tu certificado a través de la lectura de tu DNIe, simplemente abre la app, pulsa sobre "Solicitud Certificado Digital" y selecciona la opción "Lectura de DNIe". De esta forma podrás obtener tu certificado electrónico de forma rápida, sencilla y gratuita.
¿Cómo funciona?
Para obtener un certificado a través del escaneo NFC de tu DNI, sigue estos pasos:
1. Abre la app.
2. Selecciona la opción "Solicitud Certificado Digital".
3. Selecciona la opción "Lectura DNIe"
4. Sigue las instrucciones que aparecerán en tu dispositivo para hacer la lectura de tu DNI.
5. Podrás obtener tu certificado de forma inmediata y gratuita.
Requisitos
Para acceder a esta funcionalidad, se requiere tener un documento de identidad electrónico (con una versión actualizada) con los certificados activos, saber el código PIN asociado y un dispositivo móvil compatible con tecnología NFC.

Key Features of Mix VPN:
1. Strict no-logs policy:
Mix VPN ensures your browsing history and personal data are never logged or collected.
2. Multi-hop function:
Utilize sequences of servers to enhance your anonymity and security online. Our AI-based server selection feature intelligently chooses servers based on real-time channel conditions specific to your current location.

Kill-switch feature automatically blocks internet traffic if the VPN connection drops, ensuring your data remains protected.
4. Impressive speed:
Benefit from high connection speeds across our VPN servers.

We employ the IKEv2 protocol to maximize your online data security.

bluejetty:00066187:ios.description:
LEAD YOUR MARCHING BAND… AND MAKE THE MUSIC COME ALIVE!
Become the conductor of your own parade! Choose the instruments, place the musicians, and start the march: every movement creates a sound, every change transforms the music. Speed up, slow down, mix things up… your band follows your lead, and the melody reinvents itself instantly!
Pango Musical March is an interactive musical experience where every action your child takes generates rhythm, coordination, and creativity. A simple, intuitive, and joyful way to explore music from the age of 3 — with no pressure, no rules, just the pleasure of discovery.
An engaging and sensory game, perfectly designed for small hands: ideal for developing listening skills, expression, and imagination.
A PANGO SIGNATURE CELEBRATED WORLDWIDE
For more than 15 years, Pango has been creating educational, intuitive, and accessible games, chosen by over 15 million children around the world.
Pango Musical March continues this ambition: a unique musical game designed to develop listening, rhythm, expression, and artistic awareness from an early age.
WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO MUSICAL MARCH
- Develops listening, rhythm, and coordination
- Encourages experimentation and free expression
- Features 40 instruments and 4 musical styles for endless variety
- Sparks creativity with music that reacts in real time
- Simple, smooth interface perfectly suited for little hands
- A calming, stress-free experience with no pressure or challenges
(And for full immersion, headphones are recommended!)
A 100% SAFE ENVIRONMENT FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases
• No ads
• No external links
• Built-in parental controls
• Compliant with children’s privacy regulations
THE PANGO PHILOSOPHY: PLAY, EXPLORE, GROW
At Pango, we design experiences from a child’s perspective: simple, creative, and caring.
Our mission? To spark curiosity, encourage independence, and offer joyful moments full of emotions and discovery.
Need help or have a question?
pango@studio-pango.com
More info: www.studio-pango.com
DOWNLOAD PANGO MUSICAL MARCH and let your child create, conduct, and transform their own marching band: ONE STEP, ONE SOUND… LET THE MUSIC BEGIN!

bluejetty:00131323:ios.description:
Organize. Connect. Reflect - and Get Hired.
#1 shift calendar app and social networking for nurses!
Take control of your schedule by balancing work and personal life like never before. NurseGrid™ lets you take control of your career with on-the-go access to organize your work, discover new job opportunities, and manage individual events. Stay connected to nursing friends through your phone or smartwatch, and share your calendar with friends, family, and colleagues.
NurseGrid is used by 1 in 8 US nurses!
Every day, nurses across the country trust NurseGrid to:
- Carry their work calendar everywhere they go
- Swap shifts with other nurses
- Compare calendars with colleagues for swaps or off-duty plans
- See who they are working with before their shift
- Signal availability for additional shifts, swaps, and flex-offs
- Manage shift calendar at multiple worksites
- Add personal calendar for better life management
- Discover new job opportunities
- Send group and private messages to colleagues
- Share your shift schedule with family and friends
… and much more!
The NurseGrid Apple Watch app lets you see your calendar, shift details and available swaps. It's now even easier to connect with your schedule, wherever and whenever you need it.
Now available on Apple Watch
- View Shifts weekly
- View Shift details
- View Available Swaps and Giveaways
- Pick up Open Shifts
Getting started is easy. Find help documentation and support right in the app! ("Me" tab - "Help Center")
We'd love to hear how we can help you restore your nurse life balance. Contact us at support@nursegrid.com.

bluejetty:00187122:ios.summary: If you are a personal fitness trainer and looking for an online personal training app that can help you to train and manage all of your clients in one single place then you are at the right place. Welcome to TrainerFu: The Ultimate Online P
bluejetty:00187122:ios.description:
If you are a personal fitness trainer and looking for an online personal training app that can help you to train and manage all of your clients in one single place then you are at the right place. Welcome to TrainerFu: The Ultimate Online Personal Training App that helps personal trainers train, manage, engage, and stay connected with their clients. Whether you’re running online boot camps or offering one-on-one personal training, TrainerFu personal trainer app gives you the flexibility to scale your fitness business to new heights, while keeping your clients engaged and focused towards achieving their goals.
Say goodbye to emails, spreadsheets, or paper forms. Use our powerful App for personal trainers to create workout plans, track client progress, log assessments, share fitness tips, maintain fitness diary, and more. TrainerFu online personal training app is available on all devices, so you can train your clients, engage them, and keep a tab on their progress, whether you’re at the gym or on the go.
USE TRAINERFU ONLINE PERSONAL TRAINING APP TO:
• Supercharge workout programming. Create workout plans at 3.5x faster speed than spreadsheets or emails. Save more than 100 hours of programming time per year!
• Write programs once, and reuse them forever. Get your clients quickly started on their training plan by reusing pre-created workout or plan templates. 
• Eliminate all guesswork. Use our pre-loaded 1500+ workouts video library to build highly interactive workout plans for your clients. 
• Get rid of follow-up emails. Track the real-time progress of all your clients from a single dashboard, and keep them accountable for achieving their goals. 
• Log workout progress. Track the assigned workouts with highly-specific workout details (sets, weights, supersets, etc.), and automatically log them in a fitness diary. 
• Maximize client motivation. Motivate clients to push harder by interacting with them directly on the TrainerFu newsfeed. 
• Offer group training. Categorize clients into groups, and create a workout plan with just a single tap. Perfect for running boot camps or corporate wellness programs.
• Know what they’re eating. TrainerFu integrates with popular meal-logging services, like, MyFitnessPal and Fitbit to provide you with detailed macro-level insights into your client’s eating habits. 
• Keep personal training personal. Give real-time feedback to your clients from the app using automated real-time messaging. 
• Integrate online personal training. Running an online boot camp on your website? Use Zapier to push new signups directly into TrainerFu, and get them started on their personal training program, with just a few taps. 
• Never lose your data. All your workout programs or fitness logs are stored in the cloud, so they’re available forever, even if you switch devices or platforms. 
SUBSCRIBE TO TRAINERFU ONLINE PERSONAL TRAINING APP’s PRO PLANS:
In the free version of our personal trainer app, access to features is limited. To use our online personal training app with its full potential subscribe to our TrainerFu personal trainer app's pro plans and get full and unlimited access to all features.
DOWNLOAD TRAINERFU ONLINE PERSONAL TRAINING APP TODAY!
So what are you waiting for Download and Install Now TrainerFu Personal Trainer app for FREE. Level up your training business and Earn 3X more revenue with the help of our online personal training app
=====
TrainerFu offer two type of subscription plans:
* Free: This plan is totally free. With this plan you can add up to 2 clients.
* Premium plans: The pricing for these plans depends on the number of clients you want to add to your account.
======
Terms of service: [http://www.trainerfu.com/blog/terms/]
Privacy policy: [http://www.trainerfu.com/blog/privacy/]
