bluejetty:00145832:ios.description:
Experience Moody Radio in your all-in-one destination for uplifting Christian music, devotional programming, powerful preaching, and the latest news from the Christian community. Since 1926, Moody Radio, emanating from WMBI 90.1 FM in Chicago and part of the college of the Moody Bible Institute legacy founded by D. L. Moody, has been a leader in Christian radio, bringing the good news of Jesus Christ to listeners worldwide.
Key Features:
• LISTEN TO YOUR FAVORITE MOODY RADIO PROGRAMS: If you love radio programs checkout our top daily and weekly programs like In the Market with Janet Parshall, Open Line with Michael Rydelnik, Bold Steps with Dr. Mark Jobe, In the Market with Janet Parshall, Chris Fabry Live, A Love Language Minute with Dr. Gary Chapman, Ed Stetzer Live, Faith & Finance Live with Rob West, Equipped with Chris Brooks, & Today’s Single Christian
• LISTEN TO YOUR FAVORITE MOODY RADIO MUSIC STATIONS LIKE: The Praise and Worship Channel, Majesty Radio, Urban Praise, our 24/7 Spanish radio station “Radio Moody”, and our seasonal offering “The Music of Christmas”
• ENGAGE WITH THE COMMUNITY AT LOCAL STATIONS LIKE: Karl and Crew Mornings - Chicago/Network, Kurt and Kate Mornings - Florida, Mornings with Brian - Cleveland, Mornings with Eric and Brigitte - South Florida, Mornings with Kelli and Steve - Indiana, Mornings with Seth and Deb - Quad Cities, Mornings with Tom and Tabi - Chattanooga, and Perry and Shawna Mornings - Grand Rapids
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR LISTENING EXPERIENCE: Tailor the Moody Radio app by favoriting your favorite on-demand radio programs, podcasts, music stations, and by setting your own local station
• GET NOTIFIED WHEN A NEW EPISODE OF YOUR FAVORITE PODCAST COMES OUT: with the Moody Radio app you can subscribe to and customize your push notification experience for your favorite podcasts so that you can always stay in the loop about the latest content from Moody Radio.
• SEE WHAT'S SCHEDULED ON AIR FROM THE APP: access what programing is up next on your favorite station by checking out our “Schedule” calendar in the Moody Radio app
• GET CONNECTED WITH YOUR FAVORITE PROGRAMS: quickly access the community calendar, email, phone number, mail address, Facebook page, and X (formerly Twitter) page, of your favorite station or program through the “Connect” and “Contact” features within the Moody Radio app
• SEAMLESS CAR INTEGRATION: Enjoy the ease of listening through Apple Carplay, making it simple to take your faith on the road
• FREE AND EASY TO USE: Dive into a world of Christian Streaming without any cost. This free app is user-friendly and accessible to use at any time
Moody Radio is a Christian radio network that helps you take the next step in your journey with Jesus Christ by creating and delivering practical and life-changing content. We proclaim the Word to all cultures and generations by addressing today's issues from a biblical worldview.
Checkout more content from Moody Radio at moodyradio.org
We are constantly looking to improve and make the Moody Radio experience even better for our listeners. Share your thoughts and suggestions at problemslistening@moody.edu

The goal is simple: Help students maximize their scores on the AP exam in a FUN w
bluejetty:00200049:ios.description:
iScore5™ APHG is a test prep app to get students ready for the AP® Human Geography exam. The app created by EXPERT teachers for AP Human Geography Students.
The goal is simple: Help students maximize their scores on the AP exam in a FUN way. Everything is designed like a trivia game for students, with running scores, leaderboards, bonus and double bonus rounds. Plus, you have the ability to unlock levels as you progress through levels of learning.
iScore5 APHG has two major components. First, there is a practice vocabulary section that contains the MOST important terms from EVERY unit from the class. 
Our second component is where the FUN begins. 5 levels of multiple-choice questions that you must unlock as you score points. These questions come from each AP Human Geography unit. Level 1 has easier questions and level 5 contains the most challenging. As you move through the levels, your learning improves. 
Don’t worry about the quality of these questions! All of the question writers are experienced expert AP Human Geography Teachers or Geography College Professors. They know about the class and they know what types of questions to ask to prepare you for the AP exam. 
But remember, they know you WANT TO HAVE FUN while you learn! 
Think about it. Stop carrying all that review stuff. The best reason we have for the app is when your mom sees you on your phone you can say, “I AM STUDYING FOR THE AP HUMAN GEOGRAPHY EXAM!”
Highlights:
A running scoreboard 
A leaderboard to see how you do against other students
A paperless way to prepare for the AP Human Geography exam
21st century learning and gaming

bluejetty:00135288:ios.description:
Evaluate your health with BalanceMe! Your heart rate serves as a crucial health indicator. Utilize BalanceMe, a pulse checker and heart rate monitor, to measure and assess your stress and anxiety levels. This tool allows you to track not only your heart rate but also your stress, anxiety, and mood. It's a valuable resource for analyzing stress levels and maintaining a vigilant eye on your overall health.
Before You Start Health Disclaimer
1. This application is designed for health purposes and is intended to promote health awareness and relieve stress.
2. Please avoid using this application for the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of any medical condition. It is not a substitute for specialized medical equipment or expert medical guidance.
3. Please note that the measurement functionality is designed to measure heart rate. Other health indicators, such as blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen levels, can be logged and tracked, but cannot be measured.
4. If you have any health-related concerns, always consult a certified medical professional before making a decision or following any advice.
Measuring Heart Rate: Guide to Accurate Results Acquisition
1. Hold your phone gently, maintaining a calm and relaxed state.
2. Use your fingertip to completely cover the rear camera.
3. Stay still throughout the entire measuring process until it's completed.
Main Features:
1. Heart Rate Monitor: Track your heart rate in real-time, enabling continuous monitoring of your cardiovascular health during diverse activities.
2. AI-Powered Health Guidance: Leverage a GPT-driven health advisor offering personalized recommendations based on your health data and preferences, aiding you in making informed choices for a healthier lifestyle.
3. Blood Pressure, Glucose, and Oxygen Tracker: Track your blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen levels over time. Monitor trends in these health indicators and visualize the changes with easy-to-read charts, helping you stay informed about your health.
4. Daily Emotion and Mood Tracker: Record and analyze your daily emotions and moods to recognize patterns and triggers that may influence your overall health and well-being.
5. Comprehensive Health Reports: Generate detailed reports using the collected data, offering in-depth insights into your health trends, patterns, and potential health risks.
6. Valuable Health Tips and Insights: Access a thoughtfully curated collection of health tips and articles, delivering valuable information on sustaining a healthy lifestyle and making informed health-related choices.
7. Calming Meditation: Access guided meditation sessions to promote relaxation, alleviate stress, and improve overall mental well-being.
Subscription Options: Weekly/ Monthly/ Yearly
1. Upon confirmation of purchase, the payment will be charged to your iTunes Account.
2. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off automatic renewal in your Account Settings after purchasing.
3. If you don't opt out of auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period ends, your subscription will be automatically renewed.
You can use the app several times a day, especially when you wake up in the morning, go to bed, feel stressed, or exercise. BalanceMe gives you the tools to make informed decisions about your heart health. Don't hesitate to download it now!

bluejetty:00186765:ios.description:
Daily Brain Training is designed to make brain workouts easy and enjoyable—just like playing a game. From classic exercises such as math problems and memory tests to unique game-style challenges, you can enjoy a wide variety of brain-training activities.
Use it for brain anti-aging, mental warm-ups before studying, or simply to keep your mind sharp every day.
Each training session takes only a short time, making it perfect for quick breaks or spare moments. New features and training modes will continue to be added regularly.
◆ App Features
1. Adaptive Difficulty System
Get all questions correct and the difficulty level increases automatically.
Train at the level that best matches your brain and keep improving.
2. Multiple User Profiles
Save scores and levels separately within the app.
Perfect for families who want to share the app while keeping individual records.
3. Wide Variety of Training Modes
Enjoy around 50 different types of brain-training games across multiple genres—from basic arithmetic to memory challenges. See the full list below.
4. Daily Test
Complete three randomly selected training sessions in a row and record your total score.
5. Brain Training Calendar
Track your activity at a glance.
A stamp appears on days you train, making it easy to see your consistency. The more training you complete in a day, the bigger and more impressive your stamp becomes.
6. Daily Recall
Answer questions and recall your answers the next day to train your memory every day.
7. Puzzle Game: Drop Block
Line up blocks to clear them in this fun puzzle mode.
How many can you clear before the screen fills up?
◆ Training List
-Continuous Calculation: Simple addition, subtraction, and multiplication
-Card Memory: Memorize numbers on cards and select them in ascending order
-Number Crossroads: Calculate the total of numbers flowing from four directions
-Shape Touch: Tap only the instructed shapes
-Calculation 40: Extended calculation practice
-After-You Rock-Paper-Scissors: Choose your move according to instructions
-Operator Fill: Insert arithmetic symbols into equations
-Color Judgment: Judge the meaning of a word versus its display color
-Word Memory: Memorize words within 20 seconds
-Fraction Check: Select the correct fraction size
-Shape Recognition: Identify whether a shape matches the previous one
-Find the Unique Number: Spot the number that appears only once
-Number Comparison: Decide if a number is higher or lower than the previous
-Find the Identical Shape: Find the one identical figure
-Number Order Touch: Tap numbers in sequence
-Memory Calculation: Memorize a number, solve a problem, then recall it
-Black Box: Calculate totals of numbers entering and exiting a box
-Maximum Value Touch: Tap the largest number displayed
-Playing Card Math: Solve math problems using playing cards
-Odd Shape: Find the shape that doesn’t fit
-Sequence Fill: Complete number or letter sequences
-Silhouette Box: Identify the remaining silhouette
-Shape Pair: Match shapes by color or form
-Concentration (Memory Match): Memorize and match card pairs
-Reverse Order Touch: Tap letters in reverse alphabetical order
-Arrow Input: Tap arrows in the correct numbered order
-Pitch Test: Listen to sounds and select the correct key
-Quick Reaction: Tap quickly when the correct symbol appears
-Make 10!: Fill in numbers to total 10
-Instant Number Memory: Memorize briefly displayed number sequences
-Ladder Game: Find the correct starting point to reach the target
-Rotating Cube: Memorize silhouettes on a rotating cube
-Long Calculation: Solve long-form equations
-Number Guess: Deduce hidden numbers from symbols
-Cup Shuffle: Track the hidden ball under moving cups
-Spot Odd: Spot the picture from a different category
-Catch the Targets: Use the buttons to move and collect all the specified shapes
-Column Method: Column calculation training exercise with carrying and borrowing
-Mini Sudoku: Exercise for solving small-sized Sudoku puzzles
...and More!

bluejetty:00043221:ios.description:
ikman is Sri Lanka's largest online marketplace where you can buy and sell absolutely anything! No more physical visits to markets or shops; now you can simply download the ikman app and find just the product or service you're looking for. From brand-new and used vehicles to mobiles phones, laptops, TVs, cameras and everything in between, ikman offers thousands of great deals in 50+ categories. What's more, you can also find property for rent and sale, and apply for jobs in Sri Lanka and overseas. 
ikman is one of Sri Lanka's fastest growing apps with over 5 millions downloads and 400,000+ listings of a wide variety of products and services that cater to millions of buyers islandwide. 
Here’s why the ikman app is so popular:
• Great in-app experience
• Wide selection across various categories
• Post an ad in just 2 mins
• Fast ad approvals
• Generate instant cash by selling new/used items
• Discover thousands of products and services nearby
• Optimized search and filters for a hassle-free shopping experience
With the ikman app you can:
• Browse thousands of local ads in Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Kurunegala, and more 
• Search by category, location and keywords to find just what you're looking for
• Connect with verified sellers with a single tap and start making great deals
• Chat with sellers directly for negotiations and more info
• Pin your favourite ads 
• Promote ads by using ‘Bump Up’ & ‘Top Ad’ options
• Find all categories seamlessly combined on one platform
• Post ads fast and for free, from your phone
• Manage all your ads in one place
• Save on data usage with our data-saving mode
Shop in categories such as:
Mobiles
‣ Find new and secondhand mobile phones posted by genuine sellers of all brands such as Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Sony, Huawei, Oppo, Vivo, Nokia, OnePlus and many more
‣ Call or chat with sellers to get the best deals
‣ Raise some quick cash by selling a used mobile phone - all you have to do is click a few photos of the phone, post an ad on ikman. You’ll attract plenty of serious buyers in no time!
Electronics
‣ Buy and sell brand new and used tablets, laptops, cameras, TVs, video games, gaming consoles, audio gear, lighting, refrigerators, washing machines and more
‣ Compare prices
‣ Find accessories such as cases, headphones, adapters, etc.
Cars & Vehicles
‣ Buy and sell brand-new and used cars, motorcycles, scooters, trucks, buses, vans, boats and heavy duty vehicles 
‣ Browse a wide selection of car types such as Saloon, Hatchback, SUV, 4X4, Station Wagon, Coupe Sports and MPV
‣ Compare prices and search for vehicles from popular brands such as Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Kia, Mitsubishi, etc.
‣ Filter your search by the vehicle's condition, model year, mileage, etc.
‣ Find parts and accessories for your vehicles
Property
‣ Buy, sell and rent your property through ikman
‣ Search for houses, apartments, land and commercial property
‣ Compare prices and property size
Jobs
‣ Find job vacancies in Sri Lanka and overseas
‣ Post job offers for your organization
‣ Search for full-time, part-time or contractual jobs and internships
‣ Browse through offers in the marketing, sales, IT, admin and customer service sectors
Sign up for a free account and start selling! Follow these 5 quick steps to post your ad:
First, snap some good photos of your item.
• Step 1: Click on the POST YOUR AD button
• Step 2: Login to your account with Google, Facebook or Email
• Step 3: Choose the right category
• Step 4: Fill in the required information
• Step 5: Upload the photos
Become a member on ikman, set up your own online shop and start selling instantly!
Download the free app now and make the most of the island's largest marketplace.

bluejetty:00041560:ios.summary:
The GoodSAM Responder App is a professional deployment system used by Emergency Services around the world and the National Health Service in the UK.
GoodSAM provides a range of solutions connecting those with specific skill sets to those i
bluejetty:00041560:ios.description:
The GoodSAM Responder App is a professional deployment system used by Emergency Services around the world and the National Health Service in the UK.
GoodSAM provides a range of solutions connecting those with specific skill sets to those in need, for example:
- GoodSAM Cardiac: This system is used by ambulance services to alert those trained in resuscitation (e.g. off duty paramedics, nurses, doctors, police and fire staff) to those nearby who are likely to be in cardiac arrest. This system has saved many lives around the world.
- GoodSAM Volunteer Response: GoodSAM is a platform used by the NHS and 3rd sector organisation such as the Royal Voluntary Service and British Red Cross to deploy volunteers to those in need. At the current time this is coordinating the 750,000 NHS Volunteers to help those isolated in the Coronavirus crisis.
- GoodSAM Pro: This is a professional dispatch system for community first responders and the emergency services.
The App utilises the latest in location technology and has many advanced features including a built in “radio” (Buzz) function so you can communicate with surrounding colleagues.
The GoodSAM platform has saved hundreds of lives and helped many thousands of people around the world. If you can help your community, please download the App and register under your parent organisation (or get your parent organisation on board if they are not on!).
Visit www.goodsamapp.org for more information.
Please download the App and join our global community. 
Our Apps rely on location services for navigation and position updates. Please note continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00099378:ios.description:
In Block Fortress 2 you’re not just a soldier, you’re an architect of destruction! Build towering bases, train your army, and prepare for all-out war! Place walls, turrets, traps, and tons of other mechanized defenses to build your base. Deploy an army of specialized soldiers and robots. Then gear up from a massive arsenal of guns and equipment to join the fight to defend your stronghold! Put your skills as a builder, commander, and fighter to the test as you try to fend off the relentless enemies of the Blockverse!
Features
• A unique mix of block-building, tower defense, and FPS/TPS gameplay!
• Complete freedom to build your base however you want, from towering fortresses, to sprawling castles!
• Team up with your friends in co-op multiplayer! Play the campaign, create and complete missions, and build in sandbox mode together!
• Build more than 200 different block types, including powerful turrets, shield generators, farms, land mines, teleporters, zip lines, and more! 
• Equip your character with tons of weapons and items, including a rocket launcher, mini-gun, plasma rifle, jet pack, and more!
• Choose and deploy an army of specialized soldiers and robots to help you fight!
• Survive a dynamic day and night cycle, severe weather, lava, acid, alien monsters, and other environmental hazards!
• Several game modes, including sandbox, missions, and survival
• Extensive mission builder allows you to create and share your own levels!
• 15 different planet biomes to conquer, each with their own hazards!
• Take a break from combat and get creative building a home on your command ship
• Upload and share your creations and download others!
We truly respect your time and support, and we hope you enjoy Block Fortress 2! If you have any questions, suggestions, or need help, please contact us at info@foursakenmedia.com

bluejetty:00145346:ios.description:
Track work hours, projects, and billable time in one place. Clockify is a time tracking and timesheet app used by individuals, teams, and businesses to track work, manage projects, and understand how time is spent. Start the timer, fill out timesheets, and generate reports with a free plan.
TIME TRACKING
Track time using a timer or add hours manually. Categorize work by project, task, or client so that your work hours stay organized.
TIMESHEETS
Fill out weekly timesheets and keep track of all work hours in one place. Submit timesheets for approval and review tracked time across projects.
PROJECT AND BILLABLE TIME
Track time spent on projects and mark hours as billable or non-billable. This helps individuals and teams understand project costs and earnings.
REPORTS
Analyze tracked time with summary, weekly, and detailed reports. Export reports to share them with clients or teams.
TEAM MANAGEMENT
Invite teammates, organize projects, and review team activity. Managers can also approve timesheets and monitor project progress.
WORK FROM ANYWHERE
Track time wherever work happens. Clockify works across mobile, desktop, and web, as well as a browser extension.
FREE PLAN AVAILABLE
Start with a FREE plan that includes unlimited time tracking, projects, and reporting.
ADVANCED FEATURES
Clockify also offers advanced capabilities, such as scheduling, time off management, expenses, invoicing, GPS location tracking, and team permissions.
Download the app and create an account for free, or log in using your existing details.

apple-macos:6448078074.name: Iconfactory Tapestry
apple-macos:6448078074.description:
Tapestry weaves your favorite blogs, social media, and more into a unified and chronological timeline.
⁕ The Web Your Way
Tapestry combines posts from your favorite social media services like Bluesky, Mastodon, Tumblr along with others like RSS feeds, podcasts, YouTube channels, and more. All of your content is presented in chronological order, with no algorithm deciding what you should or shouldn't see.
⁕ Join The Conversation
Compose new posts, reply to your friends, and read discussions on Bluesky or Mastodon right from inside of Tapestry. No need to switch to another app when you want to interact.
⁕ A Bird's Eye View
Tapestry makes it easier than ever to browse content from dozens or even hundreds of sources. Create custom timelines, seamlessly sync your reading position across devices, and keep track of feeds in an easy-to-read, color-coded stream of content.
⁕ Avoid Spoilers Everywhere
Quickly create powerful rules that control what you do and don't see across all your feeds. Avoid potential spoilers and stay clear of unwanted topics by creating rules that muffle and mute items in everything you follow.
⁕ Powerful Searching
Search for topics and terms across all feeds simultaneously. Tapestry makes it easy to find that blog post, YouTube video, or podcast you're looking for - and easy to mark it for later.
⁕ Private By Design
Your privacy is a priority. Tapestry works with content stored on your device, so searching and viewing content is completely private. We never sell or share your data with third parties. 
⁕ Custom Connectors
Expand Tapestry’s potential with third-party connectors. Import custom connectors from trusted developers, or even write your own to add your favorite bit of data to the timeline. If there's an open data feed available, a connector can weave it into Tapestry.
Additional Features:
• Universal app for iOS, iPadOS and macOS
• Quickly open posts in your favorite third party apps to take action
• Syncs your reading position via iCloud across devices
• Fully accessible using VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, and more
• Customize Tapestry's app icon, layout, and fonts
• Create custom timelines of your favorite feeds
• Mark your favorite items to read later
• Light and dark mode support
--------
Tapestry uses auto-renewing subscriptions. The subscription provides access to premium features like ad removal, custom timelines, feed customization, and more. The subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of your subscription period and will be charged through your iTunes account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.
Terms of Use: https://tapestry.iconfactory.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tapestry.iconfactory.com/privacy
